chapters.title: Chapter 451: Extinction
paragraphs: [Progress: 0.1%]
As the ten figures turned into nothing more than layers of skin, ten small red crystals fell to the ground.
He didn’t receive any killing notification or experience from them for some reason.
Vritra pulled his arms back and jerked off the flesh sticking to them, the radioactive radiations making his body glow with a greyish colour.
He glanced at the ten crystals but no message popped in front of him, so he just stored them away, they might be the things that would be used to save lives soon.
"What... just happened here?" Yennefer spoke, her eyes wide with bewilderment.
Whereas Maeve seemed to remember something, back in the Zihong inheritance, Vritra suffered so much soul damage but in the end, it only helped him increase his strength.
And for some reason, he was also making her attack him before as if it was very helpful to him.
’So getting hit with various sorts of attacks makes master stronger? Or maybe there are some requirements.’ She pondered.
"As the two of you can see, I am perfectly fine. So why don’t you just return to the hotel, I will be back after taking care of these plague rats."
Vritra said, his body slowly absorbing all the remaining radiations as messages kept popping.
"Are you sure, master? Your body is still filled with those dangerous radiations." Maeve asked, though she relaxed visibly.
"Yeah, don’t worry, I will be back soon." Vritra said and nodded towards the two women before turning around and walking away.
"..." After gazing at his back for a few moments, they looked at one another and finally left the place.
While Vritra was busy with these people, Yennefer decided to go and check if the oracle had formed some sort of plans.
For people of their strength, whether it be day or night, it’s all the same.
"Those ten came from that direction. Hmm, I can sense the radiations they left in their trail." Vritra mumbled, as he saw a big pipe that was leading deeper into the ground.
In the next moment, he rushed into the pipe.
The Arthal plague rats had formed an entire city underneath the plague city, the leaders had enough intelligence to properly develop their new species.
There was a building made of rubble from the broken buildings nearby the plague city.
The building was made to resemble a hospital; it was large enough to fit a few thousand people at once.
One of the leaders of the Arthal plague rats used it as his home while also trying to protect all the babies inside.
They had stolen over two thousand infants and stored them here, slowly changing their bodies to make the next generation of Arthal plague rats.
Who would be more intelligent, deadly, and advanced. The plague rats had no way of direct reproduction.
Although their lifespan had increased because of the radiations, sooner or later they would all die.
The leaders knew the importance of continuing their race forward, becoming a significant race in the future and replacing humanity completely.
All these people hated humans, especially because of the Nine Pacts, who made them go through such extreme experiments.
Like always, this leader was just sleeping in a large room.
It had just received the message that the new intruder had been taken care of.
The body of the Leader Arthal rat was nearly ten meters tall and enormous, constantly leaking terrifying radiations.
It was also helping in developing those children properly.
BANG
All of a sudden, the door that blocked the entrance of the single exit in the entire city was kicked open.
The heavy metal door flew away and hit one of the piles of garbage.
"Come out, daddy’s here!" Vritra rushed directly into the city, flying high up with his body glowing with a bright purplish colour, his demonic presence spreading across the whole place.
KRRRKHHH
GGRRRRRR...
The mindless wave of Arthal plague rats was startled at the sudden shout, they just followed whatever the three of their leaders told them.
But upon sensing that some intruder had actually dared to trespass into their territory, the creatures were filled with rage and bloodlust.
Thousands of plague rats rushed out, looking like a horde of zombies but with distorted and broken bodies.
RRRAAAAAAAARRRRRRRR!!
One of the leaders let out a deafening roar, suppressing all of them. The one near the hospital wouldn’t move until extremely necessary, so the other two giant leaders rushed in Vritra’s direction.
’Sigh, poor people, they have suffered far too much and even now their bodies are constantly ravaged with those radiations.
Those scums from the Nine Pacts and Bone Blood Cult truly need a good beating.’ Vritra pitied all these creatures.
They were just normal folks before, coming to the temple to pray for their families but instead became victims of such inhumane experiments.
He also noticed the hospital they had built inside their city and the thousands of human children whose bodies were slowly getting corrupted by the radiations.
"It is always powerless people who end up in such power struggles..." Yasmine sighed, harming all these children just could not be justified because all these creatures suffered before.
Yasmine then thought of Vritra who had obtained so much strength in such a short time, was betrayed and suffered so much yet still kept his kindness alive.
Most in his place would have caused chaos all over the world long ago.
"Let’s just get this over with." Vritra mumbled, looking at the thousands of rats, especially the two leaders at the front.
Fighting all of them at once might be painful, but it will give a faster death to them all.
The time inside the city suddenly slowed down, all the Arthal plague rats began to move slowly.
[Intra Shuffle Activated.]
Vritra decided to use the same tactic, and with his current strength, he could let his arms stretch over a really long distance.
WHOOSH WHOOSH
Instantly, his arms pierced through the bodies of hundreds of the creatures, and both his palms got embedded into the bodies of the two leaders.
Radioactive radiations, thousands of times more powerful than the ones before, immediately rushed into his body.
[Suck! Suck! Suck! Activated.]
The speed increased further by a lot, even the ones who hadn’t been attacked began to release the radiations.
Of course, Vritra didn’t use it on the kids present in the hospital; he wasn’t yet sure how to save them.
[Extreme Radiations Sensed!]
[Absorbing at full limits.]
Mutamorphis pushed itself to the limit as it began to merge the deadly radiations with Vritra’s body, but it was still quite a lot.
His arms would start to distort, only for them to return to normal after a moment. Vritra’s entire body was affected, but he didn’t pause and endured.
The creatures could do nothing but release more and more radiations.
Soon their bodies began to shrink, even the leaders’ bodies were affected.
’Hoo, just a little more...’ Vritra shut his eyes tight as minutes ticked by.
An hour or so had passed and nearly a quarter of the creatures were dead, leaving behind their skins and those tiny crystals.
Just like that, time passed, and within a few more hours, all the creatures died.
The three leaders and thousands of Arthal plague rats, whom not even the emperors could clear completely, were wiped out.
[Progress: 80%]

chapters.title: Chapter 452: Radioactive Radiations
paragraphs: [Progress: 80%]
[You have slain all Arthal Plague Rats.]
[Use the Arthal crystals to remove all the radiations from the bodies of the infants.]
Reading the messages, Vritra took all the crystals and pulled even the ones present in his dimensional book before using his dust ability to make each crystal hover above an infant.
Without even doing anything, a reaction triggered on its own, and instantly all the crystals were pulled closer to the mouths of the infants, pressing against their mouths.
Then the radiations were pulled out of all the infants, getting released into the environment.
[Suck! Suck! Suck! Activated.]
[Progress 100%]
[You have acquired Radioactive Field.]
As the few messages popped in front of Vritra, all the crystals separated from the infants whose bodies had returned to completely normal.
Then the crystals floated in the sky and began to merge, soon becoming one crystal, the size of a football.
[Quest completed.]
[You have obtained the Aurora of the Betrayed.]
"And we are done, sigh... now what am I going to do with so many babies? Where are their parents?" Vritra mumbled, but for now, he stored them all away into his dimensional book.
Thankfully, all of them were asleep right now.
"Although I have absorbed all the radiation, this crystal still seems like a treasure." After a thought, he stored away the stone too.
By this dangerous mission, he had obtained two big benefits.
First, getting closer to the first-ranked Mythic Halo and obtaining such a nice Field.
"Hubby, let’s test it out." Yasmine appeared outside and mumbled. This was the first time she had heard about such a field.
"Hmm." He nodded, then looked at one of the makeshift buildings. With just a thought, he released radioactive radiations.
These radiations were far stronger than even the three leaders combined. In a moment, the entire building was destroyed, decaying extremely quickly.
"Not bad, this was the most basic attack. Anyway, let’s leave this place. I am feeling tired."
Vritra stretched his arms, his entire body dirty with the flesh of the Arthal rats.
Flying back, he exited the city and soon arrived outside the broken temple.
"Hubby, when are you planning to upgrade your Fields?" Yasmine questioned, flying beside him.
"I will do it in a few days. It is better to gather more points first, as many as I can before these games stop," Vritra replied.
He hadn’t even checked how many points he had gathered yet.
Flying at full speed, he soon entered the cloud city.
Tin and Vin had been roaming around the Cloud City after leaving Ghazi City and going through a couple more.
They just had one motive, and that was to find Vritra, with literally no other information.
"Haa... what is the Oracle thinking? He didn’t even tell us anything and just told us to keep searching," Vin said while looking around at the stalls.
"I am so hungry, and why is this Cloud City so foggy? The shops are all closed this early," Tin complained.
Just while they were roaming in search of a hotel, the brothers spotted Yennefer.
She had removed her disguise and was going to meet with the Oracle.
"Empre— cough, Yennefer!" Tin called out, hurriedly flying higher into the sky.
"What are you doing here? Still searching for him?" Yennefer paused and questioned.
She didn’t like these two brothers, but it would be beneficial to get some info, so she decided to pause for a moment.
"Yeah, sigh... we are too strong and popular. If he even spots us, I am sure he will just leave the city itself," Vin muttered, shaking his head proudly.
"So why didn’t you try disguising yourselves?" Yennefer asked. As expected, this pair was just too idiotic.
"Ah... w-we were actually about to do it. Anyway, are you going to meet the Oracle?" Tin spoke hurriedly.
"Yes." Yennefer shook her head. Vritra had actually appeared before the brothers more than once.
One time in the underground market, secondly during the fake marriage, and the third time during the game they watched earlier.
"Oh right, your servant... hmm, what was he called again? Green poop or something. After your wild announcements, he has been searching for you," Tin said before gesturing into the distance.
On the ground was a man in a green robe with long nails, trying to book three rooms in a hotel.
"Forget him, I am leaving." Yennefer didn’t want to waste time here, so she turned around and left.
"Wait, we are coming too. We need to have a word with the Oracle as well."
Tin and Vin both followed. They decided not to tell anyone that they had met with her.
Back on the ground, Green Claw looked around in confusion but couldn’t see anyone. Even the twins had disappeared.
"Huff... where did they disappear off to now? Sob... they keep dragging me along like a slave. Should I make a run for my life?"
Green Claw muttered but decided not to. Even the Empress had disappeared, so who would protect him from that pair of demonic siblings?
His search continued as he left one of the hotels disappointedly.
But right as he stepped out of the door, a person flashed before him — the speed was too fast.
After a moment, as Green Claw registered who it was, his eyes widened in shock and bewilderment.
"Y-you! Vritr—"
But a hand suddenly gripped his mouth and dragged the man away from there.
Vritra tightly held Green Claw’s head and flew higher and higher, demonic presence bursting out of his body.
He was just passing by when he noticed this guy and remembered that it was exactly him who had hurt Maeve that badly.
So how could he be allowed to live without receiving any punishment?
Vritra decided to test his new Field on a living target. The bar of radioactive radiation was still quite low, though.
Green Claw continued to struggle, trying to slash at Vritra’s arm, but it was all useless. He was completely powerless.
Vritra paused after reaching high enough and then entered the dimensional book.
Then he threw Green Claw away.
"Hello, this is the second time we are meeting. Let me properly introduce myself." After a pause, he added, "I am Vritra Arclis."
"You... how are you so strong? Weren’t you supposed to be in the 3rd or 4th Legion rank? What is going on? And when did we meet before?" Green Claw hastily took a defensive pose.
"That is not important. Looks like you replaced the finger I cut before, but it has the weakest poison." Cool air rustled his hair as the two stood in the night sky.
"It was you! Y-you did it to... save that demoness?" The exclamation in his voice was evident as Green Claw quickly thought.

"Not bad. You see, Maeve is my woman, so I am gonna have to punish you a little." Vritra said as terrifying radiations began to revolve around his body. It felt as if the air and space itself were boiling and decaying.
"W-wait! I was just following my orders! T-The Empress, she will not forgive you if you do something to me!" Green Claw’s body stumbled back, cold sweat soon drenching his clothes.

chapters.title: Chapter 453: The Treasure
paragraphs: "You don’t have to worry about that." Vritra said, ready to try out the radiations in various ways.
"NOOO STOP! It was a mistake, I just had to follow the empress’s orders and G- Griffith forced me to give him—umph." He nervously began to beg, his knees falling over empty air as he knelt.
But he suddenly paused upon sensing that he had said far too much.
"Ah, so it really was you. Good, that will just make your punishment a bit more painful and longer." Vritra said, appearing like a real devil.
His hands waved lightly through the air, as intense radiations instantly swallowed Green Claw’s body, not even giving him time to stand or flee.
Then Vritra began to test the radioactive radiations in various ways, testing the highest and lowest power.
Using it in various ways, Vritra was even able to produce dangerous diseases in his body very quickly.
He found how to do it without even a little pain or anyone noticing, or how to make it most painful.
The experiments continued for over an hour, and finally, Vritra had tested all the things he could think of.
By the end of his experiments, Green Claw was nothing more than a mass of twisting flesh hovering in the sky.
He was completely destroyed already.
"Bobby, eat him up." Vritra ordered, as a shadow flew from under his feet.
Just as Green Claw died, several messages popped in front of Vritra, and then his soul got eaten by Bobby.
Now both Psyche and Bobby had strength above the General rank, and soon he planned to kill Raelion too.
"Haa, finally time to rest." Vritra turned and flew towards the hotel.
Upon arriving, he only found Maeve there and learned that Yennefer had gone out to meet the oracle and get some information.
"Welcome back, master. Let’s bathe together, and then we can eat."
Maeve said as Vritra entered the house. She was happy to have him all to herself again.
Vritra nodded, heading towards the bathroom where Maeve removed her clothes and then helped Vritra.
After a quick shower and some practice of the lessons the demoness had received before, they settled in the bathtub.
Maeve sat on top of Vritra, her back pressed against his chest, his penis resting safely between the tight confines of her vagina.
"Master, can you tell me more about your world and our family members that I am yet to meet?" Maeve spoke, leaning back with her eyes closed, hugging his arms, which were kneading her soft boobs.
"Well, in most things, my world wasn’t too much different from this one, except the powers here and killing wasn’t as open unless you had enough money or status."
Vritra began to speak, telling her about Earth, then more about Fiona, Diana, and his mother.
"Fiona has the bloodline of the Phoenix Queen?" Maeve questioned, opening her eyes in surprise.
"Yes, did I not mention that before?" Vritra said, wondering why she was so surprised, then remembered that her mother was killed by one of the emperors of the phoenix race.
"Is it because of y—" Vritra was just questioning when Maeve turned her head and spoke,

"Master, actually, some time ago I broke into the Phoenix Kingdom and stole one of their most precious treasures, which is why none of the emperors have been able to take proper control of the entire race yet." Maeve said.
It was because of her grudge that she had even increased the feud between the two sides.
"Oh, what sort of treasure?" Vritra questioned curiously.
"Well, it is the body of the previous Phoenix Empress. Using this, one of the two emperors could obtain her strength and abilities.
But I stole it when the two were busy fighting, though it wasn’t really of any use to me."
Maeve explained as she turned her body without letting his member slip out of her and now sat facing him.
"Oh... so you mean to say..." Vritra waited for her.
"Yes, master, I can give it to Fiona. It will definitely be of great help to her, quickening her growth by several times."
Maeve said, looking excited and happy to help her family.
Even though they were yet to meet, the demoness already considered the other women close, like a family she always wanted.
"Thank you, Foxie." Vritra muttered, pressing his lips against hers and hugging her body tightly.

chapters.title: Chapter 454: Devil and Us
paragraphs: Vritra paused, sensing the change in the mountain in the distance; it was close to the door that Vanessa had entered some time ago.
"Is mom coming out?" Vritra excitedly moved towards the mountain, and several other people in the city noticed the change.
Along with the princess, several other warriors rushed towards it, joyful expressions on their faces.
"Oh, when did you get here?" The princess nodded towards Vritra and questioned.
"Just now." Vritra replied, but she was most probably already aware of his presence. Then he questioned, "But what’s going on here? Mom is going to come out?"
"She has finished all her tests. Vanessa is going to be the next Succubus Queen! The danger has ended. Now she just needs to receive her inheritance, and her strength will skyrocket."
The princess said, sounding cheerful.
"So she isn’t coming out?" Vritra was happy that she had already crossed all the danger and that soon her strength would be quite high, but he really wished to meet her.
"Not now, but the process of inheritance will only take around ten or so days. And before she starts, you can still meet her, but for a short time." The princess answered, sensing Vritra’s emotions.
"Oh, when can I meet her?" He relaxed a bit and questioned.
The princess remained silent for a minute as the mountains finally calmed down, then she added, "Why don’t you bring those two along? You will be able to meet her right now."
Vritra knew she was referring to Diana and Fiona, so without wasting any time, he just teleported to the house.
Grabbing the arms of the surprised ladies, he teleported back before they could even ask a question.
"D-Dear, what’s wrong?" Diana asked, looking around at the few gathered succubi.
"Darling, this place is..." Fiona also glanced around, and then at the faintly glowing door.
"We are going to meet mom. She has already passed all the tests." Vritra said, while the princess drew something on the door with her finger.
Drrrrrr...
With a loud sound, the doors opened. The princess gestured for only Vritra and the two women to follow while the other succubi waited outside.
Right after entering, the group of four found themselves in a white cubic space, the ground filled with beautiful, colorful flowers.
There was a door on one of the walls, which was shut tight.
"She will be here soon." The princess added, inhaling the fragrance of the flowers.
A few minutes passed, and finally, the sound of a door being pushed open rang out.
Then cold wind gushed out as a figure came into everyone’s sight.
"..." Vanessa was dressed in a beautiful red dress, looking absolutely gorgeous. There were two small horns on her head and a tail on her back. Moving gracefully, she stopped in front of Vritra.
Her appearance seemed to have changed slightly, and her strength was already quite high. Vanessa’s temperament seemed to have changed too.
"Honey..." Vanessa smiled.
Taking a step forward, she tightly embraced him. There was a big time difference between the two sides, so she had been away from him longer than he had been from her.
Vanessa missed him very much. Tears filled her eyes as she finally got to hold him.
"Mom, you didn’t get hurt, did you?" Vritra asked softly, hugging his mother back.
He deeply inhaled her sweet, familiar scent, feeling as if the two were melting in each other’s warmth.
"No, but I sensed whenever you were sad, angry, or hurt. Tell me, what happened?" Vanessa pulled back slightly, gently cupping his face and looking into his eyes.
Her strength was not yet enough to help him, but at every point in life, she would do anything to protect and support him.
"It’s nothing, mom, that has been resolved. Haa, I really missed you so much." Vritra once again pulled her into a tight hug, not wanting to separate from her.
The two embraced one another for a few minutes while talking about different things. Then they separated.
Vanessa glanced at Diana and Fiona, smiling at them, she asked, "So, how have the two of you been?"
"Mom!" Fiona hugged her, followed by the goddess.
"Princess, do you have something to tell me?" Vanessa wanted some private family time, so she directly spoke to the princess.
"Queen, just call me Gia, and before you start with the inheritance, please inscribe your name on this." As Gia spoke, she took out a thin stone slab.
It began to float in the air.
There were already several names present on the stone slab, but it was in a language that no one except Vritra could understand.
But since it was blurry, even he couldn’t understand anything.
Vanessa nodded and inserted some of her mana into it as her name automatically got ingrained on the stone.
"Thank you, Queen." Gia lightly bowed before storing away the slab and leaving the place, fully aware that the family wanted some private time.
Just as the group was alone, even Yasmine came out, appearing in her human form.
"Mom, you have become even more beautiful. It’s good that we can finally meet you.
Hubby was quite depressed earlier, always missing you." She spoke, giving Vanessa a light hug.
"This won’t take too long; I will be out before you know it. And then I will be able to help you, honey, though I am not sure how much my strength will have increased by then."
Vanessa said, feeling emotional after meeting her son after such a long time.
"It’s fine, mom, just focus on this. Everything outside is going smoothly so far." Vritra said. Meeting her again felt like a big worry had disappeared.
They chatted for a while longer, and although they were reluctant to leave, soon it was time to say goodbyes again.
"Honey, no need to do anything dangerous. Wait for me to come out. Then I will help Yasmine get her body back.
There are still many powerful warriors in the succubus race, and now they will obey my commands." Vanessa said, looking reluctant to separate from them.
"Yes, mom." Vritra was happy to be able to meet her again but sad to part with her.
After reluctant goodbyes, Vritra and the two ladies left the white room and walked out of the door.
The door closed, and soon after, the process of receiving the inheritance began.
"Darling, you are not just going to leave again, right?" Fiona asked, hoping to spend some time with him.
"Yes, I will be staying here for the night. Let’s return home and eat." Vritra said, in a good mood.
"Dear, I have succeeded in several of my researches and made miraculous potions. You should check them out.
I am sure they will be a great help in the game." Diana spoke; she was wearing round glasses just to appear wiser.
"Alright, I will check them." The goddess really looked gorgeous with those glasses.
Soon the group returned to the house.
As the goddess prepared the food, Vritra called to Fiona and spoke, "I have brought a really special gift for you. Well, it is from Foxie, so you should thank her when you two meet."
Even if this gift was of no use to them, no one would give it up just like that. Maeve truly considered them her family, so she didn’t think twice before giving it away.
"Maeve gave me a gift? I am really curious about her." A smile appeared over Fiona’s face. At first, upon hearing about the fox demon, she wasn’t too optimistic.
But hearing more and more about her, Fiona and Diana got to know about her.
"This is the previous Phoenix Empress’s body. Well, not her physical body, but let’s say a mana body in a sense.
With this, your strength will grow rapidly even without hunting any demons, and your comprehension will increase rapidly." Vritra said. It was like a cheat code to Lord rank.
"Oh, i-isn’t this too precious? She really gave me such a gift just like that?" Fiona was even more shocked now. Previously, she didn’t think it would be something so valuable.
"Yeah, so use it well and grow stronger. We will be facing a lot together in the future."
Vritra passed the mana body to her in a dimensional book’s page.
"After mom comes out, I can finally meet her. Anyway, food is ready." Fiona excitedly began to serve food for them.
’Mom and Fiona could grow strong quickly. Wifey will also return to her peak after getting her body.
Yennefer and Foxie are already very strong, so that only leaves Diana.’ Vritra thought, wondering how to help her too.
While eating, Vritra shared a few of his future plans, like going to the Dragon Kingdom and attacking the Phoenix race.
But as always, the future remained unpredictable, and in the face of fate, all planning would turn fruitless.
Still enjoying the peace before the storm, the three went for a walk after a tasty meal.
"Uh..." As they were about to arrive at home, Fiona seemed like she wanted to say something but was hesitating.
"What’s wrong? Just say whatever you want; you shouldn’t hesitate between us."
Vritra said, holding her hand; their fingers intertwined.
"There... is a play we wish to do, and it is kind of strange, but it’s really exciting." Fiona finally spoke, looking a little embarrassed.
"Oh, what sort of play? Don’t act shy, just tell me." Vritra encouraged her, while the goddess looked to the side, as if she knew nothing of it.
"..." Fiona passed a book to him—the book that contained the play that could fulfill both of their fetishes at once.
Vritra read the title: The Sacrifices My Sister Made, Devil and Us!

chapters.title: Chapter 455: Devil’s Puppet-1 [R-18]
paragraphs: The Sacrifices My Sister Made, Devil and Us!
Vritra: "..."
He opened the book and scanned through the content, his eyebrows rising in surprise.
"Your tastes sure are evolving." He muttered after reading the part they wanted to play.
"Uh... It’s fine if you are not comfortable with it, you don’t have to do it, dear." Diana said, though her eyes said otherwise.
"Haa, we can do it, what’s the worst that can happen? At most I would just fall in my own eyes, unable to look at myself in the mirror."
Vritra joked, passing the book back, wondering where they were even getting such content in this city.
I am Fiona, just 19 years old and this year my college was about to start.
I have an older sister, Diana, who loves me a lot. Some time ago, our parents crashed into an aeroplane and disappeared, leaving us with enormous debt.
We would have to spend millions of dollars just to become broke, not to mention those thugs that would come to our house often for money.
Our life was supposed to be over, but to protect me, my sister made a deal with the devil.
He paid off all our debts, but my sister became his toy. Of course, I wasn’t aware of any of it. She just made excuses about the sudden changes.
While returning home from my college, I seemed to hear my sister’s voice.
So I stopped to check; it was a house that belonged to the devil, the biggest criminal of the underworld.
I opened the door slightly and peeked inside, there I saw my sister standing humiliated in front of that very devil.
’W- What’s she doing here?!! I- It’s the devil?’ Fiona was utterly shocked by this scene.
The street was bustling with people, and the sound of the two was clearly audible outside.
"Diana, you know that you have to come when and where I tell you to, right?" The devil spoke, holding her chin between his thumb and finger.
"I- I am sorry, I was outside the city. N- Next time, I won’t be late." Diana muttered, not meeting his gaze.
"You see, we made a deal and according to it, you are mine to do with as I please for the next twenty years.
If you continue with your rebellious behaviour in the future, I might as well make you two sisters disappear forever." Vritra spoke, his eyes narrowing dangerously.
"No! D- Don’t do anything to Fiona, I am b- begging you. I won’t make a mistake ever, please just do whatever you want with me." Diana pleaded, her body shaking in terror.

’Deal? My sister made a deal with him? So that’s how she paid off our debts? S- She has been tormented by this Devil all this time?’ Fiona was utterly shocked, looking at her sister with tears in her eyes.

Vritra questioned. He didn’t want to waste time; so many sin points were waiting for him inside.
"Actually, the emperor handed me the treasure you asked for. I hope this is to your liking." General Sirius handed Vritra a crown that seemed to be made of wood.
"Thank you, General, also thank the emperor for this gift." Vritra took the crown and checked its status.
He frowned slightly, as this was not as great as the luck treasure he got back in the Dunshire Kingdom, but still better than nothing.
[The Crown of Favourability]
[Description]: A crown made by the unfortunate witch, the stealer of fate. It can increase your Luck stat to twice for twenty seconds.
’Well, it seems I will have to do with this for now. Better than nothing, and even if I end up wasting some points, I can just earn more.’
Vritra thought, sensing the big crowd of people that waited for him inside.
"This is perfect, just what I was looking for. Let’s head inside, also please enjoy the show as always."
Vritra said with a smile, as the two headed inside.
While talking with the general, Vritra thought about a doubt he had been thinking of for a while now.
’Wifey, you said as the comprehensions of the field increase, people can form their own domain.
Yet even till now, I haven’t seen a person use their domain, even when they die. Not even Raelion.’ He questioned.
"Since it’s a rule set by the Divine Kage organization, and, well, if without permission anyone uses the domain, the consequences could be really bad." Yasmine answered.
’All the people are that afraid of that organization? Is it made solely of humans? Their strength is even above the lords or something?’
Vritra was intrigued upon hearing it. Normally, Yasmine wouldn’t talk much about that secretive group.
"That organization is too mysterious, but I know they have direct connections with the gods. I haven’t really seen someone from that group in action, though.
There are many mysteries in this world that are too dangerous to even think about." Yasmine sighed, aware of how many people had died opposing the Divine Kage organization.
’I see, then let’s hope I don’t encounter any of them for the time being.’ Vritra thought and decided to push this topic to the back of his mind.
’It is time to get rich, earn millions of sin points.’ Vritra thought as he stepped into the arena, which was already so crowded.

"Congratulations, you have hit a big jackpot!! You have killed the demon Ziggy, son of a Demon Lord."
Vritra said while clapping, looking at the man who was overjoyed.

"Don’t you worry, our emperor has taken the responsibility of killing Ziggy, so just enjoy your money while the emperor deals with that Demon Lord."

Ignoring him for now, Vritra opened his status panel with anticipation to finally look at his harvest; he hoped it to be higher than last time.
And as his gaze landed on the number, Vritra was actually shocked.

Vritra stretched his arms, rubbing his head, feeling quite the headache as he got up.
He glanced back and looked at Dark Knight’s status; the figure of the knight had become extremely terrifying.
Just standing there put great pressure on the surroundings, its eyes glowing with a terrifying light.
[Dark Knight]
"Nice, you did great." Vritra praised, as the knight knelt before him, speaking in a heavy tone, "Thank you, master."
’Would be great if I can feed a Lord-ranked creature to Hellmancer too.’
Vritra thought as he dismissed the knight with a wave of his hand, as the creature of the night returned to his shadow.
Finally, Vritra opened his own status and read it from top to bottom, sighing as he observed his improvements.

sentences.text: Staring at the sin points, Vritra did the math of how he was going to spend his sin points.
He still wasn’t sure that to increase his level further from the general rank, would he need to just increase the comprehension of one of his fields or all.
"Well, I do have enough sin points for either case." Vritra said, a smile spreading across his face as he stared at the big number.
The number was over twice as big as the last time already, with that amount he could increase the comprehension of his fields at once.
"And then my level would finally increase, but that’s still not enough to face all opponents, so I need to sacrifice the biggest star of my show."
Vritra mumbled as he gazed at Raelion, who lay over the ground, wounded and broken.
"Wifey, can killing him, along with all the experience points I have gotten before, boost me to the Lord rank?" Vritra questioned.
The difference between the general rank and Lord rank was immense.
He still didn’t even know what level the Lord rank actually belonged to.
"Yes, it should be enough, but you are different from me or anyone I have ever met, so I can’t say surely for you."
Yasmine spoke, as she materialized beside him in her human-like form.
"In any case, getting those levels will surely boost my strength."
Vritra mumbled and approached Raelion, who didn’t even have the strength to beg.
"Any last words?" Vritra asked, his figure towering over the fallen lord.
BANG
Suddenly, a kick to the head destroyed Raelion’s skull, turning it into minced meat.
"Haa, scum like you don’t deserve to say any last words.
I can’t even say may your soul burn in hell, after all, someone here is ready to gobble you up entirely."
Vritra said, as the dark knight’s figure rose from under his shadow.
An endless dark flame burned around its body, its armor looking terrifying.
"Kill him." Vritra ordered as he cleaned his feet against the ground and stood back, watching as the dark knight pulled its long sword.
Raelion, being a demon lord, had very strong vitality and soul.
He wouldn’t die so easily, and if Vritra was not being careful, then he just might have escaped.
The long sword turned into a blur as the knight moved at extreme speed, cutting Raelion’s body into tiny pieces until his physical body was destroyed beyond repair.
His soul instantly tried to leave, but just a thought from Vritra was enough to lock him up.
Vritra’s soul was already at the Lord rank, although just at the entry level, but for now, it was enough.
Instantly, the dark knight began to devour it, absorbing the enormous energy from each bite it took.
Despite having destroyed Raelion’s physical body, no notification of the kill popped in front of Vritra.
A Lord could only be killed once even their soul had been destroyed.
"This is going to take a while.
Knight needs more time to completely devour him." Vritra thought, looking at the sight before him.
Very soon, he would have a Lord-ranked soul wraith.
Only at moments like these did Nihilanima’s true worth display itself.
"While they are busy playing, I can start increasing my comprehension." Vritra thought and opened his Field palette.
The one closest to 50% was Dust Manipulation, so to test his doubt, Vritra decided to make it reach the threshold.
{Palette Droplet: 23}
Vritra quickly spent forty-six million sin points and purchased 23 Palette Droplets, then he sat down and began to use the droplets.
{Used 1 Palette Droplet}
{Increasing the comprehension of Dust Manipulation!}
{Dust Manipulation: 28%}
Instantly, a large amount of information began to enter his mind.
Vritra slowly began to use one droplet after another on Dust Manipulation.
{Used 1 Palette Droplet!}
{Used 1 Palette Droplet!}
{Used 1 Palette Droplet!}
{Increasing Dust Manipulation comprehension!}
{Increasing Dust Manipulation comprehension!}
{Increasing Dust Manipulation comprehension!}
{Dust Manipulation: 29%}
{Dust Manipulation: 30%}
{Dust Manipulation: 31%}
{Dust Manipulation: 50%}
As the comprehension reached 50%, Vritra felt a big qualitative leap in his understanding and the power of Dust Manipulation.
All those sin points were well spent; Dust Manipulation’s power had grown significantly.
But unfortunately, even still, he didn’t gain all the experience points that were on pause.
Which could only mean that his speculations were right — he needed to increase the comprehension of all his fields to at least 50%.
"Well, that is fine too.
I certainly have enough sin points, sigh, let’s start." Vritra was sure his mind was going to hurt so badly after absorbing so much information at once.
He even used Null to change the time speed for him so he wouldn’t end up spending too much time inside the dimensional book.
{Palette Droplet: 305}
{Sin Points: 33,434,932}
Vritra purchased a lot of Palette Droplets in bulk as the big number of sin points quickly decreased.
{Used 1 Palette Droplet!}
{Used 1 Palette Droplet!}
{Increasing Null comprehension!}
{Increasing Null comprehension!}
{Null: 21%}
{Null: 22%}
And just like that, both Vritra and the dark knight got busy with their tasks, their strength growing rapidly.
If people were to know the field comprehension could increase so rapidly and easily, they would go mad.
"Haa, and I was called one of the biggest geniuses for comprehending my field to 100% at that young age."
Yasmine thought, but she was still under twenty and did it rather quickly, so she didn’t really feel bad seeing it.
Minutes turned into hours and hours turned into days, as nearly two days had passed.
But with Null’s high comprehension, Vritra’s grip over time became even stronger, so outside, it should still be the night of the same day.
But close to morning.
On the other hand, Hellmancer was also quite close to devouring the soul of the demon lord.
With Vritra being close, it didn’t really have to worry about getting exploded.
Not only did it have a large supply of mana, but Vritra could pause the process midway whenever things became dangerous using Null.
{Used 1 Palette Droplet!}
{Used 1 Palette Droplet!}
{Increasing Radioactive comprehension!}
{Increasing Radioactive comprehension!}
{Radioactive: 49%}
{Radioactive: 50%}
Some more time passed, and Raelion was finally dead, as several messages flashed before Vritra.
[You have killed a Level 30,036 Demon Lord.]
[Exp Gained!]
[Exp Gained!]
[Exp Gained!]
[You have levelled up!]
[You have levelled up!]
[You have levelled up!]
Finally, the message that Vritra had been waiting to see popped in front of him, just as he finished increasing the comprehension of all his fields to 50%.

chapters.title: Chapter 460: Atomic
paragraphs: Vritra read his status, surprised at how absurd his stats seemed, and finally, his fields were all at 50%, and Vritra was still left with some sin points.
But the biggest change was that he was finally at the Lord rank, becoming one of the top powers on this planet.
His body was brewing with strength, and he felt that within moments, he could obliterate an entire city if he so much as wished to.
His level was a bit lower than the Dark Knight’s since the wraith had literally absorbed all of Raelion’s power, while it was different for all other beings.
They gained experience points, which increased their strength by leveling. Not to mention, leveling for Vritra was a lot harder than for most others—or so it was supposed to be.
"Finally, I am done with the first step. Now let’s see what I can do with the remaining points." Vritra mumbled as he gazed at his remaining sin points.
{Sin Points: 33,434,932}
"Let’s buy some luck points first." Upon deciding, he quickly exchanged twenty-one million sin points for seven hundred Luck points.
[Using 700 luck points.]
[Your luck has increased to 1212]
"Good, now let’s buy sin keys." Vritra glanced toward the remaining points.
{Sin Points: 12,434,932}
Then he exchanged one million sin points to get a hundred sin keys. The number of sin points had greatly reduced by now.
{Sin Keys: 100}
"The drop odds have increased to 13.12%, still that’s not high enough. But I do have a treasure, so should I wait until I have gathered more points or use it now?" Vritra wondered.
The choice was slightly difficult.

If he used it now, he might end up wasting both sin points and the treasure, but with how the air seemed ominous by the day, Vritra wouldn’t be surprised if he got attacked the moment he left this space.
Then he would be left regretting not rolling the wheel because of his greed for better.

"Hoo, this is just sin points. I can gather millions again after a few more days, and if I loot the emperor’s treasury, then I am sure I am bound to find at least a few luck treasures—a lot better than this."
He finally made up his mind and decided to use all the keys now.
Since the treasure would only last for 20 seconds, his luck would be doubled only for 20 chances, then it would be back to low again.
After a few more moments of contemplation, Vritra decided to pour the remaining sin points into luck to increase his chances as much as possible.
{Sin Points: 434,932}
And just like that, another twelve million disappeared, and Vritra obtained another four hundred luck points.
[Using 400 luck points.]
[Your luck has increased to 1612]
"Good, now the drop rate is 17.12%. Along with the crown, it would be a great help." Smiling, he decided to purchase more sin keys.
{Sin Points: 4,932}
{Sin Keys: 143}
"Haa, I am finally done with all the preparations. Now wifey, let’s do some gambling." Vritra spoke, pulling out a chair from his inventory as he sat down.
"Hubby, whatever might be the result, don’t get too tense like that previous time, okay?"
Yasmine spoke as she sat over his lap, hugging him.
Although it was nothing like holding a real person, the two still felt quite close at moments like these.
"Yes, don’t you worry. I will be perfectly calm, even if I don’t draw at least ten things from so many keys. You can believe me." Vritra said, appearing nonchalant.
"Huff, I sure do hope so. It’s strange how gambling changes people." Yasmine shook her head before chuckling. She was just as addicted to rolling the wheel as her husband.
Without wasting a moment, Vritra took out the wooden crown from his storage, put it over his head, and got ready to roll the wheel.
[The Crown of Favourability Activated.]
[Your luck has doubled for the next twenty seconds.]
[Used 1 Sin Key.]
[Used 1 Sin Key.]
[Used 1 Sin Key.]
Vritra kept using one key after another, not stopping even as the crown turned to ashes and disappeared. He used all the keys as fast as possible.
As the wheel kept rolling and messages kept popping before him each second, neither Vritra nor Yasmine glanced at the messages.
After over two minutes, the golden wheel finally rolled for the last time as it took the 143rd key.
"Haa, finally done. Now let’s see what are the things I have obtained." Vritra and Yasmine looked at over a hundred messages at once.
Most of them were:
[Better Luck Next Time!]
But among the series of these messages, there were a few longer ones too.
[You have acquired Dew of Life.]
[Dew of Life]
[Description]: The tear of a legendary entity, which once consumed, would greatly reduce the chances of one’s death.
"Oh, this is good, but let’s hold onto it for now. I have to think of the best way to use it."
Vritra thought as he gazed at a green liquid drop that seemed to brighten his surroundings with a bright green color.
Of course, it would be of great help to him, but he decided to keep it for his family. Maybe someone among them would need it more than him.
Safely securing the green droplet into his dimensional book’s page, he moved to the next messages.
[You have acquired the Armor of Zenher.]
[Armor of Zenher]
[Description]: The legendary armor that survived thousands of battles, protecting its bearer from any and every attack.
A person shielded by this armor could never be hurt even by the lords. Increases agility greatly.
"Hmm, again, this is great but won’t be of much use to me." Vritra thought. With his defenses, he didn’t need such armor, so he decided to give it to Diana or Fiona.
But it was a lot better than nothing. Still excited, Vritra continued to read.
[You have acquired the hybrid skill Atomic.]
Vritra became excited the moment he read the word Hybrid. All hybrid skills were top-notch, and he had never been disappointed before.
"Finally, I got a skill—and a hybrid one at that!" Vritra spoke, squeezing Yasmine’s body tighter.
The dragoness just smiled; seeing him happy made her feel happy.
[Atomic]
[Skill Description]: All atoms present around the user move at extreme speed, creating a destructive and almost impenetrable force field.

It could be controlled by the user at will, changing shape, speed, and power. It could also activate on its own upon sensing a deadly strike approaching. The force field could be used in various ways.
"Damn, that sounds awesome." Vritra’s eyes glowed with excitement.
It was moments like these that made all the effort he spent earning those sin points worth it.
His already strong defenses had become deadlier now, and he instantly wanted to try it.
Yasmine, knowing her husband fully well, got off his lap and floated in the air, encouraging him, "Hubby, let’s try Atomic!"
Vritra looked around, then took out a spare table from his inventory that was made of metal.
[Atomic Activated]

chapters.title: Chapter 461: Cry Baby
paragraphs: [Atomic Activated.]
The moment the skill was activated, Vritra clearly sensed a force field appear around his body, the atoms moving at an incredibly high speed.
Moving at a constant distance from his skin, it was like he was wearing an invisible armor, protecting his entire body.
"Let’s see how deadly it is." Vritra could clearly control the force and shape of the force field.
Not to mention that it wasn’t even using any of his mana, so if he wished, Vritra could keep it active at all times.
First, he switched to low speed.
As the particles of air began to move slower, he increased the shape slightly, nearly 1 centimetre from his skin.
Then he extended his right hand towards the metallic table, gently placing his palm on top of it.
But even before his skin could come in contact with the surface, it was as if the table was being cut into tiny pieces, disintegrating into extremely small fragments.
It was like the metal had turned into butter and his palm into an extremely hot substance, making it melt even before coming into direct contact.
Vritra casually moved his fingers around as the table kept disintegrating right before coming into contact.
"That’s great, let’s test something else." Vritra changed the way the atoms were moving, keeping the speed the same.
Then he brought his palm close to the metallic table, touching it from the side.
BANG
Unlike before, the table wasn’t cut into tiny pieces but was distorted and thrown away as if pushed with very high force, landing several hundred metres away.
"I knew I could do this, this Atomic might be better than I expected. Well, a great addition to my arsenal of Hybrid skills." Vritra nodded in satisfaction.
Without deactivating the skill, he sat down on the chair, which wasn’t affected at all by his force field.
And to do that, he just needed to change the shape of his invisible armor, and now even the chair was being protected.
"That’s wonderful, hubby. This skill could have so many diverse uses in the future. But I wonder what its limits are."
Yasmine spoke as she gently sat back onto his lap, hugging him as the two got ready to open up the presents.
"I have a feeling I will be able to test that pretty soon." Sighing, he looked at the next message.
[200,000 Strength stat points.]
[Description]: You have obtained 200,000 strength points that have already been added to the stats.
"Oh well, that’s great. No wonder I noticed a big change in strength stat. Let’s continue." Vritra wasn’t disappointed by any of the prizes so far.
[You have acquired weapon, the Scar Knife.]
[The Scar Knife]
[Rank]: Lord
[Description]: The favorite creation in a big village of dwarves, lost upon the death of the village head. The knife continues to survive.
One of the sharpest creations that could overlook almost all sorts of defenses and deal damage to opponents.
Damage done by this weapon takes an extremely long time to heal, and in most cases, the wounds might never heal.
Vritra pulled a knife out of his inventory, as a steel-like, simple-looking knife appeared in his hand.
It was like its entire surface was coated with silver, but holding it in his hand, Vritra could feel the deadly pressure it exuded, appearing as if it could cut anything.
"Lord rank, nice. I was really lacking a good weapon, but should I merge it with my axes or keep it as it is...?" Vritra wondered.
"Let’s decide that upon checking the rest of the winnings. Maybe there are more and better weapons, and we can keep it for emergencies."
Yasmine suggested, so Vritra put the knife away for now, checking the next rewards.
It felt extremely great to get so many things.
[You have acquired the passive skill Lost!]
[Lost]
[Skill Description]: It becomes increasingly difficult for people to notice you.
The less movement you make or disturb your surroundings, the more you meld in with your environment. Normally, people wouldn’t pay attention to you if you don’t wish them to.
"Hmm, a hiding-type skill, passive one at that. It’s awesome. It’s even better since I can control whether I want people around me to notice me or not, just perfect."
Vritra smiled, feeling himself becoming one with the surroundings. As he stayed still, his breathing became slower.
"Hubby, once you activated the skill, I actually almost forgot about you. This one is powerful but, of course, might not work every time." Yasmine said, staring at his face.
"Well, this much is already great, not to mention it’s a passive skill." Vritra shrugged, reducing the effect before moving to the next.
[You have acquired 300,000 allocation points.]
"Good stuff, I am yet to add any of the allocation points. Let’s do it at the end." Vritra mumbled before continuing.
[You have acquired the active skill Cry Baby.]
Vritra: "..."
Yasmine: "..."
"Uhm, why are the names becoming weirder again?" Vritra paused for a moment, but remembering how great Suck! Suck! Suck! was, he decided to give it the benefit of doubt.
[Cry Baby]
[Skill Description]: An active skill that could only be activated if you start crying genuinely like a baby.
Each tear you shed increases your strength based on your emotions. So don’t hold back and go ahead, cry your heart out.
Prove to the world there are things more dangerous than a female’s crocodile tears — the genuine tears of the biggest cry baby.
"This piece of shit, what sort of garbage is this? I want a refund, you thug Divine, who do you take me for? I am not going to cry."
Vritra frowned and shouted while cursing towards the sky, and huffed upon pouring out all his frustrations.
This skill was just pure trash. Vritra decided to ignore it; there was no point in even remembering it.
"Maybe... this just has a weird name and activation condition. We can’t say it is trash without seeing its effects.
Hubby, go ahead and try crying, I am here to console you, you love role-playing, right?" Yasmine spoke, her lips curling up into a mischievous smile.
"Wifey, I will turn you into a cry baby the day we meet, don’t you worry." Vritra promised and ignored the newly acquired active trash skill.
[You have acquired the indestructible cloth.]
[Indestructible Cloth]
[Description]: A cloth that could take any shape you imagine and would never get dirty. No matter the condition, it could never be destroyed.
The creator and the previous owners died, but it continued to survive. The wearer of this cloth becomes increasingly charming, attracting attention from a big distance around it.

"Haa, this is good. I needed clothes that won’t tear the first moment I engage in battle. And it could work well while gathering sin points too." Vritra thought as he took out a soft piece of cloth from his inventory.
But it was quite the opposite of his Lost skill.
Vritra stood up and imagined the sort of clothes he wanted to wear, and instantly the white piece of cloth transformed.
He quickly changed into his new set of clothes, which were bluish in color. After wearing them, he turned to Yasmine to ask for her opinion.
But the dragoness stared at him with enchanted eyes as if she was falling in love with him all over again.

[You have acquired weapon, the Scar Knife.]
[The Scar Knife]
[Rank]: Lord
[Description]: The favorite creation in a big village of dwarves, lost upon the death of the village head.
The knife continues to survive.
One of the sharpest creations that could overlook almost all sorts of defenses and deal damage to opponents.
Damage done by this weapon takes an extremely long time to heal, and in most cases, the wounds might never heal.
Vritra pulled a knife out of his inventory, as a steel-like, simple-looking knife appeared in his hand.
It was like its entire surface was coated with silver, but holding it in his hand, Vritra could feel the deadly pressure it exuded, appearing as if it could cut anything.
"Lord rank, nice.
I was really lacking a good weapon, but should I merge it with my axes or keep it as it is...?" Vritra wondered.
"Let’s decide that upon checking the rest of the winnings.
Maybe there are more and better weapons, and we can keep it for emergencies."
Yasmine suggested, so Vritra put the knife away for now, checking the next rewards.
It felt extremely great to get so many things.
[You have acquired the passive skill Lost!]
[Lost]
[Skill Description]: It becomes increasingly difficult for people to notice you.
The less movement you make or disturb your surroundings, the more you meld in with your environment.
Normally, people wouldn’t pay attention to you if you don’t wish them to.
"Hmm, a hiding-type skill, passive one at that.
It’s awesome.
It’s even better since I can control whether I want people around me to notice me or not, just perfect."
Vritra smiled, feeling himself becoming one with the surroundings.
As he stayed still, his breathing became slower.
"Hubby, once you activated the skill, I actually almost forgot about you.
This one is powerful but, of course, might not work every time." Yasmine said, staring at his face.
"Well, this much is already great, not to mention it’s a passive skill." Vritra shrugged, reducing the effect before moving to the next.
[You have acquired 300,000 allocation points.]
"Good stuff, I am yet to add any of the allocation points.
Let’s do it at the end." Vritra mumbled before continuing.
[You have acquired the active skill Cry Baby.]
Vritra: "..."
Yasmine: "..."
"Uhm, why are the names becoming weirder again?" Vritra paused for a moment, but remembering how great Suck!
Suck!
Suck! was, he decided to give it the benefit of doubt.
[Cry Baby]
[Skill Description]: An active skill that could only be activated if you start crying genuinely like a baby.
Each tear you shed increases your strength based on your emotions.
So don’t hold back and go ahead, cry your heart out.
Prove to the world there are things more dangerous than a female’s crocodile tears — the genuine tears of the biggest cry baby.
"This piece of shit, what sort of garbage is this?
I want a refund, you thug Divine, who do you take me for?
I am not going to cry."
Vritra frowned and shouted while cursing towards the sky, and huffed upon pouring out all his frustrations.
This skill was just pure trash.
Vritra decided to ignore it; there was no point in even remembering it.
"Maybe... this just has a weird name and activation condition.
We can’t say it is trash without seeing its effects.
Hubby, go ahead and try crying, I am here to console you, you love role-playing, right?" Yasmine spoke, her lips curling up into a mischievous smile.
"Wifey, I will turn you into a cry baby the day we meet, don’t you worry." Vritra promised and ignored the newly acquired active trash skill.
[You have acquired the indestructible cloth.]
[Indestructible Cloth]
[Description]: A cloth that could take any shape you imagine and would never get dirty.
No matter the condition, it could never be destroyed.
The creator and the previous owners died, but it continued to survive.
The wearer of this cloth becomes increasingly charming, attracting attention from a big distance around it.
"Haa, this is good.
I needed clothes that won’t tear the first moment I engage in battle.
And it could work well while gathering sin points too." Vritra thought as he took out a soft piece of cloth from his inventory.
But it was quite the opposite of his Lost skill.
Vritra stood up and imagined the sort of clothes he wanted to wear, and instantly the white piece of cloth transformed.
He quickly changed into his new set of clothes, which were bluish in color.
After wearing them, he turned to Yasmine to ask for her opinion.
But the dragoness stared at him with enchanted eyes as if she was falling in love with him all over again.

chapters.title: Chapter 462: Mountain Raising Pill
paragraphs: The dragoness stared at Vritra with enchanted eyes as if she was falling in love with him all over again.
"...Wifey, is something wrong?" Vritra questioned, glancing at himself in a mirror to check if he suddenly grew a pair of horns.
"Oh, nothing, hubby. You shouldn’t be allowed to walk around like that, it’s too distracting.
Try using your Lost skill to hide your charms, or do you want women to commit suicide in hope of getting you?"
Yasmine shook her head, sighing, but found it difficult to look away from him.
Along with his natural super high charms, then his Charm Field, and now these clothes, he looked like an entity too good to exist in reality.
Yasmine doubted any woman would be able to stand his charms unless she was ’blind’, of course.
"Oh, give me a moment." Vritra nodded. Gathering sin points was fine, but always getting that level of attention was not good.
Especially since he already felt his family was full, and he didn’t wish to let any more women into his life. But who knows what plans fate had for him?
"Yeah, this is perfect." Yasmine nodded as his presence dimmed a bit. Though he still looked incredibly handsome, because of Lost, people would quickly forget about it.
Then she smiled and spoke while getting closer, "Hubby, you look very handsome, makes me want to bite you."
"Okay, I will let you do it very soon, now let’s continue with our unwrapping." Vritra said before settling on the chair, as Yasmine sat over his lap again and hugged him.
Vritra believed being close to her brought him good luck.
[You have acquired a radiation merger.]
Vritra read the name and paused again, feeling as if his doubts were really going to come true.
"It isn’t what I think it is, right?" he mumbled.
"I think it is exactly what you think it is. Maybe you actually were right, otherwise it shouldn’t be what you think it is, right?" Yasmine spoke, increasing the tension.
[Radiation Merger]
[Description]: A merger is a stone that could instantly help you merge a charged radioactive stone with any of the punching skills you possess. Chances of success: 100%.
Your skill will evolve, damage increasing greatly based on the type of radiation, and the limits of the skill will be broken.
Vritra: "I knew it!!"
Yasmine: "Hubby, you were right, someone is actually keeping watch on you at all times?"
Vritra took out the glowing silver stone from his inventory. It was around the size of a fist, and he stared at it while his thoughts surged.
This stone could only be used with one of his skills—the Charged Fist he obtained from Zihong’s inheritance.
So even though his life seemed to be flowing randomly, was it being controlled by someone? Even obtaining the Charged Fist was not a coincidence?
Was it the Divine who was behind this all along? Or someone else entirely, who even merged his fate with the Divine?

Now it felt as if from the moment he appeared on this planet, everything was planned for him—from obtaining dust manipulation to going into the Death Canopy, meeting the women he met so far, and everything being some setup.
"But if it’s not even the Divine, then who could it be?" Vritra sighed.
Thinking about such questions always made him feel insignificant, making all happiness of growing stronger disappear.
As if he was just a puppet in someone’s game, being thrown around while trying his hardest to survive.
At least whoever it was wasn’t just making his life hell without providing enough supplies.
"Let’s just keep going, that’s all we can do. We will survive and face whoever it might be," Yasmine spoke in a soothing tone, knowing his worries.
She had been through all this too before and knew how demotivating and disturbing it felt—the feeling of insignificance.
"Sigh, yes, I know." Vritra gave the stone a light squeeze, calming down his thoughts before deciding to merge Charged Fist with that stone immediately.
He took out the radioactive stone he got back in the underground space of the plague city, as he held the glowing merger in one hand and the greyish stone in another.
[Do you wish to merge the Charged Fist with the Charged Radioactive Stone?]
"Yes."
[Merging the Charged Fist with the Charged Radioactive Stone.]
Vritra waited for a few minutes, and soon the process was completed.
[Progress: 100%]
[The Charged Fist with the Charged Radioactive Stone has successfully merged.]
[You have acquired the Active skill Nuclear Fist!]
"Another great addition, I guess." He spoke before moving on to the next one. He got so many things this time from the wheel.
[You have acquired the Comprehension Guide.]
[Comprehension Guide]
[Description]: A one-time use item. Anyone who uses the guide will comprehend their field at a hundred times their normal speed for a month.
"Woah, this is great as well but not really useful for me. I think it will be a great help to Diana, her comprehension speed is already so fast, and with this, she will progress really fast."
Vritra thought as he glanced at the guide in his inventory, leaving it as it was for now.
He was happy that such objects which could help his family were also appearing. It was better to grow together, after all.
"Let’s move on..." Vritra continued excitedly.
[You have acquired Pill of Mountain!]
"Oh, sounds good, and what does it do?"
[Pill of Mountain]
[Description]: Having a problem with your ding dong? No worries, eat this pill and turn your mouse into a mountain which would never go back down ever again.
Be careful, it greatly increases the sensitivity of the consumer and is only usable by people with a ding dong, and the process is irreversible.
"What the hell!! What sort of prize is this? Again, I need a refund. Sigh, why would I need something like this?" Vritra shook his head; this wheel was definitely playing with him.
Making his mood go just like the graph of a sinusoidal wave, up and down.
But he still decided to keep it, this pill might come in handy in the future while dealing with someone.
[You have acquired the Spatial Armor.]
[Spatial Armor]
[Description]: An armor worn by the ruler of the X@#$% race. It has the ability to teleport almost all the attacks directed at it by opponents back at them.
Not even Lords could harm the armor easily, even in a very long time.
"Oh, a good one. Now I got two great armors. One for Fiona and one for Diana, just perfect." Vritra glanced at the two armors in his inventory; currently, those two were the weakest in the group.
It would be great if he could get something for his mother as well.
[You have acquired Staff of Dark Sorcerer.]
[Staff of Dark Sorcerer]
[Description]: The staff that could instantly increase the power of a dark sorcerer by at least ten times, providing various defenses and increased mana capacity.
"Hellmancer." Vritra called out as the dark sorcerer appeared before him, its presence as menacing as ever.
"This is for you, try it." Handing over the staff to the excited sorcerer, Hellmancer took the new staff and looked at it closely.
Then bowed, "Thank you, master, I will cherish your gift."

chapters.title: Chapter 463: Goop
paragraphs: "Thank you, master, I will cherish your gift." Hellmancer looked quite happy to get a new weapon, after Vritra allowed him to leave.
The dark sorcerer travelled away and instantly began to test the staff, it was just perfect for him, the previous one couldn’t even compare.
"What a bountiful draw, this staff is good." Vritra observed Hellmancer’s show of power for a few moments before turning back to the messages.
[You have acquired the Goop.]
[Goop]
[Rank]: Lord (Growth type)

[Description]: An intangible, indestructible, growable deadly weapon that supports all fields, increases the strength of the wielder greatly, provides high defence, can never be destroyed, and supports healing and concealment.
"...Isn’t this weapon too OP? Something made perfectly to match my taste? This is awesome."
Vritra took a few moments to appreciate the information, liking it the more he read.
He instantly decided to try it out, as thick black liquid appeared over his hand, stretching downward but had extremely high viscosity.
"Huh? This is the said OP weapon? This..." Vritra and Yasmine were just staring at the fluid when suddenly a message popped in front of Vritra.
[Would you like to form a bond with Goop?]
Vritra replied with a ’Yes’ without hesitation, as suddenly the black fluid seemed to go crazy, boiling over and suddenly stuck to his arm before getting sucked inside through the pores.
It completely disappeared and melded with his blood, as if becoming a part of him.
The process continued to go on for a few minutes and then...
[You have successfully bonded with Goop!]
Vritra could clearly feel the changes in his body, the new strange substance present in streams of his blood vessels, wrapped around his bones, and covering everything like an internal defence armor.
He actually didn’t feel as if this thing was out of place; it seemed just perfect.
Vritra stretched his right arm, and with a thought, a pitch-black knife appeared in his hand that instantly transformed into a sword, then hammer, and at last spear.
Still sitting over the chair with Yasmine over his lap, Vritra lightly swung the spear through the air as a sound of air being torn rang out and a big crater formed in front of them.
Destroying anything that came into contact for a few hundred meters.
"Oh, so powerful!!" he exclaimed, clearly impressed by his new weapon.
Then he imagined and Goop transformed into armor that covered his body and a demonic mask appeared over his face.
Continuing, he even tested his fields through a spear, and this weapon actually enhanced his powers, making the control better.
"Yes hubby, this thing is indeed great." Yasmine said, surprised to see such a weapon for the first time.
"But what does it mean, growth type? Can’t I already make any weapon stronger with my weapon fusion?" he questioned while continuing to test his new favourite weapon.
A pointy arm made of Goop suddenly thrusted forward, piercing through a tree over a hundred meters away.
"Yes, but all weapons have limits, like I doubt your axes could have grown to Lord rank. Even if you fused, they would have transformed into the better of the two.
But this thing is different, it will grow along with you, even without weapon fusion."
Yasmine explained, making Vritra realise how great this deadly weapon actually was.
Vritra created a thousand figures through misty essence in the sky, then he focused and instantly a thousand tentacles shot out, destroying all figures instantly.
"Damn, I love Gacha!!" Vritra called Goop back, and decided to let it consume a few good weapons later on.
"Alright next! Haa, I think I got too much this time, isn’t this like preparation right before a boss fight?"
He was now reaching close to the end of the list, but there was absolutely no regret this time, he got quite the great items.
Of course, except for a few things like Cry Baby and Raising Mountain Pill.
[You have acquired Protection of Yama.]
[Protection of Yama]
[Description]: A one-time use item, anyone equipped with this charm could evade death for the upcoming one entire year; no matter the circumstances, they wouldn’t die.
"Oh!!" Vritra was yet again surprised by the wonderful draw; obtaining an item that defied fate itself.
He almost wanted to use it immediately but held back, for the same reason as before; maybe this would be more useful for any of his women.
In the upcoming inevitable battle, Vritra would be left with endless regrets and sadness if anything happened to any of them.
"Let’s keep it for now and decide what I will do with it later." He decided.
[You have acquired the Pill of Death.]
Vritra was surprised to see that this pill even had a rank, as he began to read its description.
[Pill of Death]
[Rank]: Lord
[Description]: The pill that can make your presence as deadly as death itself.
Formed from the death of countless beings, this pill turns a person’s natural aura into one of abomination, a cataclysm. Creating terrifying effects on anyone who opposes you.
Vritra read the message then looked at the red pill silently resting in his inventory, he called it out as instantly the air became full of bloody mist.
He could already feel the strong pressure.
Wasting no time, Vritra ate the Pill of Death.
[Consumed Pill of Death!]
[Your Aura grows.]
[Your Aura grows.]
[Your Aura grows.]
As the pill mixed with his being, Vritra’s presence became deadlier by the moment, it was like he was standing over a heap of countless corpses, reaching as high as the sky itself.
The ground trembled and cracked under the pressure, the air molecules buzzing with intensity, the atmosphere of the entire small realm turning grim.
"That’s..."
Yasmine was surprised upon sensing such presence, it could almost match her own presence that she built after fighting countless battles, killing millions of opponents.
It took a few moments for Vritra to finally take control of his aura; of course, his Lost skill was a great help yet again.
"Hoo, how terrifying, I felt I can crush weaker generals with just my aura." Vritra said, shaking his head.
After seeing all the draws, he would have to go through each of them again to make sure he could properly use them in battle and not end up just forgetting them in time of need.
"Haa, I think I had enough of these. How many are still left? Didn’t I get a bit too much?" Vritra released an exaggerated sigh, suffering from success.
[You have acquired the Love Pill.]
"What’s up with sudden pills? And why the strange name?" Vritra frowned, feeling as if he was going to get yet another trash object.
Still, he decided to check it out.
[Love Pill]
[Description]: Any woman who consumes this pill would be sent into an illusory realm where she would spend ten years with you, or rather the exact illusion of you.

Both of your illusions will go through countless good and bad times over this span of time, and if by the end she falls for you, then her love would become boundless, as vast as the universe itself, madness to an unprecedented level, more passionate than anyone who ever existed. And your fates would be inseparable.
Vritra: "..."
