After seeing all the draws, he would have to go through each of them again to make sure he could properly use them in battle and not end up just forgetting them in time of need.
"Haa, I think I had enough of these.
How many are still left?
Didn’t I get a bit too much?" Vritra released an exaggerated sigh, suffering from success.
[You have acquired the Love Pill.]
"What’s up with sudden pills?
And why the strange name?" Vritra frowned, feeling as if he was going to get yet another trash object.
Still, he decided to check it out.
[Love Pill]
[Description]: Any woman who consumes this pill would be sent into an illusory realm where she would spend ten years with you, or rather the exact illusion of you.

Both of your illusions will go through countless good and bad times over this span of time, and if by the end she falls for you, then her love would become boundless, as vast as the universe itself, madness to an unprecedented level, more passionate than anyone who ever existed.
And your fates would be inseparable.
Vritra: "..."

chapters.title: Chapter 464: Eye of the End
paragraphs: [You have acquired the Love Pill.]
With a frown on his face, Vritra read the description of the pill and sighed.
It was similar to what he thought it might be but a whole lot more powerful.
Still, it wasn’t forcefully making anyone fall in love with him, so it wasn’t as bad.
"But I don’t need something like that, I already got enough women." Vritra mumbled, while Yasmine chuckled.
"Why don’t you try feeding it to a god or something, or maybe someone even above them?" she teased.
"Jokes aside, I don’t plan to use this thing. So let’s just throw it." Vritra spoke, holding the heart-shaped pill in his hand.
He tried to destroy the pill, but even his strength had no effect on it.
As his comprehension of Null increased, Vritra’s control over space and time had gotten a lot better, and he had even started to sense some sort of strange energy.
Though it would take some time to properly understand it.
Vritra opened a random portal which seemed quite chaotic inside, which might lead to some faraway space where no one could live.
Then he threw the pill into it and closed the portal, getting rid of it.
"I hope it gets destroyed in all that chaotic storm." He sighed, not even wanting to keep such an item with himself.
"Haa and there goes your chance of getting a super powerful wife." The dragoness sighed.
Rolling his eyes, Vritra decided to focus on the last few remaining messages.
[You have acquired the Magma Staff]
[Magma Staff]
[Rank]: Lord
[Description]: A staff meant for close and distant combat, highly recommended for fire-type fields.
Previously wielded by the ruler of the long-extinct Magma Asura race, it possesses too many benefits to be listed down.
"Wow, first time seeing a narcissistic weapon. Anyway, I think this would be perfect for Fiona?" he concluded.
Now the draws actually seemed to match his needs, maybe it was because of his high luck.
In any case, another good weapon.
[You have acquired the Shackled Long Sword.]
[Shackled Long Sword]

[Description]: A long sword that instantly restrains enemies to a certain extent, heavily increases the strength while diminishing other aspects of the wielder when ordered, and could launch a full-power blast dozens of times more destructive.
Vritra read and called out: "Knight."
"Yes, master." Instantly, Dark Knight appeared out of his shadow, bowing respectfully, its presence still as terrifying.
Though Dark Knight’s aura felt weaker compared to Vritra’s, it was like a 3-4-year-old child standing in front of a full-grown healthy adult.
"Take this, does it suit you?" Vritra took out a long sword from his inventory and sent it floating towards Dark Knight.
The sword was wrapped in chains and had a menacing presence. It was incredibly heavy.
Knight let his original sword disappear into its shadow and took hold of Shackled, as the sword instantly got wrapped by darkness.
Then it began to swing the heavy sword around. Each swing seemed extremely powerful. After a few seconds, Knight finally bowed.
"Thank you, master. This is perfect for me."
"Yeah yeah, enjoy. Sigh, give me at least one more good thing." Vritra sighed, seeing that only two more items were left.
"Alright, let’s see what it is now."
[You have acquired Eye of the End.]
[Eye of the End]
[Description]: An eye that could be used twice and tell if a person is going to die in a nearby time period.
Both Vritra and Yasmine were surprised as they glanced at each other, then back at the message.
This was a well-needed item. It could help greatly with all the approaching danger. But it was a pity that it could only be used two times.
’Use Eye of the End.’ Vritra instantly looked at Yasmine and tried it, but nothing happened.
"Huh? Does it not count you as alive or is it malfunctioning?" Vritra wondered and decided to check it out later on.
"I think since my physical body has been destroyed, it might not count me among the living.
If not for the help of Nihil-Anima, I wouldn’t have survived so long in this form. Of course, thanks to it all, I met you." She spoke.
She actually felt a bit happy to be in this state so she could always be with Vritra.
But the only pity was that she couldn’t touch him, embrace him properly, or feel his warmth.
"Yeah, it seems so. Anyway, I wonder what would be the final item." Vritra said, finally moving to the final message.
"I am excited to see it too, just hope it’s not something strange again." Yasmine said, laughing lightly upon remembering Vritra’s reactions each time.
"Let’s check out the final message!" he said, tightening his hug.
[You have acquired the active skill Titan Fall.]
[Titan Fall]
[Skill Description]: An end to everything, couldn’t be activated unless a certain meter has been filled.
Vritra: "... Uhm, that uh does sound good, but where is the context? What meter? What end? Sigh, anyway, that’s it for now."
"Well, we can slowly figure it out later. We have gained so many things already, and it would be better if we sort it all out." Yasmine suggested.
Nodding, Vritra looked at his status, noticing all the new entries.
"Alright, let’s start with the beginning." After a moment, he began to speak:
"First of all, I obtained200,000 Strength stat pointsand300,000 allocation points.
Two armorsthat I plan to give to Fiona and Diana andthe clothesthat I am wearing, indestructible and increasing charm.
I’ve givenone staffto Hellmancer anda longswordto Dark Knight, whileone staffis still reserved for Fiona.
There’s also alord-rank knifethat can cut through almost anything, andGoop—the perfect weapon for me.
Theradiation mergerthrough which I obtained theNuclear Fist.
Comprehension Guidekept for Diana.
Pill of Mountain, Love Pillwhich has been thrown away, I wonder why I threw it away though.
Anyway, Death PillI have eaten.Dew of Life, Protection of Yama, and Eye of the End—I have to think of how to use them.
And that’s all except for the skills." Vritra mumbled to himself, going over everything. In total, he had gotten twenty-two draws, which was quite unexpected.
Then there were the four skills: passive skill Lost, useless active skill Cry Baby, unknown active skill Titan Fall, and OP hybrid skill Atomic.
"Now I wonder if I should merge that Scar Knife with Goop or not, and just give it to Diana." Vritra pondered for a few moments and soon made up his mind.
"Let’s do it. I can give a better weapon to the goddess next time I spin the wheel, and she is safe right now anyway." Vritra thought as he pulled out the ordinary-looking knife.
He even took out his axes, which had been with him for quite long. They couldn’t be used now, so he decided to let them accompany him in new form.
[Would you like to combine Axes of Chaos and Scar Knife with Goop?]
"Yes." He replied as instantly, a black sort of armor appeared around him, and the weapons in his hands turned to particles before disappearing.
[Merging started.]

Vritra nodded in satisfaction, now it was just perfect to the very last bit.
He thought for a few moments and remembered his reward from the recent quest he had completed by clearing the Arthal plague rats.
The reward beingAurora of the Betrayed, which might give him clues about the first-ranked mythic halo.
Vritra decided to check it out later, he had spent too much time here already, and before the start of the game, he wanted to do a couple of things.
"Sigh, let’s go hubby, I want a good sleep," Yasmine spoke, disappearing after a moment.
He left the dimensional book and reappeared in the hotel, where the two women had already woken up and were waiting for him after getting ready.
’Oh, I spent more time than I intended to, but thankfully Null was quite useful,’ he thought, glancing outside at the bright sky.
"Ah, Master, you are finally done, it was almost time to start the game and I was afraid you might get late," Maeve spoke, running up to him and hugging his arm.
"The game will have to stop a little, first I need to finish something. I will tell you about it soon," Vritra said. After short talks, he teleported away.
But instead of returning to the city of charms, he appeared right above the hotel where Monk Shitless was staying.
As diligent as the monk was in committing evil, he got up early and was heading toward the arena while riding Bullo’s back.
Vritra flicked a finger and instantly, Bullo and Shitless were pulled up into the sky as they let out frightened screams.
"Stop."
Only upon seeing him did the two calm down.
"Ah P-Pitiful one, it is you. Quite the way to wish good morning." Shitless wiped the cold sweat off his forehead, still clinging to Bullo.
’I remember him warning me not long ago, saying something likeuse time properly,’ Vritra thought, aware that his words weren’t always bullshit.
"Sir Shitless..." Vritra began, and the monk already knew Vritra wanted a favor of some sort.
"Focus and tell me, who in my family is in the biggest danger. If you do, I will let you spank Onest a hundred times," Vritra promised with a solemn expression on his face.
"Really?!! Keke, that’s wonderful but... seeing that is not easy—" Shitless scratched his bald head and muttered.
"Do it or you might be the one getting those spanks from Onest," Vritra warned. This matter was too urgent.
"F-Fine, I will try my best." Shitless sighed, then closed his eyes as faint black tattoos surfaced over his head.
Vritra was surprised to see it and even felt a strange energy emanating from the monk.
’I wonder how he got this ability,’ Vritra thought, waiting.
"Yeah, he is actually quite good at it, almost like the Oracle," Yasmine spoke.
A few moments passed in silence, and finally, Shitless opened his eyes.
"Tell me, who among them all is in the gravest danger?" Vritra repeated hurriedly.
"Uhm... should you really be worrying about others? Anyway, it is her who sacrificed herself for you, someone you met a couple of minutes ago.
That’s all I found out," Shitless said with a shrug of his shoulders.
"Fine, thank you. Your rewards will be given to you soon as I promised." Vritra nodded.
The wordsacrificereminded him of the divine’s quest, which he was yet to complete.
’From Shitless’s words, it could be one among Foxie or Yennefer,’ Vritra thought. But that didn’t mean she was the only one in the gravest danger.
Although not much, this info was still useful.
Then he flew toward the city of charms to check something and also to make the deliveries of the goods he just obtained.
Vritra’s natural speed had reached a point where covering a large distance felt almost like he had just teleported.
His speed had increased by a frightening degree. In a moment, he had already arrived outside the city of charms.
"Sigh, I can feel it, something big and dangerous is coming. The war is too close," Vritra mumbled as he made his way into the city.
With his increased strength and better senses, it was as if he could almost sense the death looming over the continent.

’I wonder how he got this ability,’ Vritra thought, waiting.
"Yeah, he is actually quite good at it, almost like the Oracle," Yasmine spoke.
A few moments passed in silence, and finally, Shitless opened his eyes.
"Tell me, who among them all is in the gravest danger?" Vritra repeated hurriedly.
"Uhm... should you really be worrying about others?
Anyway, it is her who sacrificed herself for you, someone you met a couple of minutes ago.
That’s all I found out," Shitless said with a shrug of his shoulders.
"Fine, thank you.
Your rewards will be given to you soon as I promised." Vritra nodded.
The wordsacrificereminded him of the divine’s quest, which he was yet to complete.
’From Shitless’s words, it could be one among Foxie or Yennefer,’ Vritra thought.
But that didn’t mean she was the only one in the gravest danger.
Although not much, this info was still useful.
Then he flew toward the city of charms to check something and also to make the deliveries of the goods he just obtained.
Vritra’s natural speed had reached a point where covering a large distance felt almost like he had just teleported.
His speed had increased by a frightening degree.
In a moment, he had already arrived outside the city of charms.
"Sigh, I can feel it, something big and dangerous is coming.
The war is too close," Vritra mumbled as he made his way into the city.
With his increased strength and better senses, it was as if he could almost sense the death looming over the continent.

chapters.title: Chapter 466: Life
paragraphs: It was early morning, Fiona and Diana were about to get busy with their day when they heard a knock on the door.
Diana tried to sense the presence but failed, so she felt it might be the princess of the succubus race who moved around discreetly most of the time.
"I’ll open it." Fiona paused eating and went to open the door.
She was in a great mood since her strength was increasing rapidly.
If she continued like that, then it wouldn’t be long before she could reach the lord rank.
Krr...
The door opened with a faint sound, and right as Fiona was about to greet the person she believed to be the princess, she paused.
"D- Darling!!" She stared at him with wide eyes, loving the pleasant surprise.
He was wearing a black outfit that looked absolutely good on him. The redhead didn’t know why, but he seemed even more handsome now.
"Yes, it is me. Were you eating?" Taking a step forward, Vritra pulled Fiona into his arms, giving a gentle kiss on her soft red lips.
"Oh y- yes, I was eating. Isn’t it time for your game to start?" Fiona asked, snuggling into his arms, her palms feeling up his back muscles.
"Yeah, I’ll start the game a little late today. First, let’s head inside." Vritra said, patting her head. He really loved taking care of and spoiling her.
Closing the door behind him, Vritra took her hand as the two headed inside.
"D- Dear!!" Diana had exactly the same expression as Fiona. Suddenly the food seemed tasteless, and her body craved something else entirely.
"Yes, it is me." Vritra shook his head. He had only decreased the power of his Lost skill a little, and his charms were having such an effect.
If all pitiful women really were to experience this, they might really jump off their houses’ roofs just to prove their love.
Vritra took a seat in front of the two, gazing calmly at them.
Although entering the City of Charms was almost impossible for anyone without the princess’s permission, just to be sure, Vritra decided to use the Eye of the End once here.
[Used Eye of the End.]
Vritra focused on the goddess and used the special eye. A faint glow appeared in his eyes, and the space above Diana’s head became blurry.
Then a word took form.
[Life]
’Sigh, so this place will be safe. At least I can be sure of Fiona, Diana, and Mom’s safety.’ Vritra thought, relaxing a little.
"What’s wrong, dear?" Diana asked, her gaze still glued to him, while both the ladies ignored their food.
"Finish your breakfast first, then we will talk."
Vritra said, and as Fiona was about to give him the breakfast too, he interrupted, "I’m not eating. I’m full."
Fiona and Diana quickly finished the food and then put away the utensils in the kitchen before hurriedly taking seats in front of Vritra.
"You don’t have bad news for us, right?" Fiona asked, hoping that he wouldn’t leave them again for a long time.
"No, it’s nothing like that." Vritra smiled as the two heaved a sigh of relief, then he added,
"Actually, I have brought some nice gifts for the two of you."
"Gifts?" Fiona and Diana instantly got excited. Who wouldn’t like gifts, especially when they were from their husband?
"Yes, these things should be useful for you." Vritra said before taking out something from his inventory and focusing his gaze on Diana.
"Diana, this is called Armor of Zenher. This is for you." Vritra passed the armor to Diana, then took another armor.
"Fiona, this is called Spatial Armor. This is for you. Both of them are at the lord rank. They could protect you against powerful foes." Vritra said as the two happily looked at their new armors.
But there were more gifts to come.
"This is called Comprehension Guide. It can increase your speed of comprehension by 100 times for a month. This is for Diana.
This is called the Magma Staff, for Fiona." Vritra handed them all the gifts as he watched their reactions.
The ladies seemed a bit overwhelmed upon getting such wonderful gifts out of nowhere.
"Uh, Darling, you didn’t shift all this stuff from the treasury of the emperor, right?" Fiona asked, holding the staff. She was already in love with her new weapon.
"Uh... I don’t know why that is the first thing that came to your mind, but no, I got it all from the Sin Wheel."
Vritra said, feeling that maybe he should hold back from stealing in the future.
Or do it absolutely discreetly.
"Hehe, thank you, Darling. I love these gifts." Fiona giggled, running around the table and giving Vritra a kiss on the lips.
"Dear, thank you for taking care of us." Diana said, extending her hand and holding his hand gently.
’Haa, she sure has changed a lot. The goddess is nothing like her previous self.
I guess she finally matured.’ Vritra thought, missing her precious reckless self but also feeling drawn to this matured version of her.
But her kinky self was still there, just hidden behind the veil of her graceful self.
"Anyway, I’ll return tomorrow night. Mom should be coming out soon, then I’ll bring Foxie and Yennefer here." He added.
"Tell me if you need a new batch of potions. I’ll prepare them asap." Diana said. There were still a lot of raw materials left.
"I still have enough. I’ll check and see if we are missing any. But since Raelion and Ziggy are dead, I might need to get new test subjects."
He knew that the more dangerous the test subjects he brought into the arena, the more excited people became.
He chatted with the two for a bit longer before finally kissing them goodbye and heading outside.
The game would be starting a little late, but this was an important matter.
Before leaving the City of Charms, Vritra went to meet the princess.
Scanning the entire city, he sensed her presence near the entrance, so he directly teleported close to it.
"As for food, we will— oh, Vritra, you seem different." She seemed to be having an important meeting while taking a walk around the city.
Gia could sense that Vritra felt a lot different than before. Not only his appearance but his presence and strength seemed far higher.
"Hello, princess." Vritra nodded towards the princess as several sin points popped up. All five succubi were staring at him.
"Were you leaving?" Gia maintained her composure and asked.
"Yes, but I have a favor to ask of you." Vritra said as he got serious.
"Do tell me. If I can, then I will certainly do my best." Gia replied solemnly. In a sense, Vritra was their new king, and even with that, she would help him out.
"No matter what, please keep both Fiona and Diana here safely. Don’t let them go outside no matter what for now." He added.
"..." After a momentary silence, Gia nodded, aware of the dangerous atmosphere outside on the continent.
"Don’t worry, I will protect them and will keep them here." The princess promised.
"Thank you, then I’ll be taking my leave for now." Vritra disappeared from their sight in the next moment.

chapters.title: Chapter 467: Scum
paragraphs: All the succubi who were in the meeting had red faces, their minds and imaginations going on the wrong route.
’Sigh, I hope he stays safe.’
Gia had never seen a man like him; no wonder all the women in the city fell for him after seeing him once.
"Stop dawdling, he is already gone." Gia’s shout brought them out of their stupor.
Vritra quickly arrived in the cloud city.
The Ghazi Curry was as empty as before.
He directly flew towards the arena, finally planning to start the game.
The audience must already be going crazy.
’I need to earn lots of sin points again.’
Vritra thought, but before reaching the arena, he paused over a market.
Although the whole place was still covered by mist, because of the game, the population of the cloud city had increased greatly.
The market was bustling with crowds, and everyone was busy with their work.
In the street, several men and women were about to beat up a girl who seemed no older than five years.
She lay on the road, her clothes dirty and old, and it seemed she had tried to steal money but got caught.
"I can’t believe the streets of the cloud city are getting dirty with such trash.
These slum rats only know how to steal." One of the men spoke as he pushed the girl back.
"Tsk, why would you have children if you can’t even take care of them?
Turning them into disgusting thieves, dirtying the city’s environment." A woman added, her face covered with arrogance.
"It’s not about money; she only stole a copper coin, but if she doesn’t learn a lesson today, then she’ll get used to it. In her parents’ place, we have to teach her. Let’s give her a small beating."
The shop owner who caught her said righteously.
But seeing the crowd that was about to beat her up, it was evident she would be beaten to death.
’Sigh, these wannabe good guys.
Teach your kids at home if you are so concerned.’ Vritra shook his head and landed behind the crowd.
His appearance had already changed.
Then he pushed through them forcefully, and the ones getting pushed suddenly became angry before fearfully moving away upon getting a glance of Vritra.
"How much did she steal from you?" He questioned, looking directly at the shop owner.
"Uh... S-She stole one— cough, ten copper coins." The man with a fat belly spoke. He was getting bored, so he blew up the whole thing.
In her hurry, she had just forgotten to pay for the fake lucky ring he was selling.
"Here, take this silver coin and get lost." Vritra spoke, throwing a silver coin at his feet, wishing to end the matter fast so he could go start the game.
"Ah!" The man hurriedly picked up the coin and stuffed it into his pocket, gloating internally.
Vritra helped the girl stand, then dusted off her clothes. There was only one light bruise on her knee.
Then, clearing his throat, he added in a rather arrogant tone, "Like I said, this was not about money, but since you paid for her, I’ll let this one slide as long as she apologizes."
"Sigh..." Vritra sighed, scratching his head. Then he looked to the side where the makeshift stall was present.
It was filled with rings, paper charms, and other such fake ritual materials.
"Did you take permission to sell your stuff here? You’re out here scamming people, shouldn’t you be arrested?" Vritra added.
"W-Who the hell are you? Are you related to this girl? Ha! What a family of thieves, trying to blame me now?"
For a moment, he got scared, seeing Vritra’s physique, but seeing the crowd, he regained confidence.
The crowd seemed to be taking his side after all.
"Is that so?" Vritra nodded, then took out his Golden Moon emblem, instantly scaring the shopkeeper and shocking the crowd.
"For illegally operating your business here in the street and scamming innocent citizens, I’ll be detaining your stall and money."
After saying that, Vritra glanced at the stall, and in the next moment, it flew up into the sky, and the mist cleared up in the surrounding area.
Then it exploded in a beautiful firework.
"Noooooo, my precious!!" The shopkeeper screamed, but he felt something wriggle in his pocket, and then the storage glyph flew out.
"Guards, throw him in prison and take away this crowd for questioning."
Vritra ordered, calling the guards who were suddenly teleported there from a mile away.
"H-Huh? How am I here? Oh, Golden Moon! Yes, sir, I’ll do that." The guards instantly detained the shopkeeper and took the crowd away.
"Are you alright?" Vritra touched the little girl’s arm as her body healed instantly.
"Y-Y-Yes..." The girl was still shaken, trembling in fear.
"Sigh, where are your parents? Can you return to your home?" He asked, patting her head, and the girl calmed down a bit as she wiped her tears.
"Yes." She replied, tightly clutching the hem of her clothes.
"M-My father went to buy some medicines f-for my mother. She is really sick." She finally said.
"What’s your name?" Vritra asked.
"I am A-Amy." She replied.
"So you bought this ring for your mother? Tell me, where is your house? I’ll take you back." Vritra took her hand and spoke.
After slight hesitation, she finally started pointing towards her house as the two began walking.
While chatting, the two arrived at her house within a few minutes. It was a small house in the slums.
Vritra had already noticed General Sirius, who had been following them secretly.
"She is my mother..." Amy spoke upon entering the house, pointing towards a sickly middle-aged woman lying on the bed.
’She looks pretty sick, but I think I can heal her.’ Vritra thought as he approached the bed and used his skill.
The diseases and injuries in her body quickly healed, and within mere moments, her condition became better than ever.
"Here, take some money. This will help you." Vritra took out a paper bag, putting it over the table.
It was filled with a few hundred gold coins. With this, the family would be able to live comfortably.
"T-Thank you." Not aware of how much Vritra had helped her, the girl bowed but remembered something after a moment.
"W-Would you like to eat something?" Though this was what her parents taught her, there was barely anything to eat in the house.
"No, your mother will be fine." Vritra said, turning around and moving out of the house.
He wasn’t worried that they would be robbed since General Sirius would take care of everything.
’What a good guy, but this might just make more trouble for them.’ He smiled and decided to help the family.
A few minutes later, Vritra arrived in the arena, and finally, the game started.
The number of sin points once again began to rise quickly.
Onest had arranged more test subjects, but the public missed the two main ones, Piggy and Raelion.
Some time passed. Vritra was just wondering who he should target next when he saw a special guest walk into the arena.
"Oh, why is he here?" Vritra wondered and decided to call for a break as he went to meet the new guest.

chapters.title: Chapter 468: Uncle
paragraphs: [D-Day 1]
After announcing the break, Vritra glanced at the unexpected guest, but before that, he gestured towards Yennefer and Maeve to come closer, who were both in disguise.
The two women landed in front of him from the midst of the crowd and waited for him to speak.
[Eye of the End Activated.]
Vritra looked at Yennefer as a faint glow appeared in his eyes, and then a single word appeared over her head.
[Death!]
"..." Vritra felt his heart clench upon seeing that. Just as he had expected, the decisive battle wasn’t too far.
And Yennefer was certain to die in this battle.
’Fuck fuck...’ Vritra cursed, staring constantly at the single word even as the letters faded away. Just the thought of losing her forever filled him with intense emotions.
No matter what, he wouldn’t let her die.
He then glanced at Maeve. Unfortunately, the two chances of the Eye of the End were over.
He couldn’t check if she too was in danger.
’She too could be in danger, and trying to keep them away might not be the optimal solution.’ After all, who is to say that they won’t be in even more danger because he sent them away?
So any decision he makes might not reduce the danger.
"Is something wrong, husband?" Yennefer tilted her head, looking at him quizzically.
After thinking for a few long moments, he came to a conclusion.
"Show me your hand." He walked closer to her, as the confused Yennefer extended her right arm.
Vritra got a hold of her slender arm, feeling her soft, warm skin.
Then he took out a paper slip that had strange patterns drawn over it and pressed it against the back of her hand.
Suddenly a message popped in front of Yennefer.
[Used the Protection of Yama.]
"What... is this?" She only got more confused, staring at her arm then at Vritra.
The group of three was surrounded by a barrier that hid them from the public, so they returned to their original appearance.
"It’s just something I got recently, it will protect you." Vritra said, then he looked at Maeve and said, "Foxie, say ahh."
Being as obedient as ever, Maeve opened her mouth and let out a cute "ahh."
Vritra flicked his finger as a green drop flew and landed directly in the back of her mouth.
GULP
[Used Dew of Life.]
"Master, what was that?" Maeve couldn’t figure out anything from its energy, nor did it make any sort of changes in her body.
"You two must be feeling it too by now, the atmosphere inside the continent is getting abnormal. I am sure the big battle will be starting very soon." Vritra said.
He first turned to Yennefer, cupping her cheeks he spoke,
"No matter what, you must put your own safety on top. Even if you find me in danger, don’t do anything.
Uh... just know that it will just be a part of my plan." After a pause he asked, "You understand, right, Yenni?"
"Oh Uhm Y- Yes, I will." Yennefer was just surprised to hear him call her with that name again, so she replied absentmindedly.
"Foxie, you too, shouldn’t ruin my plan, you both understand, right?" He looked at them both, but knew the chances of them actually following it were slim.
"...Yes." They both nodded after a moment.
"Alright, that’s all I wanted to say. I will be going to meet him now." Vritra said, pointing towards the familiar boy in the crowd.
Nodding, the two women left as their appearance changed once again.
{Sin Point Gained: Watched 423,745}
{Sin Point Gained: Urged 421,013}
’Haa this is bliss, just a few more days and I will be able to spin the wheel again with even more keys.’ Vritra thought. Removing the barrier, he moved towards the crowd.
"Hello, it’s been a while, Rich." Vritra spoke, looking at the guy who was trying to hide his real appearance.
"Ah, how did you- cough I- I am not Rich, you got the wrong person. But do I know you?" Rich was surprised that his disguise was blown so easily.
"Well, let’s talk separately, shall we?" Vritra said, gesturing towards the center of the arena.
"Sigh, fine." Nodding, Rich gave up on pretending and followed Vritra.
After moving to the center, Vritra once again formed a barrier and took two chairs from his inventory, taking one and gesturing for Rich to sit on the other.
"Hmm, I never forget anything, but I can’t seem to remember ever meeting you. Are you sure we met before?" Rich asked, thinking long and hard.
"It is me, Jin Woo, can’t you recognize me? We even met in the prison." Vritra said, turning his appearance to a sickly young master.
"Huh? Weren’t you killed by the Empress—Yennefer?" Rich asked, so shocked that he fell down from his chair.
"Haa, she isn’t as heartless as you all think, she let me go after acting like she had killed me." Vritra said, releasing a sigh of relief.
"That’s... hard to imagine, but it’s good to know you are still alive.
I heard about this game so I just came here to clear my mind a little, damn my sister." Rich looked quite frustrated.
"The competitions that were happening all over the kingdoms were for your sister, huh. Your family is pretty impressive, do you have any relation with the emperor?"
Vritra questioned, hoping to get some info about the current situation while slowly moving the subject.
"Yeah, that was for my sister. So you are still going to participate in it, right? And yes, I am related to Emperor Darius. He is um, my uncle. More precisely, my father’s brother."
Rich answered, no longer hiding his identity.
"Your uncle?!! So you two are from the same family?" He continued to ask.
"No, the emperor had left our family a long time ago. Well, it’s complicated, but we are from different families, though our families are quite close still." Rich added.
"Oh, I see. I didn’t expect you to have such connections. Anyway, what has been going on in the continent? The air suddenly feels dangerous." Vritra asked casually.
"That... I think you should leave this place as soon as possible.
A big fight might break out soon. Even I came here for only a couple of hours." Rich said, not adding anything of value.
Vritra tried to ask in different ways but couldn’t get any useful information, so he finally decided to end the conversation.
"Well, it was a pleasure meeting you again, but don’t tell anyone that this is me." Vritra shook hands with Rich as the two bid farewell.
Of course, Rich was planning to watch the entertaining game for a while longer as he took his seat.
Vritra stood in the middle of the arena, various thoughts going through his mind.
’But why hasn’t Ziggy’s father attacked the emperor? Did he really not care about his son?’
Vritra thought as he announced the continuation of the game, waves of sin points pouring in again.
But for now, he just focused on the game, noticing that all the people were missing some big fish, as all these people were no longer enough to get them excited.

chapters.title: Chapter 469: Haunting Reality
paragraphs: The day passed just like usual, but the odd feeling in Vritra’s heart became more evident.
And running away or hiding wasn’t an option, he planned to target a lord-ranked demon or human next, to increase his strength further.
As the game ended, Vritra and the two women headed back towards their hotel. Shitless, Onest and others also left.
Flying back, Vritra glanced towards Yennefer. The word Death kept flashing before his eyes, but with the protection of Yama she should be able to survive an extra year.
Though that didn’t mean the danger for her had diminished. Then there was Maeve too, and Yasmine... even his increased strength felt inadequate.
Thankfully, Fiona, Diana and Vanessa were safe currently.
They bought some food on their way back and ate dinner together after reaching the hotel.
"Master, did you find anything else?" Maeve asked while munching over a piece of meat.
"No, Rich was just as clueless. Should we... just hide for a while?" Vritra asked, though that would just mean postponing the danger for a while.
"Do not worry, husband, we will fight whatever lay ahead of us together," Yennefer said while giving his hand a light comforting squeeze.
They continued to eat in silence for a while longer.
As Vritra was preparing for the battle ahead, it was evident that the others must be going at it, maybe even harder.

There were too many participants in this battle — Grieves, Bone Blood Cult, the human emperor, dragon emperor, phoenix emperors, the Golden Moon with their strong six seats, Nine Pacts, demons, and who knows what else.
Not choosing a side had the downside of ending up facing both sides, yet Vritra couldn’t just join any of them.
Red and many others wanted him to join them while most just wished to erase his existence.
"Master, don’t think too much about it, relax for now. We will plan it out together," Maeve said, smiling sweetly at him.
Soon the three finished eating.
After a short walk around the hotel, they returned to their bed.
The two snuggled in his arms, tightly clinging to him. Maeve lay on his left while Yennefer on his right, the three talking about random stuff.
"Husband, tomorrow morning I will go and try getting more info from the six seats. They are definitely onto something big," Yennefer said, looking at his charming face up close.
"I will come with you too. There are some demons hidden in the Golden Moon, I will try to get in contact with them," Maeve said. The two hoped to lessen some of his burden.
Just as he wanted to protect them, they wanted to do the same.
"Okay, but be careful, and return if things seem strange," Vritra said, trying to appear relaxed.
Turning his head, he softly kissed Maeve, pressing his lips against hers, then gave Yennefer a kiss.
"Good night, let’s do our best tomorrow as well."
Turning the lights off, the three soon drifted off to sleep, pressed together tightly under the sheets.
[D-Day 0]
As the dawn broke, Vritra woke up to welcome yet another peaceful day, finding his two women hugging him in their sleep.
Not wanting to disturb them, Vritra directly teleported out of the bed, but it still ended up waking them.
"Haa... Good morning, master..." Maeve rubbed her sleepy eyes and sat up groggily.
Yennefer too sat up, not appearing as dishevelled as the demoness.
Then the three took a bath together and ended up spending a little more time in there than they expected.
Then Yennefer prepared some breakfast and together, they ate while discussing their plans for the day.
After eating, their day finally started as Vritra got ready to follow the same routine, planning to head to the arena.
"Alright, we will be heading out to get some helpful information." Maeve and Yennefer kissed him and then flew away, wishing to be helpful to him.
"..." Vritra stared at their disappearing figures in silence, then he ordered,
"Knight, protect them in case anything goes wrong."
Just as he ordered, a shadow flew from under his feet, disappearing into the distance.
Although Dark Knight’s strength was still a little lower than theirs, a lord with no sense of fear of death would certainly be useful.
’Sigh... and yet again I forgot to check out that Aurora of the Betrayed. I will definitely do it today and see if I can get any useful information about the 1st mythic halo.’
Vritra thought as he too left the hotel, flying through the mist and approaching the arena.
"The air feels... even different today," Yasmine said, her voice tinged with worry.
’Yeah, but I will no longer be as helpless as before. If they do attack me now, I am sure I can escape, and I will make sure their losses will be extremely high.’
Vritra replied, unconsciously letting out faint traces of his aura that suddenly made the mist a few kilometres around him disappear.
"Let’s head to the Dragon Kingdom tonight. With your current strength, I think we can reach my mother’s room where I will be able to get my body back.

Then I will get my rightful position back as the empress. And not even the Golden Moon would attack us recklessly," Yasmine said, but she was happier about the fact that she would finally and properly meet her husband.
It wasn’t long before Vritra finally arrived close to the arena, but just as he landed outside the door...
{Sin Point Gained: Watched +3}
He paused and glanced to the side, a little surprised to see the family of three whom he had helped the previous day.
Amy, along with her parents, was standing there with a big smile.
{Sin Point Gained: Thanked +3}
"Thank you, sir. I don’t even know how I can ever repay you for what you have done for us."
The man almost knelt but was stopped by Vritra as he began crying and thanking him.
"It’s alright, just make sure to properly pamper this little princess." He patted Amy’s head as the three kept thanking him.
"C-Can I watch the game too?" Amy spoke after a couple of minutes of constant thanking.
"Sure, come with me. I will help you get the best seats inside," Vritra said, gesturing at the three to follow.
"Uh... I-It’s alright, sir, you must be busy with your work, and this is some food she cooked for you." The middle-aged man handed Vritra a lunch box.
"Thank you, I will eat it later. And come inside, it will be fine."
Finally, the parents gave in, and Amy happily held Vritra’s hand as the three headed inside. Still, her father and mother kept thanking him.
"Sob... I was sure I was going to die, I-I can’t thank you enough, sir, you saved our entire family, sob..."
As Vritra entered the arena, he yet again saw the whole place crowded with people; there should be at least 500,000.
But inside the arena, something felt really off. Vritra frowned as he told Amy to stand with her parents and looked around.
Shitless, Onest, Xie or any other demons weren’t there, and then Vritra noticed a haunting detail, even as the crowd of hundreds of thousands kept roaring.
{Sin Point Gained: Watched +3}
’Why... just 3?’

chapters.title: Chapter 470: Doom
paragraphs: The whole place buzzed with the cheers of the crowd, as hundreds of thousands of people urged Vritra to start the game.
But strangely, Vritra no longer received the notification from all the crowd. He stood stunned at the entrance, staring at the single notification.
{Sin Point Gained: Watched +3}
’Why... just 3?’
"Is something wrong, big brother?" Amy blinked her big eyes and questioned, pulling his finger.
"It’s... nothing." Vritra said, again acting casual as he walked inside.
’So it has already started, this is a bit earlier than I expected.’ Vritra was just thinking when suddenly a figure in red clothes flashed in the air, letting out a loud laugh.

"Hahahahaha... haa, so we meet again, Vritra. Stop pretending, I know you have already noticed it by now, as expected of someone I have chosen." Red spoke, and for some reason he had covered his skinless body completely, even wearing a mask.
Maybe Vritra’s insult hit him hard the previous time.
"Sigh, so how did you find me?" Vritra removed his disguise as he appeared in his real form, wearing a black outfit.
The three people standing beside him were rather surprised by the sudden changes, they stood there, trembling.

"No matter how good you might be at hiding, there are always ways to find you. Now enough with this, I will forget about all your previous offences, so just join the Bone Blood Cult and together we wil-" Red was interrupted by Vritra before he could finish.

"Hah, and here is the guy who can’t understand the meaning of the word no. There is no way you can force me to join you. And where did you put all these people?" Vritra looked to the side, at the illusion of people that was still in place.
But rather than a mere illusion, it was more like puppets, being controlled by someone.

"This was all done by the human emperor. Anyway, aren’t you worried about your women? I am surprised you let them go despite being aware of the danger." Red continued, his gaze moving between the four of them.
"You don’t have to worry about that, they are quite capable. Anyway, did you come alone?" Vritra asked, before turning to the three and telling them to leave the place.

"Of course not, I am the first to arrive here, so if you agree maybe I will still be able to take you away from here. And no one is leaving this place." Red suddenly pointed his finger towards the three.
[Null Activated]
"No-" Vritra instantly used Null to freeze Red, stopping him before he could launch his attack, but then a heart-wrenching scream rang out.
BOOM
"Aaaaaaaaah, honeyyyyy..." the woman screamed in terror as her husband’s body suddenly exploded, the blood and flesh raining down on all of them.
Vritra was sure that Red was yet to attack and no one else had attacked; it was as if their bodies had already been altered.
"Ughhhh, cough, s-save her, pleas-"
BOOM
In the next instant, the mother’s body swelled up and exploded, leaving behind her words full of pain and desperation.
The scared girl curled up in a pool of blood, crying and shivering.
"!!!" Vritra had no way of stopping that sort of attack, he hurriedly used Null and Forbidden on Amy, the shock filling his mind.
Yet, in the next moment, Amy met the same fate as her parents. Nothing Vritra did worked, as her body slowly swelled up and then exploded.
"..." Red finally managed to break free of the restraints, as he took a step forward and watched the mess created by the death of the family of three.
The real battle was yet to start, but the mind battle had already begun, and with this, Vritra was already losing.

’It is your greatest weakness that you still have kindness in you, that there are people you wish to protect. Otherwise, it would have been really impossible to catch you.’ Red let out a faint chuckle; this was all a setup to put mental pressure on Vritra.
There was just no way to stop their deaths since the three were just the copies of the bandaged man. It was all just a setup.
Vritra had his fists clenched as he glared at Red, the guilt of not being able to save them creeping into his heart.
And violent emotions began to take shape inside him, as the meter of a certain skill began to fill up quickly.
"Haha, but it’s too early to regret anything. See for yourself." Red pointed to the side as a screen appeared over a wall, displaying two figures flying rapidly.
It was Maeve and Yennefer, both rushing to get some information from the Golden Moon.
But all of a sudden several figures appeared in front of them; there were the four emperors and even the six seats.
Vritra made no move and observed it silently. It was obvious that the two women alone wouldn’t be able to fight all those lords.
"Did you change your mind yet?" Red questioned. If Vritra could truly join the Bone Blood Cult, then he was sure that very soon, not a single entity on the planet would be able to threaten them.
’His strength has grown to this extent after our last meeting?!! How is he already at the Lord rank? No matter what, I have to make him join the Bone Blood Cult.’ Red thought, firm in his decision.
Vritra could already sense the army of hundreds of thousands, or even reaching a million, that had already surrounded the arena.
But none of them were making a move yet, as if waiting for some cue.
"Yennefer, I finally found you." Darius spoke, as the group of eleven men surrounded the two women.
Han Gratt was there too.
"I will forget what happened before, so come with me, marry me, and I will protect you from all this." He added, extending a hand towards her.
"How delusional, there has never been anything between us, and there never will be. Why are you all here?" she questioned, gazing at all of them, though she was well aware of the reason.
"There is no need to pretend, we already know you have connections with demons like Vritra Arclis and Maeve." While speaking, he glanced at the other woman.
Yawnn.
While yawning, the dragon emperor, Dago, spoke: "Hey, get this over with quickly, we have to deal with that divine guy too."
"Yennefer, they must have mind-washed you, you didn’t know that they are demons, right? The very beings you hate the most in this world." Vin, one of the twins from Golden Moon, spoke.
"Yeah, you can take back your position as the empress, your family needs you. Don’t forget how these despicable demons murdered your loved ones." Tin added from behind.

"Little girl, hurry up and decide, we don’t have all day, and I have to go back and watch over my little pumpkin’s wedding." The old man called Giant spoke, his body looking as thin and frail as ever.
Giant was Rich’s great-grandfather and the emperor’s grandfather, belonging to the powerful Ford family.
"...Yennefer." Han called out in a low voice, wishing she would choose the right side; he could never let her get hurt.
"Sigh, fine, you are on your own, Maeve." Yennefer nodded and joined the group, standing between the eleven.

sentences.text: The whole place buzzed with the cheers of the crowd, as hundreds of thousands of people urged Vritra to start the game.
But strangely, Vritra no longer received the notification from all the crowd.
He stood stunned at the entrance, staring at the single notification.
{Sin Point Gained: Watched +3}
’Why... just 3?’
"Is something wrong, big brother?" Amy blinked her big eyes and questioned, pulling his finger.
"It’s... nothing." Vritra said, again acting casual as he walked inside.
’So it has already started, this is a bit earlier than I expected.’ Vritra was just thinking when suddenly a figure in red clothes flashed in the air, letting out a loud laugh.
"Hahahahaha... haa, so we meet again, Vritra.
Stop pretending, I know you have already noticed it by now, as expected of someone I have chosen." Red spoke, and for some reason he had covered his skinless body completely, even wearing a mask.
Maybe Vritra’s insult hit him hard the previous time.
"Sigh, so how did you find me?" Vritra removed his disguise as he appeared in his real form, wearing a black outfit.
The three people standing beside him were rather surprised by the sudden changes, they stood there, trembling.
"No matter how good you might be at hiding, there are always ways to find you.
Now enough with this, I will forget about all your previous offences, so just join the Bone Blood Cult and together we wil-" Red was interrupted by Vritra before he could finish.
"Hah, and here is the guy who can’t understand the meaning of the word no.
There is no way you can force me to join you.
And where did you put all these people?" Vritra looked to the side, at the illusion of people that was still in place.
But rather than a mere illusion, it was more like puppets, being controlled by someone.
"This was all done by the human emperor.
Anyway, aren’t you worried about your women?
I am surprised you let them go despite being aware of the danger." Red continued, his gaze moving between the four of them.
"You don’t have to worry about that, they are quite capable.
Anyway, did you come alone?" Vritra asked, before turning to the three and telling them to leave the place.
"Of course not, I am the first to arrive here, so if you agree maybe I will still be able to take you away from here.
And no one is leaving this place." Red suddenly pointed his finger towards the three.
[Null Activated]
"No-" Vritra instantly used Null to freeze Red, stopping him before he could launch his attack, but then a heart-wrenching scream rang out.
BOOM
"Aaaaaaaaah, honeyyyyy..." the woman screamed in terror as her husband’s body suddenly exploded, the blood and flesh raining down on all of them.
Vritra was sure that Red was yet to attack and no one else had attacked; it was as if their bodies had already been altered.
"Ughhhh, cough, s-save her, pleas-"
BOOM
In the next instant, the mother’s body swelled up and exploded, leaving behind her words full of pain and desperation.
The scared girl curled up in a pool of blood, crying and shivering.
"!!!" Vritra had no way of stopping that sort of attack, he hurriedly used Null and Forbidden on Amy, the shock filling his mind.
Yet, in the next moment, Amy met the same fate as her parents.
Nothing Vritra did worked, as her body slowly swelled up and then exploded.
"..." Red finally managed to break free of the restraints, as he took a step forward and watched the mess created by the death of the family of three.
The real battle was yet to start, but the mind battle had already begun, and with this, Vritra was already losing.
’It is your greatest weakness that you still have kindness in you, that there are people you wish to protect.
Otherwise, it would have been really impossible to catch you.’ Red let out a faint chuckle; this was all a setup to put mental pressure on Vritra.
There was just no way to stop their deaths since the three were just the copies of the bandaged man.
It was all just a setup.
Vritra had his fists clenched as he glared at Red, the guilt of not being able to save them creeping into his heart.
And violent emotions began to take shape inside him, as the meter of a certain skill began to fill up quickly.
"Haha, but it’s too early to regret anything.
See for yourself." Red pointed to the side as a screen appeared over a wall, displaying two figures flying rapidly.
It was Maeve and Yennefer, both rushing to get some information from the Golden Moon.
But all of a sudden several figures appeared in front of them; there were the four emperors and even the six seats.
Vritra made no move and observed it silently.
It was obvious that the two women alone wouldn’t be able to fight all those lords.
"Did you change your mind yet?" Red questioned.
If Vritra could truly join the Bone Blood Cult, then he was sure that very soon, not a single entity on the planet would be able to threaten them.
’His strength has grown to this extent after our last meeting?!!
How is he already at the Lord rank?
No matter what, I have to make him join the Bone Blood Cult.’ Red thought, firm in his decision.
Vritra could already sense the army of hundreds of thousands, or even reaching a million, that had already surrounded the arena.
But none of them were making a move yet, as if waiting for some cue.

chapters.title: Chapter 471: Monstrosity
paragraphs: "Wha-" Maeve stared at Yennefer dumbfounded, her expression making the betrayal more evident.
"When master finds out-!!" the demoness shouted in a loud voice, but Yennefer cut her off in the middle.
"He won’t find out. And I still hate the demons just as much, just not him." Yennefer spoke, her expression turning cold and emotionless.
"Good choice, it wouldn’t feel good to attack a friend." The big guy with a height over three meters spoke.
Killing a lord is not an easy task. If they made even a slight mistake and somehow the lord managed to escape, then they could never stay relaxed.
"Let’s get this over with, kill this fox demon." Pink, still wearing pink-colored lingerie, said, pointing a finger towards Maeve.
The two women were already in their original forms.
"Wait, something... is not right." Oracle suddenly stopped them, his brows furrowing.
"Oh, how surprising, you caught up fast." Suddenly, a heavy twisted male voice came out of Yennefer’s mouth.
And then her body transformed. Within moments, the person who stood among the eleven men was Raelion.
"Raelion? This rat, how is he still alive and perfectly fine?" Han shouted in shock.
"Did you join hands with Vritra?" Darius questioned, getting ready to battle the siblings, Maeve and Raelion.
"No, we are not even real." Then the same thing happened with Maeve, as exactly the same voice came from her throat.
And then her body twisted and transformed into Ziggy, the fat pig demon.
"What’s going on?" The big guy looked at Oracle and questioned, the group completely confused.
"I-" but the transformation was not yet over, as the two bodies twisted unnaturally and appeared in the pitiful state they were in after their deaths.
"Don’t worry, we both are already dead." The two spoke at the same time and then...
CORPSE EXPLOSION
"RUNNN-" Oracle flashed away at extreme speed using his light field, his speed unmatched by anyone.
BOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOM!!
The bodies of the lord and Piggy exploded at the same time, engulfing the ten men before they could react.
The explosion was extremely big, as the body of a lord was used to generate all the destructive energy.
"COUGH COUGH How unexpected, so they weren’t as clueless about this attack." Sir Giant coughed out smoke, shaking his head in disappointment.
"Tsk My hair got burned! Damnit!" Vin and Tin both came out of the explosion with slight injuries, but their heads were completely bald.
Though the injuries disappeared within a few moments.
Despite the deadly explosion that might have brought a general rank easily to death’s door, the group survived without any effort.
"Haa I wished to take things easy, but we are now left with no other choice." Sir Giant also flew out of the flames, not even his clothes were damaged.
The eleven men reunited, and the focus was on Oracle.
"Sir Pink, uh, your lingerie, it caught fire on the front." Oracle gestured with his eyes, as everyone’s gaze moved down towards Pink’s crotch.
"Mmm Don’t mind it, I love it a little painful. Tell us what you plan on next?" Pink said, making no effort to put out the fire.
"Cough Anyway, there is no plan next. Kill Vritra and anyone who gets in the way. He should already be trapped." Finally, they disappeared, heading back towards the arena.
"Oh, all of us had been keeping watch over you, though indirectly, so how did you find out? I am sure you even sent that shadow to protect them."
Red questioned, even more surprised at Vritra’s ability and thinking.
"There are always ways to find that, no matter how good at hiding you all are."
Vritra replied with a shrug, then he looked back at the bloody scene, sighing to himself.
He knew this was Red’s plan too somehow, but didn’t know if those three were actually real or not.
’Sigh, it is finally time...’ Vritra sensed the large crowd of people from different races surrounding the arena.
The people sitting inside the arena suddenly quieted down, then their bodies floated and aligned as if in a certain formation.
"They were already prepared, not only are they making escaping impossible for us but even reducing our strength by at least 40%." Yasmine spoke.
Soon countless figures became visible around the arena as the mist completely disappeared.
There were the six seats: Oracle, Tin, Vin, Sir Giant, Pink, and Big Guy.

Dago, Darius, and the two Phoenix emperors. Kryn, the leader of the Grieves; Red, the leader of the Bone Blood Cult; the leader of Nine Pacts, several demon lords, and many others who held high power, each along with their enormous army.
None of them were holding back.
Some had plans to recruit Vritra, like the Grieves, Nine Pacts, and Bone Blood Cult if possible, or stop others from having him.
So their collective goal could be considered to kill him.
The armies of humans, dragons, demons, phoenixes, and Grieves stretched far and wide, their number reaching in millions.
All the people had already been evacuated from there, the people had been shifted as far away from that place as possible, with most being outside the continent.
This war seemed to be at an even higher level than when the gods fought, all of this for just a single person.
"Where is she? Where is Yennefer?!!" Darius let out a frightening aura, pressing down on Vritra and the armies around, as if a sharp sword was pressed against their throats.
Oracle snapped his fingers, as all the puppets paused in their places and the formation finally started—the one they had spent so much time and resources creating.
Instantly decreasing Vritra’s strength by more than 40%.
’I... have a feeling that I might not survive this battle, so let’s just go all out.’ Vritra closed his eyes for a few moments, tilting his head up as he felt the cool air breezing against his skin.
There was pin-drop silence. Even though they greatly underestimated Vritra, none still made a move. Vritra pushed Lost Power to the minimal and then...
[Switch Activated.]
[Switch: Demonification (100%)]
A deadly aura spread hundreds of miles with Vritra being the center.
Most of the people in the army were crushed down to their knees.
His natural aura merged with the Death Pill he had eaten, his presence fighting against the auras of all the enemies combined.
It was as if several powerful lords were standing there, hurled together.
Two horns appeared over his head, his body covered with purplish energy. His red cloth fluttered around his body, slowly changing form.
[Atomic Activated.]
Even the air could no longer touch him, staying at least a centimeter from his skin, atoms moving at extreme speed.
[Dust Manipulation Activated.]
A black symbiotic-type fluid appeared over his clothes before stretching towards his arms as two extremely sharp swords appeared in his hands.
Then Goop was further covered by the dust that churned over the blades, making them deadlier.
A storm of dust suddenly engulfed the entire Cloud City, within moments bringing all houses and buildings to rubble.
Then several monsters took form around Vritra: Dark Knight, Hellmancer, Psyche, Bob, and Bobby.
[Nether Eye Activated.]
A third eye opened over Vritra’s forehead as he took a step forward, the land cracking under his feet. The armies were already shivering, wondering what sort of monstrosity they were about to fight.
And this was after he had already lost 40% of his strength.
[Demonic Dragon God’s Transformation Activated.]

chapters.title: Chapter 472: The War-1
paragraphs: [Demonic Dragon God’s Transformation Activated.]
A terrifying flame burst out around Vritra’s body, purple scales covering him as the size of his body increased, yet he maintained his human-like figure.
The horns grew with purple flames burning over them; he appeared completely different from before.
A mixture of both demon and dragon—a figure never seen before.
His height was well over ten feet, the deadly black swords growing in size, appearing just as monstrous.
Even the Oracle, who calculated all sorts of possibilities, was quite surprised; even after a 40% deduction, his strength reached that level.
"Kill him now at all costs! We can’t let Vritra—this demon—grow any further. No matter the casualties, he must be terminated today!"
Oracle shouted in a loud voice, his body engulfed by bright light.
BOOM
Suddenly there was a loud explosion, then a chain reaction followed...
BOOM BOOM BOOM BOOM
Within moments, all the supposedly indestructible puppets exploded. The big circle that was present under the ground and high up in the sky flickered before disappearing.
"What’s happening?"
Just before the two sides could collide, the restrictions were removed, as an even more terrifying demonic presence spread across the city.
The purple flames destroyed anything nearby.
"Thank you, Foxie and... Yenni." Vritra called, looking to the side, his voice tough and loud.
Then the two women appeared from amidst the broken puppets before landing beside Vritra.
Yennefer was well aware of this sort of formation and knew how to destroy it, so that was their first priority.
"WHAT HAVE YOU DONE?!!" Darius clenched his fists, glaring at Yennefer.
"Just helping out my husband. Oh, by the way, if you haven’t already noticed, I have switched sides."
As Yennefer spoke, the ground and air began to tremble, appearing as if a big calamity was about to appear.
Vritra just thought that he was yet to see both Maeve and Yennefer in action; he didn’t even know what exactly their abilities were.
"She can control all elements. Her field is extremely special—it’s almost like she can control many fields like you," Yasmine spoke, hearing his thoughts.
She too was ready to join the battle at any time.
Right then, her body got enveloped by armor that seemed to be made of several elements like wood, earth, fire, and many more.
Yennefer almost looked as if she was controlling a big robot.
"Heh, this is going to be fun, Master. We can kill as much as we want, right?" As Maeve took a step forward, her body underwent a drastic change.
Nine tails appeared behind her, her skin color changed to complete dark as the demonic energy suppressed the enemies even further.
"Yennefer, is that your final decision?" Oracle asked, his right hand raised.
"Vritra, would you like to joi—" Kryn, the leader of Grieves, was just questioning when he got interrupted by Red.
"No way I’m letting him join any of your organizations—either Bone Blood Cult or—" Then Red got interrupted.
"He is one of us, and he is going to become one of my subjects!" a demon lord called Sloth, Ziggy’s father, shouted.
The various lords almost started fighting among themselves, but Vritra was the first to make a move, just as the others were distracted.
[Shift Activated!]
Vritra shifted the stat points from endurance and strength to agility, as his speed became extreme.
Then, raising both the swords, the giant monstrosity let out a deafening roar and aimed at Dago, the dragon emperor.
Although Vritra’s speed had surpassed Dago’s, being the proud and overly confident dragon, he accepted the challenge.
His body twisted, and the two purple slashes barely missed his body.
WHOOSH
"You are still too young to—"
Yet a painful scream rang out from behind him in the next instant, as one of the dragons was torn symmetrically into two.
Just a single attack from Vritra had cut the dragon’s powerful body in two, and instantly Hellmancer popped beside the corpse.
The dark sorcerer was also the one who put up quite the show earlier when the two corpses had exploded.
Then it dragged the resisting dragon’s soul into oblivion, and it wasn’t long before a message popped in front of Vritra.
[You have killed a level 19,346 Dragon.]
[+Exp]
And Hellmancer’s strength increased at the same time.
That one death was the start of the war of millions, as instantly both sides began to attack one another.
But the problem was not everyone on the other side was on the same team, though right now Vritra was their main focus.
Darius gritted his teeth; he felt that if he could kill Vritra, then whatever sorcery he had done on Yennefer would be undone and she would be back to him.
His body seemed to transform into an enormous sword, tearing the air apart as he rushed toward Vritra.
A light flashed as the Oracle appeared before Vritra; he was the one who didn’t fight with brute force but played with the mind, slowly weakening the opponent.
But...
"Forbid: Wherever there is light, the air itself becomes a wall."
[Forbidden Activated.]
Vritra already knew which opponent needed more of his attention.
Oracle’s speed instantly slowed down greatly as the air became a hurdle for him.
WHOOSH
"HOW DARE YOU!!" Dago burned with rage at being fooled; he was the exact opposite of Oracle.
His body got covered with scales as he punched Vritra with all his physical strength.
Sensing that the weakened period was already over, Vritra activated Shift again.
Letting go of the two big swords, which swung on their own around him, deflecting any attacks launched from the distance.
[Shift Activated!]
"Forbid: Strength."
The terrifying punch of the dragon emperor that could easily crush most of the strong demons headed toward Vritra’s chest.
BANG
But Vritra grasped his fist as easily as catching a ball; the scales on his hand weren’t even touching Dago’s because of Atomic.
Then his burning red eyes stared into Dago’s eyes, muttering in a broken tone:
"You. Are. Weak!"
BOOOOOOOOOM
A punch full of Demonic God energy landed on his chest as the body of the dragon emperor got blown away; even the scales on his chest broke.
The morale of the dragons and many others instantly went down—this demon was nowhere near as weak as they had heard.
Yennefer created a wind blade in one hand and an enormous fireball in the other; she kept teleporting forward, making all attacks against her useless.
Then she smashed the fireball into Darius, stopping his attack before he could get anywhere near Vritra.
Right before engaging the twin brothers, Tin and Vin, in a dangerous battle, handling several lords all alone.
Maeve’s body shivered for a moment, and then hundreds of clones looking exactly like her spread over the battlefield.

Pulling out a black piece of cloth from her inventory, she waved it around gracefully as it stretched between all her clones, tearing apart anyone who got near—though only her real body could fight against a strong lord.
Dark Knight walked forward carrying its heavy sword; standing before the large army, it swung the sword in a horizontal slash.
CLANG
