"Just helping out my husband.
Oh, by the way, if you haven’t already noticed, I have switched sides."
As Yennefer spoke, the ground and air began to tremble, appearing as if a big calamity was about to appear.
Vritra just thought that he was yet to see both Maeve and Yennefer in action; he didn’t even know what exactly their abilities were.
"She can control all elements.
Her field is extremely special—it’s almost like she can control many fields like you," Yasmine spoke, hearing his thoughts.
She too was ready to join the battle at any time.
Right then, her body got enveloped by armor that seemed to be made of several elements like wood, earth, fire, and many more.
Yennefer almost looked as if she was controlling a big robot.
"Heh, this is going to be fun, Master.
We can kill as much as we want, right?" As Maeve took a step forward, her body underwent a drastic change.
Nine tails appeared behind her, her skin color changed to complete dark as the demonic energy suppressed the enemies even further.
"Yennefer, is that your final decision?" Oracle asked, his right hand raised.
"Vritra, would you like to joi—" Kryn, the leader of Grieves, was just questioning when he got interrupted by Red.
"No way I’m letting him join any of your organizations—either Bone Blood Cult or—" Then Red got interrupted.
"He is one of us, and he is going to become one of my subjects!" a demon lord called Sloth, Ziggy’s father, shouted.
The various lords almost started fighting among themselves, but Vritra was the first to make a move, just as the others were distracted.
[Shift Activated!]
Vritra shifted the stat points from endurance and strength to agility, as his speed became extreme.
Then, raising both the swords, the giant monstrosity let out a deafening roar and aimed at Dago, the dragon emperor.
Although Vritra’s speed had surpassed Dago’s, being the proud and overly confident dragon, he accepted the challenge.
His body twisted, and the two purple slashes barely missed his body.
WHOOSH
"You are still too young to—"
Yet a painful scream rang out from behind him in the next instant, as one of the dragons was torn symmetrically into two.
Just a single attack from Vritra had cut the dragon’s powerful body in two, and instantly Hellmancer popped beside the corpse.
The dark sorcerer was also the one who put up quite the show earlier when the two corpses had exploded.
Then it dragged the resisting dragon’s soul into oblivion, and it wasn’t long before a message popped in front of Vritra.
[You have killed a level 19,346 Dragon.]
[+Exp]
And Hellmancer’s strength increased at the same time.
That one death was the start of the war of millions, as instantly both sides began to attack one another.
But the problem was not everyone on the other side was on the same team, though right now Vritra was their main focus.
Darius gritted his teeth; he felt that if he could kill Vritra, then whatever sorcery he had done on Yennefer would be undone and she would be back to him.
His body seemed to transform into an enormous sword, tearing the air apart as he rushed toward Vritra.
A light flashed as the Oracle appeared before Vritra; he was the one who didn’t fight with brute force but played with the mind, slowly weakening the opponent.
But...
"Forbid: Wherever there is light, the air itself becomes a wall."
[Forbidden Activated.]
Vritra already knew which opponent needed more of his attention.
Oracle’s speed instantly slowed down greatly as the air became a hurdle for him.
WHOOSH
"HOW DARE YOU!!" Dago burned with rage at being fooled; he was the exact opposite of Oracle.
His body got covered with scales as he punched Vritra with all his physical strength.
Sensing that the weakened period was already over, Vritra activated Shift again.
Letting go of the two big swords, which swung on their own around him, deflecting any attacks launched from the distance.
[Shift Activated!]
"Forbid: Strength."
The terrifying punch of the dragon emperor that could easily crush most of the strong demons headed toward Vritra’s chest.
BANG
But Vritra grasped his fist as easily as catching a ball; the scales on his hand weren’t even touching Dago’s because of Atomic.
Then his burning red eyes stared into Dago’s eyes, muttering in a broken tone:
"You.
Are.
Weak!"
BOOOOOOOOOM
A punch full of Demonic God energy landed on his chest as the body of the dragon emperor got blown away; even the scales on his chest broke.
The morale of the dragons and many others instantly went down—this demon was nowhere near as weak as they had heard.
Yennefer created a wind blade in one hand and an enormous fireball in the other; she kept teleporting forward, making all attacks against her useless.
Then she smashed the fireball into Darius, stopping his attack before he could get anywhere near Vritra.
Right before engaging the twin brothers, Tin and Vin, in a dangerous battle, handling several lords all alone.
Maeve’s body shivered for a moment, and then hundreds of clones looking exactly like her spread over the battlefield.

Pulling out a black piece of cloth from her inventory, she waved it around gracefully as it stretched between all her clones, tearing apart anyone who got near—though only her real body could fight against a strong lord.
Dark Knight walked forward carrying its heavy sword; standing before the large army, it swung the sword in a horizontal slash.
CLANG

chapters.title: Chapter 473: The War-2
paragraphs: CLANG
Thousands of opponents instantly got killed, but then the big guy from the six seats stopped the dark knight.
The battle had just started and both sides were holding their strongest forms and attacks.
THUNDERRRRRR
A terrifying dust storm rose in the entire cloud city, as lightning thundered in the sky and the ground got covered with magma.
The colorless flame spread across the front battlefield, raising the souls of the dead and turning them against their previous companions.
The Nihilanima became a nightmare for the big army.
The Grieves hurriedly set up their formations, their first goal was to capture Vritra and if they couldn’t succeed then they must eliminate him.
"Capture him!!"
Upon receiving Kryn’s order, the Grieves, some of which were in human-like form and some in greyish form, threw thousands of glyphs into the sky.
They then transformed into a big net, aiming to capture Vritra. Even a demon lord trapped in this net wouldn’t be able to break it in a few days.
CLANG CLANG
BANG
But the net was just midway when countless attacks landed on it. Red and others destroyed the net hurriedly before rushing toward Vritra.
"Damnit, you are all going to pay for it."
Kryn cursed, then he took out a white glyph and rushed toward Vritra as well.
It was a complete mess. Vritra was constantly using the Nether Eye to observe the battlefield. Every moment, thousands of attacks approached him.
But all of those attacks couldn’t even touch his scales, as Atomic worked at full power.
"Let me handle Dago." Yasmine said as she rushed out of his body, finally making her appearance in front of the world after so many years.
Even though Vritra was doing his best, there were too many opponents, and the chances of victory seemed slimmer by the moment.
"Wait—" Vritra tried to stop her, but the dragoness flew high into the sky in her dragon form.
ROOOAAAAARRRRRRRRR
The white dragoness let out a terrifying roar; for a moment, the battlefield paused.
"T-That’s... the dragon empress Yasmine?"
"Wasn’t she killed by the demons all those years ago? How is she still alive?"
Various questions rang out all over the place; everyone was shocked by her appearance in the war.
After all, previously she was a symbol of terror, barely a few lords could even hold on against her.
Even though she had disappeared, that fear still remained.
"B-But why is she on that demon’s side? Didn’t she hate them as well?"
"Yasmine...?" Dago, who had just flown out of a crater, was shocked by the sight of the white dragon, but then they all noticed something.
"It isn’t her physical body, she is here just as a soul." Dago mumbled as all others realized it, and even her strength was nothing compared to her prime.
She wasn’t even at the general rank now.
"Yasmine... so she was the mysterious woman master told us about before?"
Maeve looked back for a moment before getting entangled in the fight again.
Sir Giant seemed as if he was playing around, yet Maeve was struggling against him.
"..." Yennefer glanced back before cutting off Tin and Vin’s left and right arms, then attacked Pink.
"Kill her!!" The various demon lords were the first to make a move.
Only the demon lords knew that Yasmine had actually managed to escape.
They had to complete what they had failed to do before; her death was extremely important for them.
There were a total of a hundred demon lords who served under the different five demon gods, though with Raelion’s death one place became vacant.
More than ten demon lords instantly rushed toward Yasmine, their target completely shifting from Vritra.
’Why would they try so hard to kill her?’ Vritra wondered.
She couldn’t face even a single lord in her current state and only wanted to keep Dago out of this war.
No way she could survive even a single attack.
Sloth opened his mouth wide and sucked in a lot of air before vomiting out a strange green liquid that seemed really terrifying.
Yasmine twisted her body, teleporting away from the demons and appearing before Dago.
"You should not join this battle." Yasmine said.
If she could make Dago agree, then all the dragons would leave, and that would be a big burden off.
She even took her human-like form, in hopes that he would choose his family.
"..." Dago stared at Yasmine, his expressions hidden behind the scales.
It was his cousin and the previous ruler of the dragons.
"Don’t listen to her, she is possessed by the devil." Oracle shouted from the distance as he tried to find a solution for his own problem.
"Yes, the real Yasmine would never side with the demons. You are not her. She is already dead." Dago locked the space around Yasmine, making it impossible for her to teleport.
Then his chest bulged as the temperature of the air rose; he was about to exterminate her soul with the dragon breath, burning her into nothingness.
From behind, the demons attacked again.
Along with Sloth, all of them launched destructive attacks.
"It is me, Dago!" Yasmine struggled as the dragon breath and the attacks from behind approached her body. Even without touching her, she could feel her soul weakening.
The feeling of powerlessness completely took over the empress’s mind.
She was so powerful before, yet now she couldn’t even protect her husband.
Yasmine sighed and gave up on resisting. Vritra, Yennefer, Maeve, and the soul wraiths were all getting attacked by so many opponents.
But this wasn’t the first time she had felt death so close to her, yet this time she felt sadder, not ever wanting to be apart from Vritra.
Cool air breezed past her body. Yasmine closed her eyes, but even after two seconds, the attacks hadn’t landed on her body.
As she opened her eyes, she was surprised to see every person on the battlefield frozen.
From the opponents to even Maeve and Yennefer, everything was completely still. Dago’s fists, the demon lords, the attacks—everything was frozen.
Then Vritra appeared before her. He touched her cheek, looking lovingly into her eyes, hiding the struggle to freeze so many powerful figures.
"Wifey, you are not useless or powerless. I still need you, so stop throwing yourself in front of danger each time or I will lock you away, you... understand?"
Vritra asked, using such a tone against her for the first time.
He was just too terrified by even the idea of losing her but also knew what was going through her mind.
Yasmine nodded, her body slowly disappearing.
"Even without... directly participating in the war, y-you can still help me." Vritra said.
"Okay." Yasmine nodded with determination. After a moment, she returned to his body.
COUGH
Vritra coughed as he reached his limit. Freezing so many lords at the same time was an extremely difficult task, and he did it for so long.
BOOOOOOM!
Instantly the entire battlefield became lively. Vritra stretched his hand and grabbed Dago’s head as the dragon breath exploded in his mouth.
Then Vritra turned around, receiving the demons’ attacks with Dago’s body.
"Shush, be a good boy." Vritra muttered, his voice feeling as if a devil was scratching directly in his mind.

chapters.title: Chapter 474: The War-3
paragraphs: WHOOSH
BOOOOM BANNGGGG
One attack after another from the several demon lords landed on Dago’s back, as his own dragon breath exploded in his mouth.
Vritra moved all his stat points to strength and used every sort of skill to keep Dago subdued even though Dago’s level was higher than his own.
"Hubby, even though I am powerless but being the former empress, I can still somewhat put pressure on him, so he won’t be able to use his full strength." Yasmine said and instantly got to work.
She released mental waves that affected all the nearby dragons, slowing them down and making it difficult to make decisions.
’Good job, wifey.’ Vritra took several long breaths, the two hearts thumping violently in his chest, pumping the maximum amount of energy.
WhileSuck! Suck! Suck! kept supplying more and more energy.
He even used an ability of that skill which he hadn’t used much before, as a small black hole appeared behind his back.
All the energy attacks were instantly sucked into the black hole, most disappearing even before they could get close.
Vritra focussed his third eye on Dago and used it to corrupt his mind and soul, constantly launching mental and soul attacks to stop the dragon emperor.
Under the combined effort of Vritra and Yasmine, Dago was subdued as he madly kept swinging his arms and legs around but could do nothing.
His face still clutched by the ten feet long demonic figure.
The army of millions combined their strength within their respective races and launched attacks at Vritra.
"I am giving you one last chance, change the sides or you will be killed along with that demon. Have you really forgotten how those demons murdere-" Pink spoke, a whip in his hand.
Yennefer ignored him and kept launching at any lord close to her, stopping them from going anywhere close to Vritra.
Alone she was fighting against Tin, Vin, Pink and even Darius, while also launching random attacks at others to keep them busy.
She glanced to the side and noticed Maeve struggling against Sir Giant, he was the oldest here and even she herself might not last long against the old man.
"Alright since that’s what you have decided then."
Pink pulled his whip back, his body glowing with a bright pink colour, as he charged destructive energy inside the whip.
BANG
BOOOOOOM
But before he could launch the attack, someone struck him from behind, making Pink collide with his own whip as his body got blasted away.
"Han, what are you doing right now?!" Darius glared at his protector, stopping him from trying to attack Vritra.
"I won’t let you hurt Yennefer." Han said firmly, standing against his own emperor.
"Tsk I knew you would never be loyal to me." Darius looked at Han with a brutal expression then a strange pattern appeared over the tip of his fingers.
He pointed his fingers at Han as the protector screamed in extreme pain while clutching his head, his body falling freely.
From the distance Vritra saw the scene, using Dago’s body as a shield, he blocked all the attacks from the demon lords.
’Good, one more teammate.’ Smiling, he teleported right in front of Darius and smashed Dago’s head into Darius’s face, interrupting the emperor.
’Wifey, can you create a barrier that would block the effect of whatever that seal is?’ Vritra questioned, as several attacks landed on his back.
But with several lines of defenses such as Goop, Atomic, even his indestructible clothes, and finally his nearly perfect physical defenses, none of the attacks were able to hurt him.
"On it." Yennefer hurriedly identified the type of seal and began to create a barrier for Han, someone they could use easily.
"I am not on your side!" Han glared at Vritra, understanding his meaning of helping him.
Vritra turned Dago’s face towards the approaching army of Grieves and muttered in his rough broken voice: "Shoot flames, boy."
[Natural Charms activated.]
ROOAAAARRRRRRRRRRR!
Dago shot a violent wave of flames wherever Vritra pointed, keeping the weaker lords at bay, while there were still many troublesome ones.
UGHHHWWAAAAAHHHH!
Sloth tore a piece of his fat from his belly and after chewing on it he spat it in Vritra’s direction, hoping to remove the dragon shield.
As usual Vritra stopped the piece of wriggling flesh with Dago’s body, but upon the moment of impact, the greenish flesh stuck to Dago’s scales.
Then it rapidly began to spread across his entire body, this way Vritra would have no choice but to break it.
"How childish..."
It seemed they were still taking him too lightly, his strength had increased greatly in his demonic dragon form.
Vritra breathed in a long breath before blowing out a tsunami of purple flame that engulfed Dago and the several demon lords.
"UWAAAAHHHHH!! I- It burnsssss how is this possibleeee?!!" Sloth couldn’t believe that this strange purple flame could even hurt his godly body, even after so much fat.
Notifications kept popping up, as Vritra’s mighty figure became a symbol of terror for everyone.
{Sin Point Gained: Terrorized +999,999}
Vritra only now noticed the sin points that were charging up like crazy, he was the man of the show after all.
"That’s enough!" Oracle was finally free from the restriction, his speed once again reaching the highest.
He appeared behind Vritra in a flash and struck his back, Goop formed a shield behind him on its own but couldn’t stop the blow from the Oracle.
Then Oracle’s palm landed over the madly moving atomic shield, stopping Oracle long enough for Vritra to react.
Instead of directly fighting Oracle, Vritra just teleported away, he wished to clean up the brutes in the battle first and absorb their power completely.
Letting the soul wraiths grow, then he would finally have a chance at winning, although millions might have to die for that.
"Little fox, is that all you have to show? By your transformation, I was rather expectant of you."
Sir Giant who was still trying to slack during the battle, had his hands behind his back as he fought Maeve.
"..." Maeve gritted her teeth, breathing heavily, there was a big difference between their strength.
"Foxie, leave." Suddenly Vritra’s voice sounded from beside her, the tall demonic figure appeared beside her, bringing along a big group of lords who kept attacking him.
"Y- Yes master." Maeve nodded, and went to help others, her goal was to let the soul wraiths devour stronger opponents.
"Hmm so you are Vritra, haa and here I was trying to not get involved with you. Just let this old man slack a little, go fight someone else."
Sir Giant said and flew away, getting entangled with Bobby next, fighting against the giant ball.
’Sigh why isn’t he taking it seriously? But I did expect his behaviour.’ Oracle shook his head, then taking a small brownish whistle he blew with all his might.
WHHEEEEEEEEEEEE!
Just as Vritra was hitting Red with Dago’s body, the ground began to shake.
’What now?’ Vritra flew higher into the sky, Yennefer and Maeve did the same.
"Hubby I am done, now Darius can’t control Han-"
BOOOM
Suddenly, the ground sunk deeper as the armies moved back, Oracle looked with pride at the ground.
Then a figure several dozens of feet tall rushed out of the ground, its body twisted and broken, it was like a...

"That’s enough!" Oracle was finally free from the restriction, his speed once again reaching the highest.
He appeared behind Vritra in a flash and struck his back, Goop formed a shield behind him on its own but couldn’t stop the blow from the Oracle.
Then Oracle’s palm landed over the madly moving atomic shield, stopping Oracle long enough for Vritra to react.
Instead of directly fighting Oracle, Vritra just teleported away, he wished to clean up the brutes in the battle first and absorb their power completely.
Letting the soul wraiths grow, then he would finally have a chance at winning, although millions might have to die for that.
"Little fox, is that all you have to show?
By your transformation, I was rather expectant of you."
Sir Giant who was still trying to slack during the battle, had his hands behind his back as he fought Maeve.
"..." Maeve gritted her teeth, breathing heavily, there was a big difference between their strength.
"Foxie, leave." Suddenly Vritra’s voice sounded from beside her, the tall demonic figure appeared beside her, bringing along a big group of lords who kept attacking him.
"Y- Yes master." Maeve nodded, and went to help others, her goal was to let the soul wraiths devour stronger opponents.
"Hmm so you are Vritra, haa and here I was trying to not get involved with you.
Just let this old man slack a little, go fight someone else."
Sir Giant said and flew away, getting entangled with Bobby next, fighting against the giant ball.
’Sigh why isn’t he taking it seriously?
But I did expect his behaviour.’ Oracle shook his head, then taking a small brownish whistle he blew with all his might.
WHHEEEEEEEEEEEE!
Just as Vritra was hitting Red with Dago’s body, the ground began to shake.
’What now?’ Vritra flew higher into the sky, Yennefer and Maeve did the same.
"Hubby I am done, now Darius can’t control Han-"
BOOOM
Suddenly, the ground sunk deeper as the armies moved back, Oracle looked with pride at the ground.
Then a figure several dozens of feet tall rushed out of the ground, its body twisted and broken, it was like a...

chapters.title: Chapter 475: Demonic Dragon Emerges!
paragraphs: Suddenly, a figure several dozens of feet tall rushed out of the ground, its body twisted and broken, it was like a...
’A Chimera?’ Vritra looked at the creature in surprise, it had countless heads, arms, its body was a mess of flesh and limbs.
So many creatures were used to create that one being, its strength reaching a really high level.
"Kill him!" Oracle gave one command and blew the whistle again, before breaking it, just in case.
Vritra sensed that this thing was quite dangerous, and it would be a little difficult to kill it.
’But I still need a Chimera back in my army.’ Vritra looked at the creature, although it was completely different from his previous Chimera but this would work.
"Dago, let’s fight our next opponent together." Vritra muttered, letting go of his head, he grabbed one of his feet and flew directly towards the Chimera.
All the while using teleportation to dodge the relentless attacks, the Grieves were especially getting annoying as they kept trying to capture him.
Swinging Dago’s body, Vritra struck the Chimera, hitting one of its eyes while the enormous creature let out a twisted noise, before trying to swallow him whole.
There was chaos all around, army of millions on one side and just a few on the other, there hasn’t been such a big fight in a long time.
Maeve and Yennefer fought together, keeping as many enemies busy as they possibly could while helping the soul wraiths.
Red flew up, since his plan to recruit Vritra normally had failed, now he could only use his trump card.
Calling his underling from Bone Blood Cult, he spoke: "Start it, activate the barrier."
"Yes leader." Instantly he left the battlefield and disappeared, soon leaving the cloud city.
’This will work at all costs, no way could my plan fail. Soon Vritra will be a part of the Bone Blood Cult.’ Red grinned hideously, now he just needed to wait a little before starting his plan.
Then his biggest challenge would be to get Vritra out of there.
He just hovered high in the sky, leisurely watching Vritra fight against the enormous Chimera.
Dago was becoming mad, his reputation had completely been ruined. Everyone feared him, he was the emperor of the dragons and now he was reduced to this pitiful state.
Becoming nothing more than a shield.
He let out a deafening roar, forcefully breaking free of Vritra’s grasp finally as his body twisted and he began to transform into a giant green dragon.
His long form flew high into the sky, as he proudly looked down at the entire battlefield and found Red floating right in front of it.
"Hello Dragon Emperor, I believe this is the first time meeting." Red said, standing calmly.
"...Red, you scum human. First I am done with that demon I will come to look for you."
Then he looked down and tried to find Vritra, but saw that the Chimera was rushing in his direction and the demonic dragon was nowhere to be seen.
"Oh looking for Vritra? He is right behind you." Red said, but before Dago could react, Vritra got a hold of his tail and began to swing the enormous dragon around.
"This is better, Dago, you truly are a great help." Vritra said, before hitting the Chimera with the large body of the dragon.
BOOOOOM
Vritra freely swung Dago around, hitting anyone around him while Dago kept struggling, breathing out flames.
Kryn, the leader of the Grieves, finally managed to get closer to Vritra, as he threw the white glyph towards him then flew back.
Clicking his tongue, Vritra tried to teleport away but failed, the bright glyph launched invisible strings that wrapped around him.
And then his body got pulled into the glyph, as Dago finally got free and flew away.
The Chimera had to fulfil its order, before Kryn could reach Vritra, it hastily swallowed the glyph.
As Vritra’s presence disappeared from the battlefield, everyone paused and looked around in shock, before their gazes fixed on the giant Chimera who rushed back into the ground.
"NOOOOO! Masterrrrrr!" Maeve ignored her opponents and flew towards the Chimera, planning to launch a full power blow.
"HUSBAND!" Yennefer too flew towards it, aware that Vritra was trapped inside it.
But then the body of the Chimera froze, before shivering violently, its body bulged and twisted.
Then a clear line appeared over its surface, stretching from the front to back, as a terrifying roar sounded from within its body.
And once again, the whole city got engulfed by the demonic pressure.
Finally, tearing apart the Chimera’s body, a black dragon with red patterns over its scales, burning with purple flames, shot out into the sky.
Its size slightly bigger than even Dago, covering the ground with its shadow.
Everyone paused in Vritra’s presence as he roared and at even faster speed, rushed into the horde of opponents.
"H- How terrifying, is this his current limit?" Red stared at Vritra fighting so many lords in astonishment, marvelling at his capabilities.
For some reason he felt that this new divine might still have some secrets, even more hidden power.
The need to recruit him got even bigger in his heart, he would not let any of them kill or capture him.
Vritra appearing even more horrifying, with a swing of his tail he threw Tin and Vin away, his strength higher than ever.
The battlefield once again seemed to be going on Vritra’s side but he was still far from victory.
And the Chimera quickly healed but got slightly weakened.
The phoenix emperor also changed their forms, planning to fight Vritra at their full power as they tried to burn him with their flames.
But all of it just got sucked into the black hole, making all attacks useless.
The Oracle started deploying a new tactic to once again restrict his strength, if Yennefer hadn’t betrayed them at the last moment then they might have already won this battle.
’But even she is not aware of this formation, with this I can at least restrict 30% of his strength but I need some time.’ Oracle quickly began to pull out more puppets from his storage.
While the others fought against the big dragons, as more and more lords joined hands against Vritra, it became harder for him to fight.
Though not a single attack could injure him, they were on a stalemate.
Finally, Vritra noticed a sudden change as the underling from Bone Blood Cult finally activated the barrier back in the Ghazi city.
’Huh? Suddenly why can’t I...?’ He paused for a moment but had no time as several people attacked him at once.
Red got the signal that their setup was ready, it was time to start.
"STOP!!!" Clearing his throat he let out a loud shout that reverberated across the whole field, and everyone did glance back at him in surprise.
"Vritra, do you still not want to join me even after seeing this?" Red took a step to the side and pointed beside him.
"I said I am not going to joi-" Frustrated, Vritra was replying in a heavy tone, but when his gaze landed on Red again, he froze.
He couldn’t believe his eyes and wondered if it was some illusion, after all just beside Red there was...

chapters.title: Chapter 476: Desperation
paragraphs: "Did this change your mind?" Red had a big smile under the mask as he looked down at Vritra from the sky.
Vritra’s demonic dragon form shrunk as he returned to his original state, two horns on his head and the purple flames still burning menacingly around him.
’How can she be here?!!’ Vritra was baffled by the sight in front of him.
Beside Red floating was his mother, Vanessa, her arms tied by some sort of cloth.
"M- Mom...?" He could no longer sense his connection with his mother or Diana back in the city of charms.
But even the connection he sensed with Vanessa in the sky felt weak and strange, he couldn’t tell if it was reality or not.
"H- Honey, you should never join them, mmph." Vanessa’s voice was filled with desperation, she tried to free herself but failed.
Red snapped his finger, making it impossible for her to even speak, her eyes looked at Vritra in panic.
As if she was asking him to just escape, not to put her in danger for herself.
"HOW IS SHE HERE?" Vritra had no time to ponder, his fists clenched and rage filled him.
"Ah, don’t look at me like that, I mean no harm to you or your mother.
She is perfectly fine, don’t worry, and she will be in the future, that is if you join Bone Blood Cult." Red said, his gaze full of confidence.
The whole place was silent at this moment, all the eyes fixed on Vritra and the two figures in the sky.
Yennefer and Maeve looked with worry, Maeve was yet to meet his mother but Yennefer knew that it really was her.
Whether it be her scent, aura, voice, everything was perfectly identical. Even her strength seemed closer to the lord rank, just as expected after receiving the inheritance.
’Wasn’t she supposed to be receiving an inheritance, how did Red find her?’ Yennefer could feel Vritra’s rage and helplessness.
He could think of thousands of ways to save her but each method had a ’what if’ and there was no way he could ever put his mother in danger.
’Then are Diana and Fiona also taken away?’ Vritra felt his frustration and anger rise, but even if he managed to save his mother, what about Fiona and Diana.
"Also, if you just say the word yes, I will take all of you away. None of them here will be able to hurt you all." Red gazed at Vritra and the two women.
It would be great if he could get those two women to join Bone Blood Cult along with Vritra.
"Hubby..."
At this moment, even Yasmine couldn’t help him, she didn’t want him to join Bone Blood Cult either but saving Vanessa and others was also the priority.
"..." Vritra just stared at Vanessa, he hated Bone Blood Cult because of their inhumane and cruel deeds but none of it mattered, he could do worse things if it was for his family.
Slowly the purple flames around him dimmed, he knew the moment Vanessa appeared he was defeated.
"...Okay, I will join you." Finally, filled with desperation, he accepted.
"Mom, just wait a bit, I will be with you soon." Vritra looked into her eyes, not wanting her to feel guilty.
But for now, this was his only choice.
"Good good, now that’s a really smart choice. Welcome to Bone Blood Cult, Vritra Arclis, oh the new Divine."
Red was overjoyed, from between so many races and groups, he was the one to succeed and get this strongest tool.
It won’t be long before they won’t even have to fear the Golden Moon, heck even Divine Kage, Bone Blood Cult alone would be at the pinnacle.
"Now it is time to leave this place. Sorry guys, I am going to need to take him away, you all can continue with your battles."
Red hastily activated the teleportation formation he had set up in advance.
Planning to take Vritra, Vanessa, Maeve and Yennefer away.
"Master..." Maeve bit her lip, her heart aching to see her man look so helpless for the first time.
"Husband, it is fine, we will deal with this too together." Yennefer muttered, as the two women also returned to their normal forms, surrendering along with him.
’This is just perfect, what great love!’ Red was over the moon as a big circle appeared in the sky before connecting to all their positions.
The Oracle clenched his fists, this was the worst sort of outcome.
Even if they had failed to kill Vritra here, the deaths in the battlefield would have been their only losses.
After all, Vritra wasn’t the likes of Nine Pacts, Bone Blood Cult or other dark organizations.
Oracle could tell from his observation that Vritra was still rather kind, he wouldn’t kill others unless they harmed him first.
But if he becomes a part of Bone Blood Cult then the world would be filled with chaos.
So even before killing Vritra, at any cost, they had to stop Red from controlling him.
And the only way was...
Oracle looked into Sir Giant’s eyes, as the members of Golden Moon understood their tasks.
’Yes, we have to separate that girl from that lunatic.’ Sir Giant thought, then Red couldn’t control Vritra.
They all made a plan silently, and in the next moment Oracle turned into a blinding light and flashed beside Pink.
Before the others could react, the two had disappeared, while the others from the six seats also made their moves, even the emperors.
"Oh!" Red was a little surprised but he had expected this, but before he could continue with his plans, a seductive male voice sounded just beside his ear.
"Hoo, little guy, wanna try mixing pink and red?"
Red’s body was suddenly grabbed by Pink, his body seemed to turn into some sort of clothes itself as he tightly wrapped himself around Red, freezing him.
"!!!" Vritra was surprised for a moment but knew that this was the perfect moment, he had to save her.
He tried to teleport but found that space had been locked all over the city, making even the formation useless.
Pushing himself to his limits, Vritra increased his speed to max and rushed in Vanessa’s direction.
But then he saw a blinding light rushing towards her as well.
"Oracle!!"
THUMP THUMP
THUMP THUMP
His hearts started beating so loudly that even the people outside could clearly hear him, his body burst forward with extreme energy.
But Tin and Vin appeared in front of him, trying to stop him.
"GET OUT OF MY WAY!" Vritra put his hands before him in a cross shape and smashed into them, his speed increasing beyond his limit.
If he could just get close to her, just close enough and he could save her.
Tin and Vin’s bodies were blasted away, but they flew back towards him, their sole goal was to stop him.
Darius too appeared before Vritra, spreading his arms as countless swords appeared out of thin air and danced around him.
"Try to get through this." Darius challenged, he was confident most lost would be riddled with holes if they even got close to it.
Vritra only increased his speed further as he caught fire, the restrictions of space acting against him.
BAANNNGGGGGGGG!

chapters.title: Chapter 477: Death
paragraphs: BAANNNGGGGGGGG!
He directly smashed into the countless blades, which halted him briefly.
Activating all his fields, Vritra’s body became a mess of several colours, exploding violently as radioactive radiations spread in all directions.
The tip of the blades hovered just a few millimeters from his skin, atoms struggling to hold one of Darius’s strongest attacks.
Finally, one of the blades pressed against his skin but got turned into powder.
"FASTER FASTER FASTER!!!"
Seeing the blinding light inching closer to his mother, he put every bit of his strength, pushing forward with so much force that he actually began to feel some pain.
’Damnit how is he...’ Darius struggled with all his might, he did succeed in slowing down Vritra a little but then...
BOOOOOOOOOOM
The sky itself burned with purple flames, spreading like a tsunami as all the blades got destroyed, and Darius got blown away.
Coughing out blood, he looked at Vritra with disbelief but then rushed back towards him.
Yennefer, Maeve, the soul wraiths all rushed towards them but weren’t fast enough to be of help to him.
Vritra tried to slow down time or even stop it but somehow none of it was working, only increasing his desperation since that blinding light was still faster.
Oracle wasn’t called the brain of the Golden Moon for no reason, just after seeing or even hearing about his abilities, he would prepare something against it.
And so, most of Vritra’s abilities failed to give him an advantage.
Dago and the two phoenix emperors also tried to stop Vritra, but they failed to catch up with him.
Vritra activated Suck! Suck! Suck! at maximum capability, sucking away the entire mana from the city even as he felt like exploding but used it to increase his speed to match Oracle’s.
’More More...’ He had only covered 70 percent, his speed even surpassing that of the fastest human though he was hurting himself in the process.
Oracle looked at Vritra in shock, but he had to remove the possibility of Vritra joining the Bone Blood Cult.
"Sir Giant!!" He let out a scream with all his might, the old man might be the only one who could stop Vritra now.
"Sigh don’t put the focus on me."
Sir Giant was already closer to Vanessa, he suddenly flashed before Vritra, his arms transformed gigantic and red then raising them, he punched Vritra without holding back at all.
"Sorry young guy, I don’t like hitting others but if I don’t go all out then I wont be able to stop you."
Vritra formed a shield with Goop in front of him, sensing the destructive strength in the punch, the strength far surpassing his own.
BOOOOOOOOOM!!
The Goop shield was broken after struggling for a few moments, then appeared the atomic which held on but his body got blasted back.
"We have to stop him..." Maeve gritted her teeth, her heart aching and she couldn’t even imagine what losing his mother could do to him.
He was extremely strong but she had seen his vulnerable side too, and knew that this would break him completely.
Maeve and Yennefer both used all their strength to rush towards the Oracle but their speed couldn’t match his.
’Why isn’t even Null working? Why aren’t most of my abilities working?’ Yennefer felt the anger boil inside her, she was sure that the Oracle must be behind all this.
This just might have been his trump card but because of Red he had to reveal it.
While Red was still struggling to get free from Pink’s grasp.
Kryn, the demons and several other dark organizations were just watching.
"NOOOOOOO!!"
Vritra wasn’t hurt but his momentum broke, he tried to rush forward again. But suddenly, several people grabbed him back, stopping him from moving.
Vritra had shifted his points to agility so his strength had weakened.
Dago, Darius, two phoenix emperors, Tin, Vin, Big Guy, and many others all got together to stop him.
"Now just take the girl away, then- oh!" After stopping Vritra, Sir Giant turned around as his arm returned to normal.
His face got filled with surprise as he saw Oracle who had already gotten close to Vanessa, raising his right glowing arm.

’He plans to kill her?’ Even Sir Giant was confused, wondering why he was taking things to extreme. But maybe it was because Vritra was the divine that they had to even remove everything related to him.
He could only sigh and look back at Vritra in pity, sensing how badly Vritra wanted to save her.
No matter how he got entangled with the divine and demon stuff, he was still a kid, but Sir Giant could do nothing.
Vritra’s heart was clenched as he saw what Oracle was planning, he tried to break free, even if it meant tearing his limbs apart but his strength fell short.
A black fluid rushed out of his body, desperately trying to reach the Oracle, but Goop’s speed wasn’t enough.
Yasmine couldn’t even imagine how much pain he must be feeling, but she was even more powerless.
The sight of Oracle’s hand getting closer to Vanessa’s body made even her lose her mind.
Vritra was going completely insane.
"STOOOOPPPPP!!" Vritra let out a roar, fear making its way into his heart, the world was slowly turning red in his eyes.
But even as the purple flames burned their flesh, the several lords held him back, following the Oracle’s order.
And if Vritra did lose his mind, it would be a lot easier to kill him.
All the soul wraiths exploded at once, killing several warriors from the other side.
Then Vritra again called them, as Dark Knight and Hellmancer burst forth with destructive energy.
Stunning the group of lords, and momentarily loosening their grips, Vritra finally managed to break free as the radioactive radiations clung to their arms.
Vanessa was shaking her head, her eyes filled with tears, the love and pain clearly visible in her eyes.
It was as if she was begging him not to get closer, not to get hurt.
"NOOOOO MOM-"
WHOOSH
But in the next instant, Oracle’s hand slashed through her body, tearing her apart as she got consumed by the burning bright light.
Her body began to burn, even in her last moment she kept looking into his eyes, begging him to leave.
Life slowly disappeared from her eyes, her body fading away and disappearing into nothingness; her tears disappearing before they could fall.
Vritra felt as if life had been sucked out of him, his body falling to his knees motionlessly as his mother completely vanished, from his sight, from his life.
The hollow feeling completely consumed him, a pain far greater than anything filled him, tearing him from inside.
Not even dying before was as painful.
Oracle’s lips curled up, he watched as Vanessa’s blood got burned from his arm, all demons deserved this.
He was happy to have served justice. The whole place suddenly turned completely silent, Vritra was sitting there without any sort of defence yet no one got closer to him.
The soul wraiths suddenly began to tremble as they looked at their master, terrified at what was about to happen.
"Now this is your turn." Oracle said, turning to Vritra whose face wasn’t visible.
All limits were broken as the destruction swallowed everything in the next moment.

chapters.title: Chapter 478: Carnage
paragraphs: The whole battlefield was silent; their gaze fixed on the demon who appeared as if his soul itself had been destroyed.
Despite knowing that this might be the best chance to strike him, none of them could make a move.
The Oracle floated high in the sky, waiting for Vritra’s next action.
There was a reason behind him killing Vanessa just now and he waited to see how this development would go.
Yennefer, Maeve and Yasmine all felt grief, pain and anger, but none of it could be compared to what Vritra was experiencing.
’Was that all? Sigh it seems that truly was his limits, no point in keeping him alive then.’ Oracle thought, looking down at the still figure.
Red finally managed to break free from Pink’s grasp, flying away in disgust. He was mad about his plan failing when he was clearly so close to victory, he had been so careful to do it all.
’It’s over now, I have to get out of here before they target me.’ Knowing Vritra had no chance of surviving now, he made his decision.
Darius’ lips stretched in a big disgusting grin, every cell in his body satisfied to inflict this sort of pain on the person who stole his woman.
But this was not enough. He had to kill Vritra while there was still a chance.
Creating a sword out of nothing, he took a step forward, planning to behead Vritra right in front of Yennefer.
But suddenly, every particle of the dust began to tremble, buzzing violently.
The silence was broken as strange faint noises started ringing across the entire city.
At first they were hard to recognise, but soon the pitch rose to the level that the weaker men in the army began to bleed from their ears.
It was as if infinite beings were crying, as if every devil in the world was mourning, the tone rising to a deafening degree.
[Titan Fall Activated.]
Warm bloody tears flowed from Vritra’s eyes, each drop leaving behind deep marks over his skin.
[Current limit: None]
[Forcefully Raising Level.]
The world seemed to be consumed by a dark veil, everyone’s senses becoming dull.
From Sir Giant to the demons, everyone was alerted by the sudden changes, as a bad feeling crept deep into their hearts.
[Forcefully Activating the Divine Bloodline.]
Vritra’s entire body started trembling, as if his bones and flesh itself were twisting inside.
’What’s... going on?’ Darius, with the sword in hand, paused and looked around in bafflement.
Wondering if a god himself was appearing.
[Forcefully upgrading Dust Manipulation.]
[Dust Zombie has evolved into SS rank Dust Monarch.]
Titan Fall was a skill that would pull energy from fate itself, burning up Vritra’s soul, body, his future, past, every memory he is present in, and everything related to him.
Giving enough energy to destroy everything.
Not stopping until every life form on the planet had disappeared.
Making the planet itself fall.
His level was rising as black fog began to emit out of his body, darkness slowly covering his skin.
TIP
Everything once again fell silent as a blood tear fell to the ground, all the devils going silent abruptly.
The soul wraiths still trembled, unable to move even a little.
Sensing the changes, they knew that Vritra needed to be killed now or a disaster like never before would befall.
Every single one of them rushed towards him, the world feeling as if it was moving in slow motion and no sounds could be heard.
Oracle already knew that he had made a mistake, his body turned into a blinding light, rushing forward to kill before the chaos engulfed everything.
Yasmine tried to leave but found herself locked. Maeve and Yennefer flew towards Vritra, they would protect him even if it meant fighting every single lord there until their last breath.
But their bodies froze and two separate pages appeared under them, swallowing them both, before shooting off into the distance.
Within moments, the two pages had left the Quartz continent, yet the speed didn’t decrease.
[Cry Baby Activated.]
Oracle was the closest to Vritra, as dozens of lords all tried to kill him.
AHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHH
A blood curdling scream rang out, Vritra’s fingers digging into his own flesh as he tore apart the human skin.
A Demon was born...
All the lords were blasted several miles back, as a horrifying red figure rose, its body growing at an absurd rate.
100 meters...
200 meters...
Every person who saw the sinister figure felt a primal fear, not a single person was present who wasn’t shivering.
"That is..." Dago, even in his dragon form, would look tiny in front of that Behemoth.
The fiendish figure was a blur of red colour, two burning horns over its head and looking nothing like a human.
RAAAAAAAARRRRRRRRRRRGGGGGGGGGGHHH!!!
A broken and twisted cry rang out that made the bodies of thousands of men explode in a bloody mess, the radius of the destruction far surpassing just the city.
"W- We have to stop that!!" Darius stumbled back, dread filling his heart.
That wasn’t something any of them could handle.
What had they awakened.
Maybe from the beginning, it was a mistake.
They never should’ve broken what could lead to carnage.

’Right the Oracle, he must have something planned for this, nothing ever escapes his expectations...’ Darius had little hope that Oracle might have a solution but upon looking to the side, he saw the Oracle trembling.
Red was smashed into the ground by just the after effect of the blast.
Looking up, he shivered, terrified that this was the entity he wanted to control.
That wasn’t a tool, that was destruction itself.
He just wanted to leave now, but it was impossible. Dust was spreading across all the cities nearby, swallowing up the entire continent, the extent of his power unbelievable.
"Damnit, my plan almost succeeded if only that fucker O- Oracle hadn’t interfered." Red now just wanted to survive. Since escaping now wasn’t an option then stopping Vritra was their only chance.
But looking at him, Red knew he would be killed the moment the battle started.
"VRITRA, YOUR MOTHER IS FINE!!!" Red screamed, hoping that he could come back to his senses.
There was no way for him to actually abduct Vanessa, he didn’t even know where she exactly was.
All along, that was the Bandaged Man’s clone, who took Vanessa’s form.
His biggest flaw of becoming the person he cloned itself became a great benefit this time.
With Pink’s help he was able to get the relative position of Vanessa and then he put a massive barrier around there that cut off any sort of connection.
Which was why Vritra couldn’t sense his connection with Vanessa or Diana suddenly.
He just planned to make Vritra create a pact while using that clone, but only Oracle recognised that it was a clone, not the actual Vanessa.
But to confirm some of his doubts he went as far as to play along and kill that clone.
The real Vanessa had never left the city of charms or the inheritance ground, but Vritra had completely lost his mind.
"Tch he isn’t listening!!"
The ground broke as countless dust giants rose, each more than a hundred meters tall and filled with extreme destructive energy.
Almost equivalent to a lord rank.
The battle had completely shifted, each lord would have to face several of those giants to even things out.
"ATTACK VRITRA!!" Oracle screamed, fully aware of his blunder.
Ignoring the giants that had started to destroy the cities, they all charged towards Vritra.
Using every trump card and pushing themselves to the limits.
Dago transformed into his dragon form again, becoming even bigger than before as he burned his essence blood.
Darius pulled out one of his most dangerous treasures, a short metallic sword.
He pushed it into his chest, coughing out blood. Then a terrifying energy seeped out of his body, taking the form of a gigantic sword above his head.
The two phoenix emperors also transformed, using every bit of their strength.
The demon lords used their most terrifying forms, all their treasures against that one figure who was becoming more twisted by the moment.

Sir Giant sighed before finally deciding to use his full strength. His body grew in size, his skin changing colour to grey as he rose to a height of several hundred meters but still fell short before the abomination.
The Grieves, Red, Nine Pacts, all of them didn’t dare hold back, as they all flew towards Vritra.
The world had become red in his eyes, every entity its enemy.
Thousands of dust tornadoes spread, the sky, water, space, everything was buzzing under the dust which seemed to be filled with blood.
Vritra’s strength kept rising, the two skills far too terrifying to exist.
Haaaahhhh!!
Darius shot the sword forward, he had put everything in this single attack, his body devoid of any energy.
He was confident to at least injure that monster, even a little.
The colossal figure’s gaze landed on the approaching blade, and then at Darius.
Letting out a spine chilling roar, its enormous hand moved at a speed far surpassing even Oracle’s.
CLAAANNNNGGGGGGGG!
The blade struck his finger, exploding violently but it couldn’t even last for a moment, getting tossed away instantly.
Vritra took a step forward, a purple lava spreading across the land, destroying everything hundreds, thousands of miles around him.
Stretching his arm, he caught the human emperor, the figure respected and feared by all, into his palm.
Squeezing tightly, the flames burned off skin and flesh, every bone in his body cracking with a sickening crack.
Darius screamed, but felt the purple magma filling his mouth, burning him from inside.
Everyone froze as Darius continued to scream for several seconds, going through an inhumane torment.
And soon, his voice became weaker and weaker.
Dust tore his body into tiny piece, and radioactive waves, slowly melting his organs.
His eyes, face all of it distorted under the deadly radiations and magma, he couldn’t do anything, not even move a bit.
Seeing how such a powerful lord was beaten by Vritra in a mere moment, all of them suddenly lost confidence.
Even together, there was no way of defeating that thing.
The faint, pain filled screams of the defeated emperor ringing like a warning.
Vritra’s figure, with two big terrifying horns, looked too nightmarish.
Not even sir giant could move as that hollow gaze passed over him, his giant body shaking involuntarily.
CRACK CRACK
ZSSSSSSSSSSS...
"AAHHHHH- UUUUUUUUUAAAAA" Darius voice was unrecognisable, as even his soul started burning.
Soul wraiths were too filled with a terrifying amount of energy, their bodies undergoing a strange evolution.
Hellmancer attacked Darius’s soul at the same time and before anyone could register...
Darius was killed.
Mind, body and soul, all destroyed.

The faint, pain filled screams of the defeated emperor ringing like a warning.
Vritra’s figure, with two big terrifying horns, looked too nightmarish.
Not even sir giant could move as that hollow gaze passed over him, his giant body shaking involuntarily.
CRACK CRACK
ZSSSSSSSSSSS...
"AAHHHHH- UUUUUUUUUAAAAA" Darius voice was unrecognisable, as even his soul started burning.
Soul wraiths were too filled with a terrifying amount of energy, their bodies undergoing a strange evolution.
Hellmancer attacked Darius’s soul at the same time and before anyone could register...
Darius was killed.
Mind, body and soul, all destroyed.

chapters.title: Chapter 479: One Moment
paragraphs: Everyone stared at the gigantic demon in bewilderment, the emperor of the human race was gone just like that.
He didn’t even have the time to defend himself and the strongest attack was swatted away like a fly.
And with how Vritra kept growing, his strength increasing, it seemed he would destroy the entire planet.
Quite a lot of cities around them were already in shambles, thankfully the people had been moved away beforehand.
"W- What should we do now?" Pink shivered, being an agent from several groups, he was well aware of what was going on in the background.
He was the one who had helped Red with several tasks, and now he regretted doing any of it.
Initially Vritra was just a means for all of them to carry on with their plans, they were all sure he would be easily killed in this war and they could take advantage of the chaos.
But their plans were flawed from the very beginning.
"...We have to hold him back for now, for a power like this, someone else will have to deal with it." Oracle said, then gritted his teeth as he added:
"Everyone activate your domains."
At first they all were a bit hesitant but there was no other way to hold back that monstrosity, and Golden Moon itself gave permission.
The enormous fiend stomped on the ground, as Ghazi City and several others exploded violently, all buildings, everything crushed to pieces.
The giants and dragons made of dust spread destruction all over the continent, there had never been destruction of this level before.
Even people and beasts hundreds of thousands of miles away trembled, the presence of calamity making their senses scream in alarm.
At the same time, the emperors, the demons, Grieves, humans, all of them opened their domains, as suddenly the space around them got enveloped by domains of different shapes and sizes.
Vritra was inside dozens of domains, each one with different abilities.
"I will take the lead, you all attack him from behind." Sir Giant said, fully aware that only he could handle those attacks now.
His body had grown to full size, his fists turned red while his body remained grey as he stomped on the ground and charged towards Vritra.
BOOOOOOOOOM
His fist struck the side of the colossal demon’s abdomen, taking it a step back, and instantly everyone attacked using the full power of their domains.
Oracle’s strength increased even further, he moved at extreme speed trying to cut Vritra’s skin but he was stopped around a meter from his skin.
Even Atomic had been strengthened.
For Oracle, it seemed as if the entire world had slowed down, at this speed, no one here could match him, not even Vritra.
That, he was sure of it.
He decided to check for Vritra’s weakness.
’His eyes might be the only place.’ He thought before flying higher, passing in front of the terrifying entity’s face.
He looked into the two hollow eye sockets, a faint purple flame burning where its pupils should have been.
’Will he receive damage if I were to- Huh? He can still see me?’ Oracle felt a shiver, Vritra’s gaze moving directly onto him.
The giant demon, despite being suppressed by all domains, moved its arm at a speed matching Oracle’s.
"!!!" Suddenly Oracle found himself almost in Vritra’s grasp, his fingers curling around him.
"Damnit!! How is he still faster than me?" Oracle tried to move, the world around them frozen and only Oracle and Vritra’s arm were moving.
Though Null hadn’t been used, their speed had just reached that level.
He tried to escape in every direction, even launching his strongest attack but none of it could do anything, while Vritra’s speed kept increasing.
WHOOSH
He broke into two blinding lights, flying into different directions, hoping to get away from that thing.
The regret increasing with each passing moment.
The demonic figure although appearing mindless still easily saw through Oracle’s trick.
Ignoring both lights, he directly hit the space ahead, breaking the barrier formed around the frightened Oracle.
’Ughh’ Even before he was caught, his skin began to melt.
In the end, Oracle was forced into a corner, and in order to survive he had to do the extreme.
After all, he didn’t want to be another tragedy like Darius.
His body exploded all of a sudden, the explosion far stronger than Raelion’s as Vritra’s fingers got pushed back just a little.
Oracle’s soul escaped hurriedly, moving behind the group.
’Haa haa That... was terrifying cough’ Thankfully he managed with his soul unhurt, if he could survive then getting a body back wouldn’t be too hard.
The area around them finally reacted, they could barely see what had happened in that brief moment.
And already, Oracle, their commander, was defeated.
"D- Damnit, this is suicide, we might still be able to escape." One of the demon lords ended up leaking, almost crying.
He turned around and fled with all his might, deploying every sort of escaping treasure he could.
It seemed Vritra had ignored the escaping demon, making him cry out in joy as he continued to flee.
The demonic figure let out a roar so terrifying that the space around them trembled, then he struck down Sir Giant.
BOOOOOOOOOOOOM!!
Just as his fist landed on the grey giant, its body broke apart, limbs falling and a hole appeared in his chest before getting blown far away.
[Domain Activated.]
Then suddenly the world around them became a mess of different colours and everyone in Cloud City felt as if they had suddenly been devoid of any energy.
A circular strange domain covered the entire Cloud City, locking everyone inside, a domain made from several fields and so much terrifying energy.
For the first time, Vritra activated his domain.
The demon who had already arrived near the wall of the city saw the strange looking wall that had appeared.
But it was impossible for him to stop since he had used a treasure to increase his speed severalfold.
"W- What is this now? How can there be a domain like this?" Gritting his teeth, he decided to break through the wall.
Screaming wildly, he punched the wall.
But even before his body could get close to the domain wall, his body began to disintegrate. The skin was torn away first, rotting rapidly.
Then flesh, nerves, bones, organs, his body got destroyed within a matter of moments as the demon let out painful screams.
He at least tried to escape with his soul like Oracle did, but his soul was getting pulled by the strange wall.
"Uwaaaaaaaah What is this thing- S- Someone help meeeeee ughhhhh aaaaaaah" The screams made everyone in the distance shiver, but right then a shadow flashed behind the frightened soul.
It was Bob, without wasting a moment, the large soul wraith munched at his soul.
Normally, the soul of the demon lord could still have beaten Bob but with the suppression of the domain, he could do nothing.
Under all the terrifying gazes, Bob slowly devoured the demon lord’s soul, its strength rapidly increasing.
But none of them had time to worry about others, Vritra suddenly charged forward, messages constantly flashing before him.
More than half of the army had already been slaughtered by the dust demons.

chapters.title: Chapter 480: Purge
paragraphs: Everyone on the battlefield felt the terrifying unknown domain swallow them, their own domains shattered almost instantly.
Immense pressure suddenly crushed the bodies of thousands of warriors, all the souls consumed by the wraiths.
It was as if suddenly they had all lost more than half of their battle prowess, while radiations made their insides melt.
Despite their great healing factors, their bodies were getting damaged just by standing inside the domain.
GRRAAAAAAAAHHHHHHHHHH!!!
Vritra suddenly raised both his hands, his arms covered by Goop which appeared infinitely more terrifying now.
Then deadly and giant weapons rained down from the sky over the span of thousands of miles, destroying everything.
The Dust ability was finally being used to its current maximum potential, the whole continent on the verge of collapse.
What the hundred demon lords and countless dark organizations failed to do previously was happening all because of one person.
COUGH COUGH
Sir Giant coughed but then his body healed and he got back to his feet, finally aware of the gap between their strength.
"Even I can’t handle him now, where are they? At this rate the continent will be completely wiped off." Giant gritted his teeth, glaring at Oracle’s soul.
He didn’t want to handle big matters and even planned to retire, but Oracle kept delaying it, saying they first have to recruit a new member.
And even now, it was all because of that bastard that sent Vritra over the line of madness.
"Why did you kill his mother?!!" He shouted, watching the terrifying devil swatting the lords away like flies.

"S- She wasn’t really his mother, it was one of Red’s underlings, he has the ability to perfectly clone any person. I- I just wanted to check something..." Oracle, for the first time in his life, had made such a big blunder, and was completely responsible for so many lives.

"Oh did your curiosity get quenched? Why don’t you go ahead and play with him a bit more and check a few more things? See if he can catch your soul or not." The old man really felt like killing him with his own hands, but this was not the time.
"Any plans?" he asked, getting ready to strike that giant again.
"I-" Before Oracle could say anything, they heard a heart-wrenching scream from not too far away.
"Uaaaaaaahhhhhhhh aaah uuuuuuiiiiiii S- Stooppppp ooooooooooooaaaaaa"
Several people glanced and saw Dark Knight, Hellmancer, Psyche and all other soul wraiths holding onto Pink.
They pulled him, stretching his body like a bedsheet, all of the wraiths looked bloodthirsty and seemed mad like that big demon itself.
They were releasing broken gurgling sounds, all forms of intelligence disappeared from their eyes and only endless hunger remained.
Together they started devouring Pink’s flesh and soul, biting and tearing him apart. His body was frozen, no matter what he did it all failed inside the domain.
"S- Shouldn’t we help him?" Big Guy gulped, terrified at the sight of those fiendish creatures munching at their colleague.

"That’s... Forget him, he is already working for several organizations, let’s just try to hold that demon here. At least someone should be here from that place." Oracle said through gritted teeth, but in his soul form he wasn’t really of much help.
His life force was getting devoured slowly.
"R- Reeeeedddddd saveeee meeeeeeee!" Pink screamed, taking the form of an old man, finally revealing his secret.
But too bad, Red was already aware of that.
"Die you old disgusting bastard, how dare you wrap yourself around me. You deserve that for putting that smelly ass over my face." Red shouted, at least there was something good about all this chaos.
Pink’s screams continued to ring, but no one came to help him, all of them were busy surviving themselves.
It wasn’t long before Pink got completely devoured by the wraiths, not leaving behind a trace of him, feeling extreme pain till his last moment.
"Sigh He was a good guy..." Red mumbled, respecting the dead before moving to the back of the group to save himself.
"Sir Giant, please hold it for a few more minutes-" Oracle was just speaking when he suddenly felt several gazes fix on him.
Looking to the side he saw that the soul wraiths all had their eyes on him, he felt a chill, the memory of Pink’s death still fresh.
"Alright." Sir Giant nodded and pounced towards Vritra.
"No wait save me firs- uwaaaaah!" Oracle rushed away in haste as Bob and Bobby both flew towards him, while the other wraiths continued with their slaughter.
Their strength had now risen to the level they could kill a lord by themselves in a short time.
Vritra held two demon lords in one hand while Big Guy and Sloth Demon in another, as they went through the same experience as Darius.
They were unable to do anything, while Vritra’s strength was only increasing exponentially.
CRACK
WHIZZZZZZZZZ
Under the effects of radiations, their bodies were going through grotesque evolutions, becoming messier with each passing moment.
All the others were running away from Vritra but couldn’t escape because of the domain.
Aaaaaaah!
Sir Giant hit Vritra with his strongest attack, exhausting nearly 90% of his energy as his entire body turned red and increased in size further.
’I can’t let him go kill innocent people.’
BOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOM
But before his strike could even land, Vritra raised his right foot and stomped down on the smaller giant, creating an enormous hole in the ground.
COUGH
Every bone in Sir Giant’s body was destroyed, his flesh and organs destroyed and body blasted away into several pieces.
But after a few moments, his body once again began to heal as he rushed back, his condition extremely worse.
If he got struck by Vritra one more time like that, then he really might not be able to see his great-granddaughter’s wedding.
Looking back, Sir Giant saw Oracle being chased by the two balls all over the place, and decided not to help him.
Oracle is smart but he is too overconfident in his abilities, always looking down on others and using others for his curiosity.
But now they all had to pay the price for it.
Vritra squeezed his fists further, it wasn’t long before the two demon lords died, and instantly got devoured by the wraiths.
While Big Guy seemed to be on his dying breath, his body in a grotesque and disgusting shape.
A person wearing a white military-type uniform flew closer to Cloud City, surprised at the level of destruction.
On his way he saw countless demonic giants and dragons wreaking havoc all over the place, wherever he passed, those creatures exploded suddenly.
But in the next moment they would regenerate and continue to destroy the cities.
’The situation here is worse than we thought.’ He glanced around but didn’t seem much worried, after taking care of the main target, everything would be resolved.
Initially the Divine Kage organization wasn’t going to interfere with the hunt for the new divine.
Unless of course they all fail to kill him in the long run. Divine Kage group was set up by the said Gods to kill if ever a new Divine appears after all and keep the planet in order meanwhile.
But now the chaos had gone out of hand.
He easily passed through the domain and saw the enormous demonic figure.
"That’s unique, target located. Starting purge."

chapters.title: Chapter 481: Death over and over
paragraphs: The man in the white official uniform was called Sixty. Since the threat level wasn’t high initially, he was sent to take care of it.
He was a part of the Divine Kage organization, the group which was arranged by the gods themselves to kill the new Divine.
They could be said to be the messengers of the said God themselves, with strength far above the lords.
Even if they killed this Divine, a new one might appear in the future. That’s why they had to use the least of their resources in killing Vritra.
"Target locked, starting purge," Sixty muttered. They weren’t human, even if they might appear like one.
The gods made a mess of several souls and then generated their bodies. They barely had any emotions.
Looking directly at the demonic figure, Sixty flew closer and stopped exactly in front of Vritra.
"Get back!" All the others saw the figure. Seeing that uniform, they felt as if they had been blessed.
Hurriedly, everyone stepped back, moving further away from Vritra but not close to the domain wall.
"Now there is no need to worry, the Divine Kage has finally gotten involved." The Oracle, who was about to be devoured by the soul wraiths, felt his heart leap in joy.
With a glance at them, the wraiths were destroyed in an instant, returning to Vritra’s body.
All the giants and dragons made of dust exploded as well, finally giving some time of relaxation to them all.
Sir Giant turned back to his original form, his body shrinking, covered in blood.
"More than several hundred thousand men had already been killed, not to mention big losses like Darius and other lords. The losses are already too big." He sighed. If only Sixty had arrived sooner.
If only Oracle hadn’t done that stupid thing. But there was no point in regretting now; Vritra could finally be defeated.
"Be prepared for punishment, Oracle, leader of the Six Seats," Sixty declared before charging towards the colossal fiend.
BOOOOOOOOOOM
He kicked Vritra’s chest, making the big creature skid across the land as the atomic protection broke and a wound appeared over Vritra’s chest.
But instantly it got healed, and now his full attention was on the white-clothed man.
RAAAAAAAAARRRRRRRRRRRRRR!
Bringing both his hands together, Vritra clapped with Sixty between his palms, but he couldn’t match Sixty’s strength or speed.
Sixty raised his hands and slashed casually towards Vritra’s wrist, releasing a violent blade of air.
WHOOOOSSSHH
BOOOOM
From the wrists, both of Vritra’s hands got severed, falling down and exploding violently.
Big Guy and Sloth, who were both trapped, were finally blown away, but their bodies looked ugly.
Their skin and flesh had melted, organs rotting away. But at least they had survived, though their healing couldn’t undo the damage for some reason.
"Launching final blow." Sixty was almost like a robot working on commands, declaring his actions.
Pulling his arm back at a speed before Vritra had even noticed the damage on his hands, Sixty charged an attack.
Of course, he wasn’t going all out yet, but still had to use nearly 60% of his strength.
"That’s..." The hearts of everyone watching the scene chilled. Only a few of them had seen the Divine Kage in action before.
Vritra was already an unkillable monster for them, yet that monster was going to be defeated so easily?
"Should I leave the demon race?" one of the demon lords muttered. But the Divine Kage doesn’t side with the good ones; they won’t even do anything unless rules set by them are broken.
"Sigh..." Sir Giant fell back. He was happy that now he would be present at his great-granddaughter’s wedding.
But nothing went as he had hoped.
BOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOM!
Sixty finally punched the space before him. A violent shockwave spread through the cities, the space itself trembling.
The violent pressure struck the giant demon’s body. Instantly his torso was blown to pieces, the entire body falling apart.
THUD BANG
Limbs and head slowly disintegrated after falling to the ground in a magnificent display.
The dust storm, demonic figures—everything slowly came to a halt.
"Target purged, returning." Sixty scanned the surroundings and confirmed the kill before turning around and flying away.
But suddenly, blood started seeping out of the ground, rising as if a tsunami was about to strike.
The domain expanded as energy was sucked violently. Within moments, the domain was as big as the continent itself.
The size hundreds of times bigger than before.
Its effect far more deadly, as the bodies of thousands of men instantly began to melt.
All of them felt a lot weaker.
Sixty stared in confusion, wondering if Vritra was alive or if it was some reaction to his death.
The blood rose higher and started to form a figure in the sky. Unlike before, the height was only a bit over six feet.
It resembled a human figure. The pressure rose significantly, the ground over the entire continent cracking up.
The sounds of devils crying again filled the city. It was like countless children, women, and men were all crying at the same time.
"Target still alive, increasing limit." Sixty decided to use full strength, even activating his domain.
Instantly a white sphere engulfed everything in the city. The pressure on Sixty decreased, and he was back to his full strength.
"Engaging in battle."
The figure, which seemed to be made entirely of blood, already took form. The space around it was buzzing with great intensity.
Sixty once again rushed towards Vritra. Like before, he first launched a kick.
But this time Vritra wasn’t slow enough to not even notice his movement. He put his arms in a cross to block the kick.
BAANNNGGGGG!
Still, his body was thrown back over ten meters, arms bending before healing back.
"His strength increased even further?" Oracle muttered, standing beside Sir Giant.
"Just Sixty might not be able to kill Vritra. I feel they should have sent more men," Sir Giant muttered. He helped Big Guy, using his best healing potions.
But the radiations still seemed to be tormenting his body, and the wounds wouldn’t heal no matter what.
Krrrrrrrrrrrrrrrr...
The bloody figure stretched his arms as his hands got covered by a black substance.
"Again." Sixty once again started charging the same attack, as he pulled his right arm back, though with a bit more power this time.
BOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOM!!
The mindless bloody figure tried to dodge but failed. Then he tried blocking it as his body got blown to pieces once again.
His body was torn and fell over the ground, once again everything coming to a halt.
"Death unconfirmed." This time, Sixty waited to see if Vritra was truly dead.
But suddenly, the entire continent got engulfed in a purple light.
Flames rose over the ground, over the rubble. All those inside the domain and even the air itself began to burn with a purple flame.
And within moments, the flames started taking human-like form, standing high in the sky.
"He seems even stronger now..." Everyone felt as if their flesh, soul, and mind would burn to ashes.
"Attackin—"
WHOOSH
The purple figure suddenly vanished, appearing before Sixty and striking out at his face.
BOOOOOOOOM!
Although the man in white was quite surprised, he was still fast enough to react in time. He blocked the attack, taking just a step back before punching even harder at him.
BOOOOOOOOOOOOOOM!
Vritra’s body once again got blown to pieces.
