chapters.title: Chapter 482: Uncontrolled
paragraphs: As the demon made of flames was destroyed, nothing appeared even after a whole minute had passed.
"Danger Sensed!" Sixty suddenly jumped back, his senses tingling.
With a loud explosive noise, the area hundreds of miles around them was blasted as a blurry figure appeared in the sky.
It was made of radiations completely, but it was still not completely formed.
Then flames covered the invisible figure, then dust, then blood, and continued to absorb different form of matter.
Sixty felt the danger rising exponentially, he instantly sent the message back to others.
Then a human like silhouette, whose body was mess of colours just like the domain wall appeared before them.
Everything was silent, as they all got pressed against the ground, except Sixty.
But even he found it hard to move while his domain cracked before exploding.
"Going full power." Pulling a red crystal from his storage, Sixth devoured it.
This was a miraculous gift from the gods, it would increase their strength to the extreme level possible for some time though they would be left in a state of weakness for several years.
Without any hesitation, he put the crystal in his mouth, gulping it.
COUGH
But just as the crystal was in his throat, the terrifying demon disappeared and clutched his throat, stopping the crystal from going down.
"Ughhh cough" Sixty tried to move, but in the next instant his throat was ripped apart, as the crystal got pulled out.
Vritra threw the flesh and crystal away, which were both instantly got devoured by the Dark Knight whose body just got formed.
Unlike others, the crystal had a completely different effect on the wraith as his body started undergoing a strange transformation.
Dark Knight’s strength kept rising, pattern made of red lines appearing over its body.
Vritra threw Sixty’s body away.
He just took a step forward, and an explosion that could easily wipe out a city of two, swallowed the remaining men in the army.
None of them could survive such powerful attack, as everyone in the army except the lords got killed.
An army of more than a million was slaughtered, disappearing without a trace.
"!!!" Sir Giant stared at the destroyed city in shock, all those who had taken part in this war had faced extreme losses.
And that monster kept growing, now even sixty couldn’t handle him.
The whole continent had finally fallen, all the cities, all the houses, everything was gone.
The land filled with magma and radiation, even in the future no one would be able to live there for a very very long time.
"I- Is he unkillable?" Kryn, the leader of the Grieves felt his heart bleed as every grieve got killed right before his eyes.
Only regrets were left now. Such a war could bring big benefits but might also result in complete loss.
Vritra’s body trembled then divided into two, then four and soon there were hundreds of figures just like him.
"We are doomed!" Dago muttered.
What followed was complete destruction, within a few moments, Vritra had already killed the two phoenix emperors, all the demon lords present, and several others.
His clones kept spreading, destroying everything on their path.
His main body held Sixty’s head, before making it explode.
It wasn’t enough to kill him but his regeneration was extremely slow and in his current state, sixty had no way to fight back.
The soul wraiths instantly began to devour his flesh and soul, almost like zombies.
They were devouring all the souls, the levels of each of them had increased rapidly.
One of Vritra’s clone flew towards the ghazi city, causing complete destruction even there.
Out of more than a million, only a few survivors were left.
Sixty could do nothing as the soul wraiths began to eat away at his soul and body, pain filled his body and for the first time he felt a new sort of emotion.
It was fear of death.
The soul wraiths soon devoured him completely, killing one of the strongest figure on the planet.
The distant base of Divine Kage suddenly went on high alert, as they all rushed towards that location.
The clone present in the ghazi city punched the empty air, blowing everything away.
The barrier set up by Red which was already on the verge of collapse trembled, cracks stretching all over it.
BOOOOM!
The clone stomped at the ground and continued to rush forward, and finally the next attack broke the barrier.
Vanessa and Diana’s presence could once again be felt, as the demonic figure which was about to blow off sir Giant’s head.
The consciousness that was descending into darkness, suddenly stirred, as he sensed that vanessa was still alive.
But Titan Fall had already been activated, and it was just impossible to deactivate it until the planet had fallen and the host had disappeared and forgotten completely.
Vritra threw unconscious sir giant away and made all his clones explode, forcefully trying to awaken his consciousness.
He knew if things continued then he might end up killing his own family, but getting his body back seemed impossible.
ROOOAAAAARRRRRRRRRR
He roared before flying towards the sky, only a few figures were left on the ground, barely alive.
Out of the four emperors only dago was left alive.
Nine Pacts was completely wiped out, not a single member was alive now, of course only the ones who had come to the war.
Kryn was alive, only sloth, the fat demon was alive though in a really bad shape.
Out of the six seats, Big guy was in a terrible state, Oracle’s soul was almost devoured, Pink was dead, tin and vin were dead, and Sir giant was also in a bad shape.
Most of the dragons were killed too.
But suddenly the destruction stopped, all soul wraiths disappeared. Vritra fly higher and higher, trying to stop himself.
The two pages carrying Maeve and Yennefer, inside which time was frozen had travelled hundreds of thousands of miles.
Maeve could still not do anything but as Vritra began to fight himself, Yennefer, using Null finally managed to break free.
"What happened? Why did husband send us away?" Yennefer had a really bad feeling about this, she touched the bracelet at her wrist and tried to stop the negative thoughts.
"I have to go back." Looking around, although the place looked exactly the same as before but Yennefer knew she was inside Vritra’s dimensional book’s page.
With all her might she began to strike the ground, the space around her, causing as much destruction as possible.
And under the constant barrage, it didn’t take long before cracks appeared in the space.
Using that moment, Yennefer used Null to teleport back into the real world.
She was shocked to find herself so far away from the Ghazi city, after sensing the direction, she flew back at full speed.
Even from such a distance she could see that the whole continent was obliterated, constant explosions sounding from there.
But she was only worried about Vritra, he had just witnessed the death of his mother, and now he was fighting all those lords all alone.
Gritting her teeth, Yennefer kept teleporting forward while moving the fastest she could.
"Husband, just wait a little for me."
WHOOOSH

chapters.title: Chapter 483: God’s Punishment
paragraphs: The message from Sixty was sent to all the members of the Divine Kage organization, that he had already dealt with the new Divine.
But it wasn’t long before he sent another message, asking for help.
Yet before help could be sent out, they all sensed that Sixty had been killed.
There were exactly hundred members in the Divine Kage, and all of them were spread over different parts of the planet.
So just as Sixty had died, not all members could go there in time, only the bases which were close enough could go there to clear the threat.
Still exactly thirty nine members gathered, the highest among them being number Fifty.
The others were too far, spread in different realms and busy with various challenges.
But still they were sure, those men alone would be enough to deal with a new Divine, since he was still in the early stages of his growth.
Not to mention, number Fifty was going there too, who could even use the god’s power once.
A power similar to what had almost killed Yasmine before.
So they had full confidence of winning, even if things went wrong somehow, they would still be able to escape with their abilities.
The group of thirty nine members gathered outside the continent, they couldn’t see inside since it was all covered by the strange domain that had spread over such a large distance.
"There is actually someone who could summon a domain this big?" Number Fifty was completely different from all below him, he seemed more humane though he was far from one.
All the men were dressed in the same white clothes which looked like an officer uniform, only number Fifty’s was different with a different pattern over his chest.
One of the men flew ahead and stood beside their temporary leader, asking in an almost robotic tone.
"Should we try to break it?"
"Hmm..." Going closer to the domain wall, Fifty touched the strange surface, instantly feeling pain in his arm.
His skin, flesh and bone suddenly started to rot, and he felt weakened.
Pulling his arm back, he shook his head and commanded: "There is no need to waste your energy on this, I have something to deal with this."
Just as he spoke, he took out a metallic heavy shield.
Looking back, he pointed at one of the men and instructed: "Your only job inside is to hold this shield high and fill it with your mana, don’t stop or let this shield separate from you."
"Yes Fifty." Nodding, the man took the shield and began channelling his mana inside it, instantly all thirty nine of them got covered by a faint barrier.
The spherical covers wouldn’t protect them physically but it would greatly reduce the effect of the domain.
"Let’s enter." Finally the group entered, and was shocked by the condition of the continent.
It was in complete ruin.
"I heard the new Divine isn’t evil, so why would he destroy the whole continent?" Fifty paused for a moment and questioned.

"Fifty, we received a report that it all happened after Oracle from the Golden Moon killed his mother, making him go berserk and... he burned down the whole continent." One of them gave the report they had received from Sixty, even telling about the death of so many lords and armies.
"Hmm Oracle..." Fifty nodded, and finally the group flew inside, within moments arriving inside the Cloud City.
The condition there was even worse, bodies rotting all over the place, the land covered with magma, radiations and other sorts of energies.
"There he is, target locked. Waiting for command." One after another they all said the same thing as they gazed up at the demonic figure who looked quite strange and was acting weirdly.
"What is he doing?" Fifty just stared at Vritra for a few moments, then he commanded:
"You, help all these remaining people out of here and return at the earliest."
"Yes Fifty." One of the Divine Kage instantly took all the injured men out of the continent.
Meanwhile, in the sky, Vritra found it hard to stop himself from causing further destruction.
It was as if he hadn’t slept for weeks and now he had to try with all his might to stay awake, while lying on the bed comfortably.
He tried to deactivate the skills but couldn’t, he tried to dispel the deadly energy from around his body, yet failed.
Suddenly he sensed several presences arriving near the ground.
He looked down and saw many figures dressed in white, and Vritra once again lost the control of his body.
BANG
Kicking the air he flew at full speed towards the group, punching a man, his fist burning with extreme energy.
BOOOOOOOOOOOM
Fifty arrived in front of Vritra just in time, blocking the punch with both his hands as he got smashed into the ground.
Creating a human shaped crater.
"His strength is higher than I expected, CHARGE!" Fifty climbed out of the ground and commanded, dusting off his clothes before attacking Vritra as well.
Unlike Sixty none of them let their guards down, using their greatest abilities and treasures.
Yet most of them could barely survive against Vritra’s attack.
The man holding the shield, sensing Vritra’s punch descending upon him, hastily and instinctively raised the shield he was holding.
"Nooo! Get away!" Fifty shouted, while trying to get closer yet he was a moment late.
"Uh oh, Detected mistak-"
DOOOOOOOOH
The shield stopped the attack but for a moment, it broke into countless pieces as the punch landed over his chest.
All of them instantly got affected by the effects of the domain, their bodies weakening and slowly rotting.
COUGH
The man got blown several kilometres away, most of his torso blown away.
But thanks to the shield his life was safe, for now.
"Ugh I don’t have more of that artifact, try to hold him back for twenty seconds." Fifty said and flew back.
Then he took out a token from his storage, holding it tight and poured all his mana into it.
The token began to light up with a bright white colour, spreading throughout the city.
The remaining thirty eight men all faced Vritra, using their teamwork to somehow protect themselves against that monster.
His strength clearly far surpassed even all of their combined, not even Fifty would be able to handle him now.
Their only chance of victory was by using the token of God’s punishment, though the god himself receives punishment for meddling directly after it.
Just like what happened in Yasmine’s case.
And the person using it might be killed as well by the god himself.
But if they could kill the Divine it was all worth it.
Vritra sensed the dangerous energy in the token, his body moved on its own, trying to break it before Fifty succeeded.
But all the men launched a combined attack, using all their strength to push him back.
And that was all the time that Fifty needed, the token disintegrated into tiny pieces and spread through the air.
A bright light filled the sky, clouds disappearing completely.
Then one extremely big finger, big enough to destroy a city with just pressure, descended towards Vritra.
It was a direct attack from the god and no one on the planet stands a chance against it.

But still they were sure, those men alone would be enough to deal with a new Divine, since he was still in the early stages of his growth.
Not to mention, number Fifty was going there too, who could even use the god’s power once.
A power similar to what had almost killed Yasmine before.
So they had full confidence of winning, even if things went wrong somehow, they would still be able to escape with their abilities.
The group of thirty nine members gathered outside the continent, they couldn’t see inside since it was all covered by the strange domain that had spread over such a large distance.
"There is actually someone who could summon a domain this big?" Number Fifty was completely different from all below him, he seemed more humane though he was far from one.
All the men were dressed in the same white clothes which looked like an officer uniform, only number Fifty’s was different with a different pattern over his chest.
One of the men flew ahead and stood beside their temporary leader, asking in an almost robotic tone.
"Should we try to break it?"
"Hmm..." Going closer to the domain wall, Fifty touched the strange surface, instantly feeling pain in his arm.
His skin, flesh and bone suddenly started to rot, and he felt weakened.
Pulling his arm back, he shook his head and commanded: "There is no need to waste your energy on this, I have something to deal with this."
Just as he spoke, he took out a metallic heavy shield.
Looking back, he pointed at one of the men and instructed: "Your only job inside is to hold this shield high and fill it with your mana, don’t stop or let this shield separate from you."
"Yes Fifty." Nodding, the man took the shield and began channelling his mana inside it, instantly all thirty nine of them got covered by a faint barrier.
The spherical covers wouldn’t protect them physically but it would greatly reduce the effect of the domain.
"Let’s enter." Finally the group entered, and was shocked by the condition of the continent.
It was in complete ruin.
"I heard the new Divine isn’t evil, so why would he destroy the whole continent?" Fifty paused for a moment and questioned.

"Fifty, we received a report that it all happened after Oracle from the Golden Moon killed his mother, making him go berserk and... he burned down the whole continent." One of them gave the report they had received from Sixty, even telling about the death of so many lords and armies.
"Hmm Oracle..." Fifty nodded, and finally the group flew inside, within moments arriving inside the Cloud City.
The condition there was even worse, bodies rotting all over the place, the land covered with magma, radiations and other sorts of energies.
"There he is, target locked.
Waiting for command." One after another they all said the same thing as they gazed up at the demonic figure who looked quite strange and was acting weirdly.
"What is he doing?" Fifty just stared at Vritra for a few moments, then he commanded:
"You, help all these remaining people out of here and return at the earliest."
"Yes Fifty." One of the Divine Kage instantly took all the injured men out of the continent.
Meanwhile, in the sky, Vritra found it hard to stop himself from causing further destruction.
It was as if he hadn’t slept for weeks and now he had to try with all his might to stay awake, while lying on the bed comfortably.
He tried to deactivate the skills but couldn’t, he tried to dispel the deadly energy from around his body, yet failed.
Suddenly he sensed several presences arriving near the ground.
He looked down and saw many figures dressed in white, and Vritra once again lost the control of his body.
BANG
Kicking the air he flew at full speed towards the group, punching a man, his fist burning with extreme energy.
BOOOOOOOOOOOM
Fifty arrived in front of Vritra just in time, blocking the punch with both his hands as he got smashed into the ground.
Creating a human shaped crater.
"His strength is higher than I expected, CHARGE!" Fifty climbed out of the ground and commanded, dusting off his clothes before attacking Vritra as well.
Unlike Sixty none of them let their guards down, using their greatest abilities and treasures.
Yet most of them could barely survive against Vritra’s attack.
The man holding the shield, sensing Vritra’s punch descending upon him, hastily and instinctively raised the shield he was holding.
"Nooo!
Get away!" Fifty shouted, while trying to get closer yet he was a moment late.
"Uh oh, Detected mistak-"
DOOOOOOOOH
The shield stopped the attack but for a moment, it broke into countless pieces as the punch landed over his chest.
All of them instantly got affected by the effects of the domain, their bodies weakening and slowly rotting.
COUGH
The man got blown several kilometres away, most of his torso blown away.
But thanks to the shield his life was safe, for now.
"Ugh I don’t have more of that artifact, try to hold him back for twenty seconds." Fifty said and flew back.
Then he took out a token from his storage, holding it tight and poured all his mana into it.
The token began to light up with a bright white colour, spreading throughout the city.
The remaining thirty eight men all faced Vritra, using their teamwork to somehow protect themselves against that monster.
His strength clearly far surpassed even all of their combined, not even Fifty would be able to handle him now.
Their only chance of victory was by using the token of God’s punishment, though the god himself receives punishment for meddling directly after it.
Just like what happened in Yasmine’s case.
And the person using it might be killed as well by the god himself.
But if they could kill the Divine it was all worth it.
Vritra sensed the dangerous energy in the token, his body moved on its own, trying to break it before Fifty succeeded.
But all the men launched a combined attack, using all their strength to push him back.
And that was all the time that Fifty needed, the token disintegrated into tiny pieces and spread through the air.
A bright light filled the sky, clouds disappearing completely.
Then one extremely big finger, big enough to destroy a city with just pressure, descended towards Vritra.
It was a direct attack from the god and no one on the planet stands a chance against it.

chapters.title: Chapter 484: The Knight
paragraphs: Yasmine who was locked, sensed the familiar energy.
"A god’s energy?" It wasn’t from a demon god but the power in the attack was quite similar, she became even more restless.
Even with his current strength there was just no way for Vritra to survive such an attack.
She knew that these beings called Gods certainly weren’t the ones to create the world, but they were certainly the ones managing everything on the planet.
"Hubby..." She could only feel sad at their fate, after all that struggle, is that how they die?
But at least she was together with him, so facing a god’s attack wasn’t as terrifying this time around.
Vanessa had also died, or so she believed, so maybe it was fine.
All the Divine Kage members moved as far away as possible, of course they weren’t facing any sort of pressure.
Whereas Vritra was frozen in the air, unable to move away as the enormous finger descended towards him.
It had covered the entire sky and seemed as if the world was going to end.
Huddling together in a group, all the men watched as the god attacked.
"This is the first time I am seeing the God’s punishment, since the new divine would be killed, will I still be punished by the god?" Fifty wondered, but he had accepted his fate.
Dying for them wasn’t as bad after all, their souls could easily be resurrected, so they just change from one form to another.
The only loss is their strength, directly from fifty he would be dragged to number hundred.
Wherever the finger passed, the space cracked, the sky had become a mass of white light.
WHOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOO
It moved at extreme speed, travelling a vast distance within moments as it soon got closer to Vritra.
Trapped in his mindless state, Vritra could barely control his mind or body.
His body instinctively trembled, if he was struck then he would certainly be killed.
It was like a kid standing in front of the fastest moving train, trying to stop it from front at its fastest speed.
Of course he would be flattened.
Everyone on the planet felt that attack, changing the climate all over.
Going over the list of all his skills, there was just one which could deal very high damage.
The Nuclear Fist.
Using all his might, Vritra urged himself to activate this skill, he wasn’t sure if it could face a god’s attack or not but there was no other choice.
GRRRAAAARRRRRRRRRRR!!
Letting out a roar towards the finger, he pulled his arm back, his body trembling under the pressure.
[Nuclear Fist Activated!!]
[Used: 1967.34% Charged!]
Suddenly, Vritra’s right arm glowed with a blinding light, colour changing from white to yellow then red and finally black.
A vast mass of energy surrounded it, making his veins bulge.
The space trembled, faint lines spreading around him.
Its power rising rapidly.
From the distance, the group of thirty nine sensed the energy swirling around Vritra, their eyes widening in bafflement.
How could someone possess that sort of destructive energy.
Just how could Vritra have grown this much in such a short time.
There was the god’s punishment on one side, and on the other side a Nuclear Fist.
The world seemed to distort between them even before the two attacks had met.
Vritra’s body would certainly have been torn to shreds while handling that much energy had it not been for his physique.
One side of the world was completely white while the other black.
RRRAAAAAAAAARRRRRRRRRRRRRRRR!!
Swinging forward with all his might, Vritra punched towards the finger that was over a few hundred meters above his head.
BOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOMMMM!!
Instantly, Vritra’s body got blown into the ground, creating an extremely large hole just because of the recoil.
An enormous fist twisted, carrying death, it charged towards the blinding finger.
Even before the two attacks had collided, the surroundings were in disarray.
The bodies of the white clothed men were getting blown back, each of them shocked.
Just as the finger and fist collided, it seemed the world had gone silent. No one could see or hear anything.
The space was trembling violently, as if it might collapse at any moment.
And finally, chaos and destruction swallowed everything as the two energies collided.
For a few moments, the attacks just paused, unable to move back or forth.
Then the finger began to push down while extremely big explosions kept taking place.
Vritra couldn’t move one bit, there was immense pressure on his body, making him feel so much pain in a long time.
But the men in white were in even worse conditions, just by the shocks of those two attacks clashing, their bodies were getting destroyed.
They too couldn’t move.
’K- Knight...’ Vritra had a better grasp of his mind now, as he called out.
The shadowy figure understood its master’s order as it flew towards the group of men.
Its body was in a shadow-like form, unaffected by the pressure of the destructive energy in the space.
Reaching the group, it swung its sword around with urgency, the enormous blade was glowing with different colours.
It was covered with Vritra’s energy, making it extremely sharp.
While the men were unable to move, the dark knight slashed at their bodies horizontally exactly once.
And one by one, Knight chopped all of them into two, though cutting Fifty was a little difficult.
As the two attacks continued to rage on, swallowing everything, dark knight finished cutting them all.
The space was filled with mixture of the extreme destructive energies, making it impossible for any of them to defend, run or even scream.
Dark knight opened its mouth wide and swallowed all the souls, but instead of absorbing them, it kept the souls for now.
There was another purpose behind his attack.
In the distance, Yennefer who was rushing towards the continent was shocked as the colour of space around her changed.
Then she saw the two enormous attacks, even from so far away, just aftershocks resulted in her speed decreasing.
"What sort of fight husband is involved in? W- Was that attack actually launched by him?" she muttered in shock, and then increased her speed.
Although the dark fist seemed extremely deadly, the god’s punishment still seemed to have an edge over it.
Just like in that abandoned city, she felt so powerless, unable to help him when he is facing such danger.
Still she didn’t stop, continuing forward, ready to die with him if she has to.
After devouring the souls, dark knight covered the seventy eight pieces of flesh with its shadow and flew back towards Vritra.
The blurry dark shadow appeared before him, stretching its arm, Knight touched his shoulder.
Then Nihilanima burst forward, wrapping around dark knight before covering the corpses.
Vritra had to expend a vast amount of energy, after the task was done, Nihilanima weakly returned and began to rest.
Done with this task, dark knight transformed back into a shadow and flew higher towards the two attacks, despite the danger.
After getting close enough to the gigantic destructive fist, dark knight’s body started to wither.
Without wasting a moment, Knight threw all the corpses high into the sky, as they disappeared into the mass of energies.
Finally dark knight disappeared, returning to Vritra.
Enduring the pain, Vritra called out in his mind:
’Explode...’

chapters.title: Chapter 485: The Last Kiss (FINAL!!)
paragraphs: Corpse Explosion...
BOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOM!
It was like a chain reaction, just as the corpses of all the white-clothed men exploded, the finger and fist exploded at once.
An enormous cloud of extreme destructive energy spread, swallowing everything up.
The ground disappeared, the sky filled with cracks, and all that was visible was destruction.
The Quartz continent and a big land around it completely disappeared, leaving behind an enormous hole thousands of meters deep.
Yennefer, who was still quite far away, was blown back, though she didn’t get injured.
Trees all over were pulled off and flew away, the attack was stopped but it was still very deadly.
Vritra was directly hit by so much energy, even his Suck! Suck! Suck! couldn’t do anything.
All his protective layers broke one after another.
Although because of his Divine Physique, his body remained intact, this energy hit more than just the body.
There was only destruction for a couple of minutes and finally things began to subside as the energy dissipated.
Vritra lay thousands of meters deep inside the pit, his body covered in countless cracks as if he was falling apart.
The Titan Fall had finally stopped but...
Vritra was no longer breathing, his hearts stopped thumping as every sign of life disappeared.
His body was still getting scorched by the mess of destructive energy, seeping inside slowly.
His eyes were closed, wind breezing past him...
The war had finally come to an end, although Vritra managed to protect his family, but against overwhelmingly powerful beings, even he couldn’t survive.
Yasmine had survived but she too received some damage, falling into slumber, yet the broken connection still made her heart ache.
She could feel the eternal separation.
[Initial condition met.]
[You have died.]
[Obtained the Scroll of Novar.]
Suddenly a scroll began to float on top of Vritra’s corpse, glowing brightly.
Sir Giant, Han, Sloth, and many other survivors looked in bafflement at the disbelieving sight.
"T- That... what was that just now? Wasn’t it the God’s Punishment?" one of the remaining Phoenix Emperors mumbled.
"Yeah, but did that demon use the other attack?! He had that kind of power?" Oracle spoke in bafflement.
"Surely, he must have died right?" Red asked, he was still frightened.
After all, Vritra must still believe that Vanessa had died because of him. They had kidnapped her and tried to blackmail him.
Even though it was all just a setup, and he didn’t even know where Vanessa was.
"Yeah he must already be dead." Sir Giant sighed, again wondering if these so-called gods were truly the good ones.
If the people had not been shifted in advance and the God’s Punishment was launched, would they have stopped to protect all the population?
Or just slaughtered them all to kill one person.
"Let’s go and check, we have to make sure he is dead. Otherwise it will all be for naught." Oracle said.
He was sure that even if Vritra wasn’t dead, he would at least be in a very bad shape, so he wouldn’t be so dangerous.
"That’s enough, we have already done enough, let’s just leave." Sir Giant didn’t want to get involved in this one-sided fight anymore.
"Sir, we have to do it, otherwise who knows what he will do in the future if he were to survive.
He surely hates everyone, if he somehow survived, then he would slaughter everyone, even kids..." Red added, too afraid to go there without Sir Giant.
"Sigh, that was the God’s Punishment. Whoever it is locked on will surely die even if they somehow escape from all that energy."
Sir Giant shook his head, getting to his feet.
After drinking various sorts of top healing potions, most of them were in a better condition, though not good enough for another fight anytime soon.
"But sir, we will see and leave, nothing else definitely!! Don’t forget it is still your duty to remove any future danger as a member of the Golden Moon.
If you help one last time, then you can leave the organization." Oracle said.
All of them urged, and Sir Giant finally had to give in.
It was just to see it, there was a high chance that there wasn’t even a corpse left.
Soon all of them flew towards the place where Cloud City was located.
Within moments they arrived, shocked at the condition of the whole place. Everything had been obliterated.
"T- There!! Vritra’s body didn’t get destroyed despite all that, just what sort of physique does he possess?" Pointing at Vritra’s corpse, someone mumbled.
"Hmm, but what is that scroll floating above him?" Han pointed and questioned.
"W- Whatever that is, we have to make sure he is dead, let’s attack him together!" Oracle suggested, just the sight of Vritra made him shiver in fear.
"ENOUGH!" Sir Giant glared at them all. Vritra was clearly dead, there was no point in doing anything more.
WHOOSH
A strong gust of wind breezed past them, and then Yennefer appeared before Vritra.
With a thud she fell to her knees, staring at him with an empty gaze, her heart nearly stopping.
"She... Should we kill her?" the Phoenix Emperor spoke.
"Try it!!" Yennefer turned her gaze, madness and extreme bloodlust making them shiver.
She wanted to kill everyone, destroy everything, as the feeling of hollowness consumed her.
She couldn’t even process any emotions, intense pain building in her chest.
"Leave!" Sir Giant said, looking at them, and finally all of them had no choice but to leave.
Within moments, everyone but Sir Giant and Han had left.
"Y- Yennefer, I-" Han took a step forward, feeling sad seeing her look so broken.
But she didn’t even look back, pulling Vritra close to her with trembling hands as her gaze became blurry with tears.
"You too." Sir Giant said, patting Han’s shoulder.
"..." Han looked at her for a few moments before finally turning and flying away.
"..." Sir Giant sighed, seeing the previously cold and heartless woman filled with sadness and grief.
"I am sorry..." In the end, that’s all he could say before leaving the two alone.
His strength was just insignificant; nothing he could do against the plans those mighty beings had created.
He knew from the start that Vritra wasn’t a bad person, that’s why he didn’t fight properly from the start.
But he was just there to avoid their wrath.
Finally, only Yennefer and Vritra were left in a seemingly endless pit.
Warm tears rolled down her cheeks, falling over Vritra’s face as she stared at him, denying the reality.
There was no way that her love could be separated from her just like that, it felt like a sick nightmare.
But feeling his cold skin against her, the motionless body in her arms, Yennefer was filled with endless rage.
What had he even done to deserve any of this? Called into this world without his permission.
Then going through so much pain, facing death again and again, while he just wanted to survive, to live with his family.
She wanted to slaughter all beings, the gods, fate itself.
"Husband..." she hugged him tighter, sobbing and begging just so everything could change, just so he could come back to life.
But there was nothing now that could be done. Even if she somehow reversed time, she couldn’t protect him.
As the reality started sinking in, Yennefer drowned in sadness, crying loudly as her twisted voice reverberated.
She kept calling out to him but there was no response. He wouldn’t call her Yenni again, he wouldn’t hug her back no matter how much she called him.
Yennefer felt incomplete, unable to imagine her life without the one person she loved the most.
For more than an hour, she just kept crying, sobbing with Vritra in her arms.
"T- There sob has to be some way, Null... I have to use that." Her control over Null was nowhere as good as Vritra’s.
Since it wasn’t her field, if she tried it her life might just be in danger.
Then she finally noticed something floating above them. She pulled the scroll and read it.
Her eyes brightened up, then dimmed. She clutched it tightly and then turned to Vritra.
"Husband, I will save you no sob matter w- what..." Slowly she got to her feet, hugging Vritra tightly as she flew away.
This scroll was from the Divine. If what was written is really true, then she just might be able to revive him.
But Yennefer was still grief-stricken, since still they wouldn’t be together, but she would still choose this option no matter how many times she had to make this choice.
After following the direction given on the scroll, she soon arrived in front of a cave, far away from the Quartz Continent.
Heading inside, she kept walking for hours. And finally, a bright door appeared in front of her; it was a sort of portal.
Yennefer hurriedly passed through it, and only saw a large pit in front of her.
Just as instructed, she threw the scroll into the pit and waited, her arms tightly wrapped around Vritra.
Within moments, a milky-coloured liquid started filling it up and soon the large pit was full of that liquid.
"Husband, maybe not in this life, but we will definitely be together in all our next lives. And don’t get yourself in danger again, also let me keep my status as your fifth wife."
While speaking softly to him, Yennefer slowly began to walk into the milky fluid.
The touch of the fluid made her feel extreme pain as the body touched with that fluid began to disintegrate her body.
"I love you, husband, and always will." Softly pressing her lips against his, Yennefer shared her last kiss.
Before finally the two got swallowed by it.
And together, their bodies faded away...

"Yeah he must already be dead." Sir Giant sighed, again wondering if these so-called gods were truly the good ones.
If the people had not been shifted in advance and the God’s Punishment was launched, would they have stopped to protect all the population?
Or just slaughtered them all to kill one person.
"Let’s go and check, we have to make sure he is dead.
Otherwise it will all be for naught." Oracle said.
He was sure that even if Vritra wasn’t dead, he would at least be in a very bad shape, so he wouldn’t be so dangerous.
"That’s enough, we have already done enough, let’s just leave." Sir Giant didn’t want to get involved in this one-sided fight anymore.
"Sir, we have to do it, otherwise who knows what he will do in the future if he were to survive.
He surely hates everyone, if he somehow survived, then he would slaughter everyone, even kids..." Red added, too afraid to go there without Sir Giant.
"Sigh, that was the God’s Punishment.
Whoever it is locked on will surely die even if they somehow escape from all that energy."
Sir Giant shook his head, getting to his feet.
After drinking various sorts of top healing potions, most of them were in a better condition, though not good enough for another fight anytime soon.
"But sir, we will see and leave, nothing else definitely!!
Don’t forget it is still your duty to remove any future danger as a member of the Golden Moon.
If you help one last time, then you can leave the organization." Oracle said.
All of them urged, and Sir Giant finally had to give in.
It was just to see it, there was a high chance that there wasn’t even a corpse left.
Soon all of them flew towards the place where Cloud City was located.
Within moments they arrived, shocked at the condition of the whole place.
Everything had been obliterated.
"T- There!!
Vritra’s body didn’t get destroyed despite all that, just what sort of physique does he possess?" Pointing at Vritra’s corpse, someone mumbled.
"Hmm, but what is that scroll floating above him?" Han pointed and questioned.
"W- Whatever that is, we have to make sure he is dead, let’s attack him together!" Oracle suggested, just the sight of Vritra made him shiver in fear.
"ENOUGH!" Sir Giant glared at them all.
Vritra was clearly dead, there was no point in doing anything more.
WHOOSH
A strong gust of wind breezed past them, and then Yennefer appeared before Vritra.
With a thud she fell to her knees, staring at him with an empty gaze, her heart nearly stopping.
"She...
Should we kill her?" the Phoenix Emperor spoke.
"Try it!!" Yennefer turned her gaze, madness and extreme bloodlust making them shiver.
She wanted to kill everyone, destroy everything, as the feeling of hollowness consumed her.
She couldn’t even process any emotions, intense pain building in her chest.
"Leave!" Sir Giant said, looking at them, and finally all of them had no choice but to leave.
Within moments, everyone but Sir Giant and Han had left.
"Y- Yennefer, I-" Han took a step forward, feeling sad seeing her look so broken.
But she didn’t even look back, pulling Vritra close to her with trembling hands as her gaze became blurry with tears.
"You too." Sir Giant said, patting Han’s shoulder.
"..." Han looked at her for a few moments before finally turning and flying away.
"..." Sir Giant sighed, seeing the previously cold and heartless woman filled with sadness and grief.
"I am sorry..." In the end, that’s all he could say before leaving the two alone.
His strength was just insignificant; nothing he could do against the plans those mighty beings had created.
He knew from the start that Vritra wasn’t a bad person, that’s why he didn’t fight properly from the start.
But he was just there to avoid their wrath.
Finally, only Yennefer and Vritra were left in a seemingly endless pit.
Warm tears rolled down her cheeks, falling over Vritra’s face as she stared at him, denying the reality.
There was no way that her love could be separated from her just like that, it felt like a sick nightmare.
But feeling his cold skin against her, the motionless body in her arms, Yennefer was filled with endless rage.
What had he even done to deserve any of this?
Called into this world without his permission.
Then going through so much pain, facing death again and again, while he just wanted to survive, to live with his family.
She wanted to slaughter all beings, the gods, fate itself.
"Husband..." she hugged him tighter, sobbing and begging just so everything could change, just so he could come back to life.
But there was nothing now that could be done.
Even if she somehow reversed time, she couldn’t protect him.
As the reality started sinking in, Yennefer drowned in sadness, crying loudly as her twisted voice reverberated.
She kept calling out to him but there was no response.
He wouldn’t call her Yenni again, he wouldn’t hug her back no matter how much she called him.
Yennefer felt incomplete, unable to imagine her life without the one person she loved the most.
For more than an hour, she just kept crying, sobbing with Vritra in her arms.
"T- There sob has to be some way, Null...
I have to use that." Her control over Null was nowhere as good as Vritra’s.
Since it wasn’t her field, if she tried it her life might just be in danger.
Then she finally noticed something floating above them.
She pulled the scroll and read it.
Her eyes brightened up, then dimmed.
She clutched it tightly and then turned to Vritra.
"Husband, I will save you no sob matter w- what..." Slowly she got to her feet, hugging Vritra tightly as she flew away.
This scroll was from the Divine.
If what was written is really true, then she just might be able to revive him.
But Yennefer was still grief-stricken, since still they wouldn’t be together, but she would still choose this option no matter how many times she had to make this choice.
After following the direction given on the scroll, she soon arrived in front of a cave, far away from the Quartz Continent.
Heading inside, she kept walking for hours.
And finally, a bright door appeared in front of her; it was a sort of portal.
Yennefer hurriedly passed through it, and only saw a large pit in front of her.
Just as instructed, she threw the scroll into the pit and waited, her arms tightly wrapped around Vritra.
Within moments, a milky-coloured liquid started filling it up and soon the large pit was full of that liquid.
"Husband, maybe not in this life, but we will definitely be together in all our next lives.
And don’t get yourself in danger again, also let me keep my status as your fifth wife."
While speaking softly to him, Yennefer slowly began to walk into the milky fluid.
The touch of the fluid made her feel extreme pain as the body touched with that fluid began to disintegrate her body.
"I love you, husband, and always will." Softly pressing her lips against his, Yennefer shared her last kiss.
Before finally the two got swallowed by it.
And together, their bodies faded away...

chapters.title: Chapter 486: Beginning After The End!
paragraphs: Somewhere far away in the universe, a pinkish pill was moving forward at a high speed.
It smashed into various objects, asteroids and whatnot, destroying them all and continued to flow for who knows how long.
Even getting swept away into various space tears, disappearing into oblivion and crossing the limits of space and time.
Yet there wasn’t a single scratch on it.
Coming out of a spatial rift, it continued to fly forward at a very high speed.
In the direction of its flight, there was a man who was standing over an enormous asteroid, seemingly searching for something.
He had long orange hair and a robust body but looked quite lazy.
"Sigh where is it? Not even this stone has that mineral..."
BANG
Just as he was about to fly away, a round pill hit the back of his head, almost making him stumble.
"OUCH damnit who is attacking me?" The man looked around in anger but in the end couldn’t find anyone.
He even wondered if someone had used teleportation to stop him, but even thousands of miles away there was no one.
"Hmm, is this a stone? Huff stupid stone!" Pushing it up, he punched the pill, shooting it back away into the distance.
The pill broke into two, one part was a tenth of its size which shot into a random spatial rift.
While the other part flew at an even faster speed, disappearing into a space storm.
The bigger pill continued to move from one place to another, going through various rifts and going into a completely different period of time.
While the smaller pill entered a strange cosmic space, wandering around aimlessly before getting pulled towards an injured soul.
It barely had any consciousness and seemed to be fading away slowly.
But then the tiny piece of pill got absorbed into the fragment of soul, before turning into a tiny spatial crack.
The soul got covered by a pink barrier while a part of the consciousness got pulled into the crack.
A tenth of the pill would keep the consciousness in the illusory realm for a year.
And that’s how this soul would survive for an entire year.
While the other piece ended up in a secret realm, where dozens of higher beings were present.
They all surrounded a woman, who was badly injured and poisoned.
Had she not been poisoned secretly, all of them wouldn’t have dared to face her together.
"Don’t act arrogant now, hand over the Mutamorphis stone to me right now and I just might let you live." One of those supreme beings said.
Their bodies were covered by a blinding blur, these were beings who kept even the gods as a way of entertainment.
The woman was too exhausted to even reply, if only she had more time then she could breakthrough and reach a level that could scare all of them away.
But in her condition, just one of them might defeat her.
"This is your last chance, otherwise you will be begging to even turn into a statue." Another man said, over ten of them and all were ready to attack.
’Do I really have to give up...?’ Gazing at all the higher beings, she wondered, but there was no way she would be defeated without a fight.
But just then a broken pill flew towards her. The woman was on high alert, wondering if it was another sneak attack.
Yet just as it got closer, the pill disintegrated, turning into a pink barrier that covered her body.
While her consciousness faded away, as she too went into an illusory realm for nine whole years.
"Huh? What happened?" The other higher beings were baffled, they launched attacks but couldn’t break or even move her.
While she began to use this chance to break through, within a few years she would be in a higher level.
"Nothing is working, at this rate she might survive and even breakthrough." Someone said fearfully.
"Let’s just stay here and wait for a moment when we can petrify her, it would be the end for us all if we let her succeed."
And so, the group just stayed in that secret realm for the years to come, surrounding the woman covered in a pinkish barrier.
While she found herself in a dream realm, a world filled with countless dangers and she was just a normal human.
The houses were broken, there were limited resources, strange monsters lurked all over the place.
Despite knowing none of it was real, she wasn’t one to not put up a fight.
Surviving in this dangerous place, she found the only other person alive there, a dazzlingly handsome young man.
The news of the great war spread across all the places, every race and organization which had participated had faced big losses.
Even the Divine Kage had lost 40 of their members, the grieves, golden moon, dragons, humans, phoenix, demons, all of them regretted being a part of the war.
But it was great news that despite the losses they had actually managed to kill that demon.
That is how they calmed down the public.
Since the entire Quartz continent had been destroyed, not even a stone was left intact.
A big pit in place of the continent, while with all the radiations it was impossible to live there.
But slowly things began to become better. As time passed, the golden moon and all other organizations stabilized.
Humans and others who used to live in the continent moved to a separate place and work to create the new continent began.
It wasn’t easy but with the combined effort, things started looking bright.
The houses were rebuilt, organizations were set up, everything started going back to just how it was.
Of course there were many changes as well.
Nearly a year later, the news of the one remaining phoenix emperor being killed spread, and the phoenix race got a new empress.
Everyone was still shocked by that news, but then, the succubus race made its appearance.
They stopped living in hiding and occupied a big city in the new continent.
Of course as this news spread, quite a lot of people went there to capture the succubus.
But anyone who approached the city of charms with malicious intent was killed.
Even the lords maintained their distance, it was said that the succubus race now had a new empress.
A truly terrifying presence.
And her strength and ability were even better than the previous empress.
There was a major shift in power in this new place, even the six seats of the golden moon were filled again.
Tin, Vin and Pink had died, Sir Giant retired and now only two of the former men remained, Oracle and Big Guy.
As the new continent was set up, then appeared the big problem of choosing the new human emperor.
There were various battles, debates and whatnot, as all the potential candidates did everything in their power to become the new emperor.
But in the end, it was a woman who took on the throne for humanity.
A goddess not only supported by the succubus and phoenix race but even by a mysterious group called the World Information Centre.
The information organization was now more than that, the leader being someone mysterious who established it as one of the biggest powers.
And that’s how after two years of Vritra’s death, Fiona, Vanessa, Diana and Maeve prepared for his return.

chapters.title: Chapter 487: The Yates
paragraphs: The five monarchs refers to the heads of the five strongest planets on the planet.
One family being the Fords, which was previously ruled by Sir Giant, but he stepped down from his position as the monarch.
Allowing his son to rule the family next, but after his son died, his grandson took over the family.
Sir Giant only had one son, but two grandsons and a granddaughter.
One grandson being Darius, who had died not long ago, and the other was Shen Ford, who ruled their family currently.
Shen had two children, a boy and a girl, namely Rich and Tiny.
It was Tiny for whom they had been searching husband candidates through the competitions in all the kingdoms.
Although it got delayed because of the war, very soon, the marriage trials were about to begin.
All five families lived in their own separate realm.
There was another family which could be said to be the strongest of the five, but it had started to decline in recent years.
After the son of the family monarch disappeared.
It was the Yate family. They weren’t even able to participate in the war over two years ago because of ongoing troubles.
Inside the Yate realm, a group of five soldiers wearing heavy armors entered a labyrinth.
"All four of the other families used to be scared of us but now our family has lost all the power and reputation." One of the guards spoke, sighing loudly.
Passing through the labyrinth door, the group of five began to go to the lower floors.
All of them had already cleared all the floors and now needed to go there for their regular inspection.
"Man, if things continue like this, our Yate family will be crushed by others." Another added.
After the son of the monarch disappeared, the monarch used a lot of resources and manpower to search for him.
His wife’s health deteriorated and that was just the start of the decline.
"If only we had a young lord as talented as Rich or those young masters from other families, they are all already so accomplished."
"And our family is filled with those scheming little snakes, ready to kill others and eyeing the next monarch’s position. None of them are even talented." Another mumbled in disappointment.
Checking one floor after another, the group continued forward, soon they were halfway to the end.
"Yeah, it’s already been years since the young master disappeared, it is now time to move on. If our monarch doesn’t do anything, we might have to join another family." Said one of the guards.
It wasn’t long before they arrived at the final floor. Most demons inside wouldn’t bother attacking them, their strength was too high.
"Anyway, nothing we can do about the family situation. What do you say we beat up the final boss of the labyrinth, let us let out some steam."
One suggested, and all agreed. Even the final boss was too weak for them, they would just play around with the boss before killing it.
Without wasting any time, the group entered, and... saw a scene they hadn’t expected.
The corpse of the boss lay there in pieces, still fresh, evident that it was killed not long ago.
"Huh? We didn’t see anyone leaving, so who could have killed it?" The five looked around in confusion before one of them spoke while pointing towards a corner:
"Is that a person?"
"Hmm, there is indeed someone, did he faint after defeating the demon? Did he come here alone or were his teammates killed?" They muttered before getting closer and looking at him closely.
Long black hair, pale and smooth skin, wearing a black outfit which seemed to be giving off a dangerous feeling.
"Oh! I have never seen him around here before, such a pretty guy lived here?" One of the guys muttered in surprise.
"Or maybe he sneaked inside?"
"Let’s just bring him out for now, after he wakes up we will begin our interrogation." After coming to a conclusion, the group carefully picked the guy up and made their way out of the labyrinth.
After putting him in a room under strict observation, they informed their superior.
The monarch of the Yate family sat alone in his room, staring mindlessly into the empty air.
With each passing day the condition of his wife was getting worse, and there was no sign of his son.
If nothing was done, then not only would he lose his wife but even the entire family.
He had long brown hair and a strong body with well developed muscles, his face covered by a big beard which made him appear invincible.
He kept sighing every few minutes, all paths seemed to be closing.
And by now, even he believed that his son might already be dead, maybe some other family had him assassinated.
KNOCK
There was a light knock at the door which finally pulled the man out of his thoughts.
"Sir, we have found a boy in the labyrinth and he um, I think he resembles our young master who disappeared over ten years ago." One of the commanders spoke, pulling out a photo from his pocket.
Every member of the family carried this photo so they wouldn’t end up forgetting the young master, Art’s face.
On the photo was a six year old kid whose entire face was covered by long bangs, his black hair resembling his mother’s.
"Really?!! Where is he? Bring me to him right away." Gunter suddenly got up, in his surprise he knocked off the table and chair.
"Y- Yes, he is currently unconscious and staying in one of the guards’ house." The commander said, then led Gunter to the house.
The two men quickly arrived at the house, and upon entering they saw the young man lying on the bed.
"T- That’s..." Gunter stared at his face, which was half covered by the long hair.
"I- Is he our young master?" The commander asked, though the possibility was extremely low.
’Is this truly my son?’ Gunter couldn’t come to a conclusion, he was way too young when he disappeared.
The monarch wasn’t sure if it truly was his son or not, but he made a choice.
"Yes, finally, I have found my son. This is Art!! Spread the news, the young master has been found." Gunter announced, his voice full of joy.
"It really is our young master Art?!! Y- Yes sir, I will immediately spread this news. And should I tell this to madam?" The commander asked.
"No, I will personally go tell her. Ask the healers to safely bring Art to his room and treat him if he received any injuries." Gunter instructed.
"Yes sir!!" The commander nodded and immediately got to work.
Gunter stared at that face with deep emotions, truly, he wasn’t sure if it was really his son or not.
But even if he was not, he had to do things this way, maybe with this his wife would be saved.
The guy in question was of course Vritra. In the span of over two years, his new body had been successfully constructed.
But his mind still wandered through two of the six truths, finally meeting with the Divine.
Finding how insignificant everything had been, what sort of dangerous beings lurk outside the planet.

"I- Is he our young master?" The commander asked, though the possibility was extremely low.
’Is this truly my son?’ Gunter couldn’t come to a conclusion, he was way too young when he disappeared.
The monarch wasn’t sure if it truly was his son or not, but he made a choice.
"Yes, finally, I have found my son.
This is Art!!
Spread the news, the young master has been found." Gunter announced, his voice full of joy.
"It really is our young master Art?!!
Y- Yes sir, I will immediately spread this news.
And should I tell this to madam?" The commander asked.
"No, I will personally go tell her.
Ask the healers to safely bring Art to his room and treat him if he received any injuries." Gunter instructed.
"Yes sir!!" The commander nodded and immediately got to work.
Gunter stared at that face with deep emotions, truly, he wasn’t sure if it was really his son or not.
But even if he was not, he had to do things this way, maybe with this his wife would be saved.
The guy in question was of course Vritra.
In the span of over two years, his new body had been successfully constructed.
But his mind still wandered through two of the six truths, finally meeting with the Divine.
Finding how insignificant everything had been, what sort of dangerous beings lurk outside the planet.

chapters.title: Chapter 488: The Game
paragraphs: When Vritra died, he found himself in a selfless state, he was present somewhere but could feel nothing.
It was almost like he had ceased to exist, but a part of his consciousness still existed, yet still locked.
Time passed, it wasn’t long before he finally felt warmth as sparkling light enveloped him, dragging his consciousness to a separate space.
At the same time, his new body started to construct.
As the world brightened up, getting filled with all the colours, Vritra appeared back in reality.
There was no body, he could only see and hear, and do nothing else.
He found himself in a rather familiar scene, a group of teenagers were just summoned by a goddess.
Though unlike Vritra they received quite the warm welcome, apparently there had been several previous summonings.
But Vritra’s view was bound to one of the summoned teenagers.
He watched as they trained, killed the demons, and completely got used to their new life.
One of them became a hero, after a long journey, the group fought against a demon lord.
Though they lost at first, they escaped successfully and in the next attempt, they killed the demon lord.
They received great honour, cheers by everyone. Their status was built, revered by everyone.
But it wasn’t long before they disappeared.
Yet everything continued as it was, years passed, and the memories of the heroes became blurred.
The demons remained rather subdued during that time, but once again they began to attack the humans.
And a new goddess summoned another group of heroes, the same cycle repeated.
But this time, other than the main hero, there was another powerful boy.
Growing way faster than the hero and the others, he was the first to kill the demon lord, all alone.
But that didn’t trigger anything and the heroes didn’t disappear.
Vritra’s consciousness remained with that one boy, who continued to grow rapidly.
And finally the hero killed one of the demon lords, like before they received great honour.
Soon, the whole group disappeared from the planet mysteriously.
But this time, Vritra actually got to see the scenes after their disappearance.
They were never sent back to their original planet, but instead appeared before the ten real gods.
Five of which were the good gods and five were the demon gods.
There were eight people in the group, while several had been killed along the way.
Then someone explained about a game, the game which the eight had already become a part of.
The gods were actually the administrators, five were given one planet and the other five were given another planet.
For their respective planet they were the good gods and the other five were the demon gods.
And then the heroes from the two planets would fight, the winners survive while the losing planet would be destroyed.
All living creatures in it would be killed, the planet would be turned into a living stone.
After the group got to know the shocking truth, about how insignificant everything had been, their struggle.
They were given the choice to either participate in the game or just surrender, of course that would mean their deaths too.
Vritra wasn’t able to see the game, but eventually the heroes of the first planet won, though a few died.
Now only four of the previous ones remained, the hero and that talented guy.
The planet in which Vritra was later summoned survived of course, while the other got destroyed as billions of creatures died in an instant.
But even after winning, although their planets continued to survive, the heroes were thrown into even more dangerous trials.
Unfortunately, before they could participate on a universal level, all of them had died.
Or so had the gods believed, as they chose another batch of heroes with regrets.
Though one of them had survived, but transformed into something completely different, a tiny bug.
That was how the Divine came to be.
Divine evolved, secretly became a part of the game, his strength increasing rapidly.
And before long he had strength enough to challenge one of the gods, yet he continued, almost evolving into a higher being.
Vritra even got to see all ten of the gods, getting to know their names, finally becoming aware of one of the six truths.
Yet being protected by the Divine’s protection, he wasn’t harmed.
The Divine united with the 1st Mythic Halo, the Halo of Creation, through which he created various strange and powerful skills.
Though the Divine never became owner of the 1st Mythic Halo, the two beings could be said to be friends.
Halo of Creation wasn’t a flame-like entity, instead it appeared like a silhouette with no particular shape.
This was the story of another of the six truths, the truth of betrayal.
Vritra couldn’t see the entirety of it, but saw that the Divine was killed by the 1st Mythic Halo itself.
"Well well, enjoying yourself?" Suddenly, Vritra’s consciousness drifted back into the nothingness, as the loud voice reverberated.
"Is it the Divine?" Finally he was able to speak at least, as Vritra made a guess.
"Yes, I am the Divine." The same bug, but millions of times bigger, appeared before Vritra.
As his mind was finally in his own control, Vritra couldn’t help but be distracted by thoughts of his family.
He wondered if all of them were safe, also sad that he was separated from them.
Was this how the afterlife was supposed to be?
He hoped his mother and the other women didn’t do anything in their anger, endangering themselves.
Then he got worried about Yasmine, wondering what happened to her and his soul wraiths, the mythic halos.
"Put a stop to your thoughts, you will have enough time to think about all that." The Divine interrupted, his voice ringing directly in Vritra’s head.
"...Hmm so you are the one responsible for this entire event, and so many things that had happened to me?" Vritra finally looked at the giant bug.
"Yes, it is yours truly, the Divine!"
"Thank you for giving me that level of strength." Vritra said, if it wasn’t for the divine sin wheel, his growth wouldn’t have been as fast.
Though with Mutamorphis, he could have survived but he still would have been far from killing a demon lord.
"Oh don’t mention tha" Divine waved one of his legs, but got interrupted.
"You stupid bastard, was it fun toying with my life? Putting me through all that trouble, even announcing to the entire world about my existence." Vritra shouted in anger.
If it wasn’t for that announcement, then he still would be earning millions of sin points in the continent or White Kingdom, growing safely.
"I was just a catalyst in this line of fate, just making things faster for you. If you hadn’t been erased completely, killed, how could you have a new better start?"
Divine said, as if shrugging his shoulder then continued:
"That fate, that body, that soul, all of it was too weak to reach higher levels. Believe me, I have been there.
And I chose the best fate for you, well not me exactly but you were chosen by someone else. She pressured me to make you my successor, and gave you that skill.
Anyway that’s not important. If I hadn’t done that, then you would have grown safely and slowly, but very soon you would have lost two of your lovers."
As the Divine mentioned this, Vritra finally calmed down but then he remembered something.
To trigger this, he needed to die but there was one other condition, a sacrifice.
"Wait, what was that about the sacrifice? Is everyone alright?" Vritra asked in worry.
"They are... at least for now. Anyway, make your choice. I can still make you peacefully return to your planet, where you can live happily with your mother and that red-haired girl.
You might not even remember a thing about this place, and live a long peaceful happy life.
Or be reborn as something far superior to a human, demon, dragon or even me, the Divine. I can only make one of them come true." Divine answered and continued in a serious tone.
"..." Vritra just hoped for the best, hoping that all of them were fine.
There was no way he would part with Yasmine, Yennefer, Maeve and Diana. There was no point in running from this fate now.
"Hoo I choose to be reborn here, but I still have so many questions." Vritra said.
"You do have quite a lot of time, but I don’t. But let me tell you a few things first." Divine then began to explain.
"You have seen the truth of gods, but if you were to use that recklessly, it could bring trouble for you so be careful.
You will become one of the truth itself, the truth of Divine, your existence might bring danger but remember that is how you grow.

And good job surviving so far, I didn’t have much hopes for you at first, but she insisted or rather forced me so I gave you whatever I can. I will come meet you again soon, so hold your questions, and... FUCK THE GODS!!"
Finally the insect exploded, turning into a beautiful firework and soon Vritra found himself sitting in darkness.
His soul and body were currently being created so it was just his consciousness which had taken a form.

"What am I supposed to do now? How long do I have to wait? You troll Divine, at least tell me that!!" Vritra was just surprised at all the new shocking news, but once again he was filled with anger towards the Divine.
He certainly enjoyed torturing him.
"Oh you are all here too?!!" Vritra finally looked back and saw several figures.

chapters.title: Chapter 489: Stealer of Fate
paragraphs: "Oh you are all here too?!!" Vritra finally looked back and saw several figures.
There was the brand new Dark Knight whose body seemed more menacing, red lines spread across its armor.
The knight’s strength had increased greatly after devouring so many powerful souls, while all his soul wraiths had greatly benefited from the war.
And finally he had a new chimera. Vritra had already let the Chimera devour Ghost and Ghoul, since they didn’t possess any useful traits.
On the other hand, the chimera was very powerful and had all sorts of abilities.
Aside from the soul wraiths, there was Yasmine. Of course unlike Vritra, she was in her soul form, healing slowly under the care of Nihilanima.
Both his mythic halos were present as well.
He hadn’t really lost anything, except his life.
"Wifey, are you alright?" Vritra asked. His body was just a form of consciousness now, so he could see, hear, talk and couldn’t do much else.
"Hubby! Why are you like this? What happened after we were hit by that god’s punishment?" Yasmine seemed to wake up from her daze as she worriedly looked Vritra up and down and got closer.
But now she couldn’t even touch him. She wondered if they both had died together and this was the afterlife.
"Yes, well, you had died before and now I died, so we could be considered ghosts but this is not afterlife." Vritra said, reading her mind.
"Hubby, stop joking, seriously what’s going on?" Yasmine asked. She was still shocked by several things such as Vanessa’s death and Vritra’s death.
"First of all, mom is alive and safe in the City of Charms. And yeah, I ended up dead, though I am getting a second chance apparently."
Vritra started telling her about the war and his meeting with the Divine.
"Oh, so you have already seen several of the six truths huh, anyway, it’s great that we can return but I am worried about others more."
They had a long chat, time seemed to be in excess in this place.
"Previously, soon after the hero killed the demon lord, they were pulled into those sick games.
But after I killed the lord, we weren’t called there which means someone else is carrying the fate of the hero." Vritra thought and he didn’t need to think hard about it.
It was certainly that Jack, who was so madly in love with Fiona back then.
"So we wait for him to become strong enough?" Vritra sighed. He didn’t want to think about all that for now.
Moving his gaze back to his dragon waifu, who was in her human form and was just floating around him.
"What are we going to do until my new body and soul are ready?" he asked, still wishing to reunite with his family as soon as possible.
"Hmm, let’s do some training. From the start, you never got good training, you were always rushed into deadly situations." Yasmine spoke, as she stopped.
"What sort of training?" Vritra questioned.
"Psyche can teach you a lot about the glyphs." Yasmine pointed towards the soul wraith who was busy showing special tricks to its new friend, the Chimera.
Previously, when the games were ongoing in the Cloud City, most of those innovative glyphs were made by Psyche.
Psyche was created from the souls of the Grieves, so its knowledge about glyphs was top notch.
And in the war, Psyche had devoured most of the Grieves, bringing its knowledge about the glyphs to the peak.
"Oh that’s right." Vritra nodded. That would certainly be useful.
"Knight can teach you to fight properly, I can teach you about barriers and more, I mean you can learn something from all of us." Yasmine added, the soul wraiths nodding.
"Of course except Bob, Bobby and Chimera." She corrected herself.
And so, Vritra began to spend his time learning about glyphs, barriers, various forms of magic, fighting and more.
Though he couldn’t directly participate, but with his understanding ability, Vritra would get everything by just seeing it once.
Just like that, time began to pass. Thankfully Yasmine was with him, otherwise Vritra wasn’t sure if the time could pass in such a way.
He still missed his women, but could only wait for now. His playful and teasing wife always kept him distracted and happy.
"So how is your training going?" Suddenly, after several months, a voice sounded in Vritra’s head.
A very familiar voice.
"Sigh... you are here again, how long am I to stay here?" Vritra was lying beside Yasmine, who was asleep.
She needed rest but he didn’t.
"Just a few more months. Anyway, you were right in thinking that the lame guy, Jack, got the fate of the hero. And if you wish to take things in control, then you need to steal it." Divine said.
This time only his voice was present.
"Steal it? How? By killing him? And why should I?" Vritra asked, sitting up.

"No, you can’t kill him, or this planet would directly be eliminated in the trial game. And you need to steal that fate, or do you wish to let Jack decide your future? And it will bring you great benefits." Divine patiently spoke.
"Oh..." Vritra now felt how close he had been to getting the whole planet doomed, thankfully he hadn’t killed Jack, or was it fate playing?
"So how do I do it?" Vritra knew there was no point in resisting. He needed to increase his strength even more after all.
"There is a witch, the stealer of fate, you need to steal this ability of hers." Divine answered.
"And how? Where is she?" Vritra tapped over his cheek. He didn’t mind the stealing part but he wanted to be more aware of things happening with his life.
Not just following what others said or going with the flow. That would certainly lead him to doom.
"Finding her is easy, as for stealing... oops, time to leave, I will tell you later." Divine disappeared right after speaking.
"Sigh..." Vritra lay back and fell deep in thoughts.
Divine had hidden this information from him for some reason, but he felt he had heard that name somewhere.
"The stealer of fate, the witch..." After thinking for a couple of seconds he finally remembered.
"Oh right, the Crown of Favourability, the luck treasure I got from Darius through General Sirius.
That crown was the creation of the Unfortunate Witch, the stealer of fate." Vritra pondered but didn’t possess any other information about her.
"Anyway, no need to worry just yet." Shrugging, he decided to rest.
In the outside world, inside the Yate Realm.
The news about the young master Art returning back after several years spread like wildfire.
Vritra was brought back into Art’s room, where several healers began to check upon him.
But they couldn’t find much.
Though one of the old and experienced healers did feel that something was wrong with his soul.
When Gunter heard this news, he brought lots upon lots of soul potions, letting the healers inject it into his body.
The Yate family was quite big. The main family branch consisted of only Gunter, his ill wife and his missing son.
Over time, Gunter had lost his father and brother, though with his strength alone, he still kept Yate as the strongest family.
