He didn’t mind the stealing part but he wanted to be more aware of things happening with his life.
Not just following what others said or going with the flow.
That would certainly lead him to doom.
"Finding her is easy, as for stealing... oops, time to leave, I will tell you later." Divine disappeared right after speaking.
"Sigh..." Vritra lay back and fell deep in thoughts.
Divine had hidden this information from him for some reason, but he felt he had heard that name somewhere.
"The stealer of fate, the witch..." After thinking for a couple of seconds he finally remembered.
"Oh right, the Crown of Favourability, the luck treasure I got from Darius through General Sirius.
That crown was the creation of the Unfortunate Witch, the stealer of fate." Vritra pondered but didn’t possess any other information about her.
"Anyway, no need to worry just yet." Shrugging, he decided to rest.
In the outside world, inside the Yate Realm.
The news about the young master Art returning back after several years spread like wildfire.
Vritra was brought back into Art’s room, where several healers began to check upon him.
But they couldn’t find much.
Though one of the old and experienced healers did feel that something was wrong with his soul.
When Gunter heard this news, he brought lots upon lots of soul potions, letting the healers inject it into his body.
The Yate family was quite big.
The main family branch consisted of only Gunter, his ill wife and his missing son.
Over time, Gunter had lost his father and brother, though with his strength alone, he still kept Yate as the strongest family.

chapters.title: Chapter 490: Magical Treasure
paragraphs: Although Gunter did his best to handle the family’s affairs.
But the branch of the family had started to eye the position of the family monarch, so none of them were happy about Art’s return.
Several people tried to come and visit Vritra in the name of goodwill, but Gunter kept all of them away. He knew very well about their ill intentions.
Days passed after the initial shocking news, then all the people in the family began to question if it was just fake news.
Maybe the monarch did it to put pressure over the members of the family and to decrease the pressure of other families.
Over a month passed just like that, nearly two years and six months since the destruction of Quartz Continent.
It was just the usual day. The healers checked upon Vritra. Whatever sort of potions they gave to his body, he absorbed it all like a dry sponge.
Today, Gunter had to leave the realm and go to meet the Ford family regarding some important matters.
After the regular checkup, the healers left the room, not finding any change in his condition.
They were just baffled how strong Vritra’s body was even after being in a coma for so long. They couldn’t even prick his skin.
One tried and almost got his arm chopped off somehow. No one saw what happened, as a cut appeared over the healer’s arm.
Since then, they had been extra careful with treating him.
It was around eight in the night and the sky had started to darken.
Gunter had stationed several guards to protect Vritra, even leaving behind one of his personal protectors.
But as the darkness started filling the room, a person appeared there out of nowhere.
It was an assassin sent by people from the branch family, they needed to kill Vritra at all costs.
Wearing a black robe, with even his face covered, the assassin took out a knife.
The protector outside, despite noticing the assassin, did nothing.
Just like the branch family, he too felt that letting the young master return would just make the family decline more.
They would turn into a joke.
The assassin was at the general rank, he quickly brought the knife closer to Vritra’s throat.
But suddenly, Vritra’s clothes trembled, then two black hands flashed rapidly.
One of the assassin’s arms got chopped off instantly, and a deep cut appeared on his neck.
"Urrkkhhh cough" the knife dropped to the floor along with an arm, as the assassin stumbled back.
Stifling his sound, he fled out of the room.
And once again, the room was full of silence.
Before the healer could come to inspect, the maids came to clean the room and were shocked to see the arm and blood.
But they cleaned it all off silently.
Gunter had several cousins, and all those cousins had dozens of kids.
Few were talented but most grew up with the arrogance of being a part of the top family.
Which led to them being lazy, corrupt, cowardly and backstabbers, while their parents were busy looting as much as they could with Gunter being busy.
Now, the family was certainly at the bottom of the five, and barely a top family.
A group of two young men and one woman dressed in luxurious clothes headed to meet Art.
The three, who were the children of Gunter’s youngest cousin, wished to silently complete the task that the assassin couldn’t the previous day.
"If it wasn’t the protector then who could have injured butler uncle that badly?" Dray spoke, oldest of the three.
Their father wasn’t aware of the brave act they were going to commit now, but they had to follow their oldest brother’s instructions.
"Whoever it was, we just need to burn this incest there hehe" Ray, the youngest, laughed stupidly.
TAK
Frey hit his head and corrected: "That’s incense, stupid Ray."
"Silence!" Dray stopped them as the three climbed the stairs and soon arrived near Vritra’s room.
"Greetings, young masters." One of the five guards standing outside spoke while all five bowed.
"Is Art inside?" Dray questioned. The three were 24-year-old triplets.
With brown hair and a face too similar to one another, so similar that Frey was having facial hair.
"Yes." The guard answered, the protector was hidden.
"We are here to meet our young cousin, we were so worried about him. We won’t disturb him and just need to see him for a few moments." Frey added, showing a dramatically emotional look.
Ray didn’t want to be left behind so he added: "Yes, so open the door and ask him to come out, tell him we three are here- ouch"
"Quiet" Both Dray and Frey hit him before looking at the guard.
"Uh... Sorry, but I can’t-" the guard had strict instructions to not let anyone from the family meet him.
"I have taken permission from the protector, just open it." Dray added.
"Haa..." the guard looked back and saw the protector nod in the shadows.
"Alright, but please stay away from young master Art." The guard opened the door and the three entered.
"..." After taking just one look at Vritra, Dray put the incense over the table and began to light it up.
"This is a present from my father, it will help him heal." Dray said, while Frey stared at Vritra’s face in surprise and enchantment.
"Brother, w- was he always that handsome?"
The guard tried to stop Dray who was trying to light up the incense with his fire ability but failed.
"Wait, you can’t put it theaa- uwaaah!!" but suddenly, Vritra’s eyes opened, his body jerked as he inhaled a long breath.
COUGH
"Where am I?" After being asleep for over two years, Vritra felt lightheaded, he looked at his surroundings and then at the people in front of him.
"T- T- The young master is awake!!!" the guard let out a shocked scream, before looking at Dray and his incense.
What sort of magical item was this, what healers couldn’t do over several weeks, this young guy did within a matter of seconds.
And on top of that, the incense hadn’t even been lit yet.
"Brother, it worked? Is he finally dead? Don’t worry, this is your afterlife." Ray said, smiling towards Vritra.
"Shut up!!" the three hurriedly left the place with their incense, wondering if the oldest brother gave them the wrong thing.
Vritra ignored them and looked at the guards, repeating himself: "Where am I?"
"O- Oh, congratulations young master Art for finally waking up from your coma. This is the Yate realm." The guard said, while telling the other guards to bring this news out.
"Yate? Art?" The more he heard, the more confused Vritra became.
"Huh? Hubby, did you get reborn with a new identity or something? Or are they just mistaking you?" Yasmine too woke up with Vritra, though her condition wasn’t as bad.
But none of it was important, he wanted to find all his women as soon as possible.
Climbing off the bed, he looked down at himself before bringing out a mirror and gazing at his reflection.
After the recreation, his face certainly seemed to have changed to some extent, it would be hard for others to recognise him.
Though Vanessa and others wouldn’t find it difficult.
"Oh hubby, you look even more handsome, check if it’s just your look or even your strength that has grown." Yasmine said, staring at Vritra’s face.

chapters.title: Chapter 491: Titan
paragraphs: Name: Vritra Arclis
Level:1 (Demi-God)
Class: Dust Lord (Rank: SS) [SSS+(?)]
Title: The Fallen Titan
Race: Titan
Origin Bloodline and Physique: Titan
Merged Additional Origin Bloodline & Physique: Demonic Dragon God {UPGRADE: 200 million Sin Points}, Divine
Essence Core: Evil-Veyll God Essence
Mythic Halo: Nihil-Anima Mythic Halo, Misty Essence Mythic Halo
Weapon: Goop {UPGRADE: 100 million Sin Points}
Stats:
Strength: 10
Agility: 10
Endurance: 10
Intelligence: 10
Mana: 10
Luck: 10
[Allocation points:0]
Vritra read the status in surprise, his level had somehow been reduced to just 1.
At first he felt angry and frustrated, feeling as if all his effort and pain had been for nothing.
But strangely, he didn’t feel any weaker, instead his strength was definitely higher than what it had been before.
Just then, the Divine’s voice sounded in his head.
"Yes, your race now is Titan, and their beginning itself is Demi God level. What you fought before, the Divine Kage members were on the higher phases of Lord rank.
Anyway, I will give you more information related to it later but for now, you can not leave this family, the secret to saving her will be found if you follow along."
And just like always, Divine disappeared without explaining things.
’Save who? Titan, what even is that? A Demi God...’ Vritra just stood frozen, finding it all quite strange.
"A Demi God!!" Yasmine exclaimed as well, she remembered the time when Vritra had just entered the labyrinth’s death trap.
She hadn’t even paid much attention to him in the start, he was so weak but now his strength had risen by such a huge level.
’Wifey, do you know about any of that?’ Vritra asked, feeling confused.
"Not really, it’s the first time I am hearing of a Titan race, but I had heard a little about the term Demi God." Yasmine said before continuing.
"There was once a person before who almost became a Demi God, nearly destroying half the planet."
’Anyway, knowing that could wait, but first I have to find Mom, Yenni, Foxie, Diana and Fiona.’ Thinking this he looked back at the guards.
"Young master Art, how are you feeling now? You shouldn’t get out of bed yet." The healers finally arrived, but they all froze as they looked into his crystal-like red eyes.
"I am fine, what am I doing here?" Vritra asked, his tone and gaze somehow made everyone around uneasy.
He still remembered his desperate moment, how all those people attacked him for no reason, killed the person he believed to be his mother.
Many of them had died already, but there were still some he needed to torture, he wanted to hear them beg, to see regret and despair in their eyes.
Especially that Oracle. Some time must have passed since Vritra’s death and all of them should already be relaxing by now.
Enjoying their time from killing a demon, but it was exactly them who were responsible for the birth of a demon.
Vritra’s way of looking had completely changed, though he still wouldn’t go on a mindless slaughter.
But even looking at the guards and healers, their lives seemed worthless to him.
"Young master Art, you don’t remember anything? You remember your name, right?" One of the healers took a step forward, despite the fear.
While he was in slumber, he looked so serene, peaceful and gentle but now he seemed the exact opposite.
’I... is it really the meek young master Art from all those years ago?’ the oldest healer wondered.
"...No, explain to me in short, what is going on?" Vritra sat back on the bed, wishing to know everything that happened after the war.
The oldest healer took another step forward hesitatingly and spoke: "You are young master Art, the next in line to be the monarch of the Yate family.
You disappeared several years ago, and we recently found you in a labyrinth. After you disappeared, your mother fell ill, and the Yates family had been on constant decline since."
"I see, you know about the war in which several lords died, right? How much time had passed since?" Vritra continued.
"Oh around over two years and a half years." The healer answered.
’So much time has passed?!’ Vritra hurriedly asked: "Do you know anything about the succubus race? Or a goddess? Any big changes after the war?"
"Yes, there have been several major power shifts after the war. The Quartz continent was rebuilt from scratch, and it is nearly finished and now a goddess rules it.
The succubus race also became a part of the continent, I heard they have a new empress who is quite strong.
And... hmm the phoenix race too has a new ruler now. Aside from that, the world information centre has become one of the biggest groups in the continent.
And several dark organizations such as Nine Pacts, Bone Blood Cult, even Grieves and more have become a part of the Twilight.
I think that’s most of it, oh right, the girl from the Ford family, Tiny, her marriage competition will be taking place soon." The healer made sure not to miss anything.
Vritra was nodding, at least now he knew that Diana, Vanessa, Fiona and Maeve were all fine and must have grown considerably stronger.
But then he interrupted.
"Do you know anything about Yennefer?"
"Oh the previous empress? No, she disappeared after the war, I heard she was in cahoots with that demon." Came the reply.
A frown appeared over his face, as Vritra clenched his fists, rage bubbling inside him.
But just the random gesture had a dramatic effect, as the whole building suddenly started shaking.
Tremors travelling through the land and shaking everything nearby.
The people around rushed out of their homes and shops in a panic, even the healers were frightened by the sudden tremors.
"E... earthquake!! Run!!" And so several healers ran.
The guards weren’t as afraid because of their higher strength, so they hastily asked Vritra to move into an open area.
But Vritra just remained seated on the bed, staring at the ceiling as he got a hold of his emotions.
Since his strength had increased suddenly, he would need some time to adjust.
’So the sacrifice had something to do with Yenni?’ Feelings of pain and grief filled his heart, he wanted to destroy everything.
Killing every living person until the whole planet becomes a dead zone.
But Yennefer was still alive from what he had heard from the Divine, and he needed to find her as soon as possible.

"So the clue to find her will be found here? Let’s see the situation here, then I will go and find Mom and others." Vritra wanted to meet them again so badly, but since they were fine now, and he was in a rush to save Yennefer, so it would have to wait just a little.
But he can’t wait more than a day or two.
Standing to his feet, Vritra walked out of the room and started asking different questions about the family to one of the guards.
He also needed to find that witch.
And soon Vritra got the rough idea of most things, unfortunately, the family was far from being at peace.
’Guess I will need to meet Gunter first.’ Vritra said, but he paused as a middle-aged man stepped before him.

chapters.title: Chapter 492: A Good Man
paragraphs: "My good nephew, are you alright? You should be resting on your bed, you aren’t fit to be going around yet or to be ruling the family."
The middle-aged man was wearing rather fancy clothes. His face resembled the triplet Vritra saw briefly a while ago, so it must be Art’s uncle.
"And you are?" Vritra paused and looked back at him. It seemed he would have to first deal with some internal problems.
"Call me uncle Sid. I heard you lost your memories, now go back to your room and rest." Sid said, pushing his hair back.
Vritra ignored the man, turning to the guard he questioned: "Where is Gunter?"
"He is-" the guard began to answer but was interrupted.
A big smirk appeared over Sid’s face. He was trying to show his dominance and he just got the perfect reason.
"How dare you call your father, the monarch, by his name!! It seems you have lost your manners while living outside, let me teach you some manners."
Sid raised his hand, his face full of wildness.
"..." Vritra watched the man moving extremely slowly. He was just at the general rank, that too was spoon-fed to him.
His first instinct was to just make the man explode, but he still needed to find Yennefer, so he held back and went easy on him.
CRACK CRACK CRACK
Vritra remained still as exactly three crackling sounds rang out.
Vritra could now control dust to the atomic level. With just a glance he controlled the countless atoms, as Sid’s arm broke from his wrist, elbow and shoulder, twisting in a strange angle.
Even though he needed to stay here and act like a part of this family, he wasn’t going to act submissive or weak.
That was just beneath him. If such a cowardly man, just because someone a bit strong was backing him, could act so arrogant...
Then why would Vritra, being the strongest here, need to hold back?
He just hated others acting superior to him.
"H- Huh? Uwaaaaaaaahhh my aaaarrmmmmm!!!" Sid instantly fell to his knees, screaming and wailing. When had he ever felt so much pain?
His broken arm was hanging freely, bone piercing out of the skin as soon his fancy clothes became blood soaked.
After crying for a minute, with his face wet with tears and snot, he pointed at Vritra and shouted:
"Y- You, it was you right?! Guard ughhhh what are you doing j- just waiting there? Cough ahhhh my armmm Arrest him now!!"
"Oh uh..." the guards looked back and forth between the two. There was no way they could arrest young master Art, son of the monarch.
Seeing their hesitation, Sid became even more agitated.
"You can leave, I will come find you in a minute." Vritra said, gesturing them to leave. Finally, the guards heaved a sigh of relief, turned around and left in a hurry.
"Stop!! You b- bastard ahhhh at least help me to drink some p- potions." Sid screamed, but the guards ignored him and left.
"How dare ughh you hurt m- me, you useless brat!! You aren’t even a p- part of ughhh of this family, you are going to regre-"
Sid was shocked that the person he thought would be powerless and useless, was so strong.
Initially he believed Art would have to completely depend on Gunter, that’s why he came to put some pressure.
"Sigh You are a good man, but need to be modified a little." Vritra took a step forward, then used his hypnosis skill and charm field.
"W- What are you-" Sid was scared out of his wits but then his body froze and his eyes became dazed.
"Shhh You are now changing..."
Just after a few seconds, Sid blinked his eyes as he finally came to his senses. There was no one around.
He was still kneeling on the ground while clutching his broken arm.
"..." After a moment of confusion, he hurriedly took a few potions, gulping them down.
Only then did the pain disappear.
Finally he left.
"Where is Gunter?" Vritra asked again as he approached the nervous guards.
"U- Uhm he has gone out to meet his friend, and h- he should be back soon." The guard answered.
"Alright." It seemed he would have to wait a little. After getting back to his room, Vritra called out:
"Knight, Hell."
"Yes master." The two wraiths rose before him, each of them alone capable of wiping out the entire Yate family in less than a minute.
"Go and make sure my family isn’t having any problem, but don’t let them notice your presence yet."
The two bowed before disappearing. Vritra just stared into the empty space for a few moments.
Now even without using the Null or his field, he felt a sense of space and time.
He wasn’t yet sure of the extent of his current strength but felt destroying the Yate realm wouldn’t take a moment.
But he wouldn’t be satisfied with just that. His level had returned to 1 and there was no way killing the weaker creatures here would make it budge.
’I guess I will have to steal Jack’s fate first and get into that game to be able to get stronger.’ He thought.
Taking out a bracelet from his storage, Vritra stared at it with longing.
This was given to him by Yennefer. Putting it back over his wrist, he could feel her presence although very faintly.
She was still alive, present somewhere, but finding her might not be easy.
But finally, Vritra would be able to get Yasmine’s body. Now none of the dragons would be a match for him.
After some time, Gunter finally returned to his realm. The reason for his meeting was directly related to Art’s return.
If things went right, then they would have a chance to return to their past glory.
But first, Art needed to wake up for that.
"Sigh I hope it really is Art and he could wake up as soon as possible." Muttering to himself, Gunter put aside his gloves and sat back on his chair.
KNOCK KNOCK
Suddenly there were urgent knocks on his door and without waiting for a response, the same commander burst into the room.
"Sir Sir Sir! Haa H- He..."
"Slow down, why do you look so panicked?" Gunter calmly gestured him to sit down on a chair.
"Y- Young master haa haa he woke up finally!" The commander finally said.
"He is awake!" Gunter stood up suddenly, tossing his chair and table over.
"Let’s go meet him." Gunter said, but without waiting he rushed out of the room.
"Sigh Ask some servant to clean this up." The commander said to a guard before running out.
Within moments, Gunter arrived outside the door. He was about to burst inside but paused.
A strange feeling of doubt filled his heart. What if he entered and an unknown person was sitting inside? What if he couldn’t recognise him?
But after taking a deep breath, he opened the door and stepped inside.
"Wait outside for me." He said before closing the door behind him.
"..." Gunter finally saw the boy seated on the bed. He just looked unreal.
’Was my son that good looking?’ the doubt in his heart increased.
"Take a seat." Vritra gestured, his tone emotionless.

chapters.title: Chapter 493: The Unexpected Reunion
paragraphs: For some reason, Gunter was the one feeling nervous here. Nodding, he sat down, then clearing his throat he questioned:
"A- Are you my son?"
His fists were clenched and sweat appeared over his forehead, the future depended on just this one answer.
"No-" Vritra shook his head as he answered, but he paused as an irritating voice sounded in his mind yet again.
"Say yes, his son was assassinated inside that labyrinth several years back. Art possessed a special trait which was perfect for my plan, which is why I preserved his soul and body.
And when you were reborn, I had to use that core and the ability attached to his soul, which is why you were able to become a ’Titan’, otherwise it would have been impossible.
So, you would help them too right? This pair of poor husband and wife..." Divine went silent, Vritra really wanted to turn off his switch.
"..." The silence stretched, Vritra now finding it hard to choose either of the options while looking at Gunter’s hopeful gaze, so he shrugged: "I don’t know."
"C- Can you show me your mana?" Gunter spoke. Art didn’t really possess any special mark or anything, so the mana was the only thing he still remembered.
Even his face was blurred in their memories somehow.
Raising his right hand, Vritra channelled out mana as a mass of colourful energies suddenly lit up over his palm.
"That’s...!!!" Gunter stood up in surprise.
"Art, you really are Art! My son, sob I have been searching for you all this time, y- your mother, she fell ill after you were gone."
The strong man couldn’t stop himself from crying, he had been acting unaffected for a long time.
But so much had happened and he was truly at his limits, there were problems from outside and even his own family was making things difficult.
"Uh wai..." Gunter hugged Vritra before he could speak, patting his back, he felt like he was holding his little son.
Then taking a step back and wiping off his tears, he spoke in a hurry: "Let’s go, you should meet your mother. I am sure she will be very happy to meet you."
Vritra first wanted to have a serious talk, but he was dragged to Art’s mother’s room.
There were several maids present around the room, guards were also stationed there.
"Greetings, monarch." The maids bowed and opened the door. As their eyes landed on Vritra, they all froze.
"Is that...?" As Vritra and Gunter headed inside, the maids all had lovesick expressions, even the married ones.
He just looked too perfect, even his long black hair looked so good on him.
"Honey, look who is here!" Gunter walked to the side of the bed and sat beside the woman who was in a slumber.
She looked weak, very weak. She was definitely a beautiful woman but now barely seemed to have any life in her.
As Gunter injected some mana into her body, her eyelids twitched, she slowly opened her eyes.
"Honey, it is him..." Gunter said in an emotional tone, helping her to sit up.
"Uh... My... cough" She could barely look or speak, at such a rate, it wouldn’t be long before she passed away.
Sighing, Vritra approached her from the other side of the bed. He took out a potion created by Diana.
It was a high grade healing potion, but that alone wouldn’t be enough to heal her.
So Vritra injected some of his own energy into the fluid, which had extremely good healing capabilities.
With just a tiny amount, her life span would increase by a century at least.
"Here, give this to her, it will help." Vritra gave the potion to Gunter, who took it without hesitation.
He didn’t even question what it was or where he got it, he was just desperate to save his wife and it came from his son.
Removing the cap, he gently pressed it against her lips, letting her drink it in small sips.
The potion would take effect slowly, otherwise her body might not handle so much energy.
Yet after a few moments, her eyes opened, looking clearer.
And within ten or so minutes, she looked considerably better, even her breathing becoming normal.
Her name is Ava, she was from another top family, but ever since Art disappeared, Ava had been extremely sick.
"Who... Art?!!" Finally Ava’s gaze focused on the young man standing beside her, for some reason she was getting a familiar feeling from him.
"Yes honey, it is our son, he is back!! Our Art is back, you have to get better for him."
Gunter felt happy for the first time in such a long while, his family had become complete.
"Art... my baby sob, c- come here." Ava began to cry, stretching her arms towards him.
Vritra sat down on the bed, the woman was too weak to hug him properly, so he just put his arm over hers.
"I won’t let you go again sob forgive me, I wasn’t able to p- protect you before, I won’t let anyone sob sob hurt you e- ever again." She cried, hugging his arm.
After a few minutes, Vritra and Gunter finally left the room, leaving Ava to rest.
With her son’s return and the potion, she would be perfectly fine soon.
"Make sure to deliver proper food from now on." Gunter ordered, since previously Ava had even stopped eating food but now she would definitely eat.
The two left. While walking together, Gunter finally remembered the few things he had ignored before in his happiness.
’Art said he didn’t remember, he lost his memories? And where did he get such a potion? Where had he been all this time?’ With questions in his eyes, he turned to Vritra.
"Let’s talk." Vritra said. After discussing a few things with him, he planned to go meet his family.
Soon the two were seated in an empty room, with a barrier present around, stopping anyone from listening.
"You don’t remember anything?" Gunter questioned.
"No." came the answer.
"Not even me or your mother?" another question.
"No." same answer.
"Sigh Where have you been all this time? Are you alright? How did you end up in the labyrinth?" Gunter continued, though feeling a little sad and hoped his wife wouldn’t be affected by this news.
"I am fine, I... don’t really remember all that much about what happened before or how I ended up there, I just remember fighting a lot of demons, waves after waves." Vritra answered.
"I understand, you should get some rest, you don’t have to worry about anything." Gunter spoke, not wanting to pressure his son too much.
Then he added: "Oh and about the family, I know those bastards want to steal your position, but now, I will put them in their places."
After thinking for a moment, he spoke: "No, it is fine, I will handle that. But first do you know anything about Yennefer?"

"The former empress... No, after that war, she disappeared along with that boy’s body or so I heard, maybe you can find some information from Sir Giant, he was also the last to see her." The monarch answered.
"Then let’s go meet him, this is urgent and I can’t tell you why." Vritra stood up. Being the strongest in the Golden Moon, Sir Giant might really know something.
"Oh actually about that, I did plan to bring you to meet the Ford family for an important reason, which is related to your marriage."

chapters.title: Chapter 494: The Challenge
paragraphs: "Oh, I did plan to bring you to meet the Ford family for an important reason, which is related to your marriage." Gunter spoke, sighing heavily.
"Huh? What marriage?" Vritra questioned in surprise.
"Yeah, I know you have been away for so long and had only just returned. On top of that, you don’t even remember anything, so I planned to bring up this urgent matter later on."
The monarch of the Yate family said slowly.
"That is not important now, ask that Giant if he knows anything about Yennefer’s whereabouts."
That guy was also on Vritra’s list, after all it was him who had stopped him when he was trying to save that clone of his mother.
"Okay, we are going to the Ford family soon anyway. But first we have to deal with the members of our branch family." Gunter said, releasing yet another sigh.
He had not paid them much attention and mostly let them do as they pleased, but he can’t allow such a thing anymore.
Otherwise, they might end up harming his son.
After a moment, Vritra said: "Call a family meeting, asking everyone to come there."
"What do you plan to do?" Gunter looked at him in confusion.
"We need not waste time on them, so I will just speak to them a little." Vritra said.
Gunter stared at his face for a few moments. Since he would also be there, nothing could go wrong.
"Alright, but be careful, those cousins of mine and their children are rather cunning." Gunter said before leaving Vritra alone, arranging for the meeting.
’More than two years have passed...’ Vritra fell back on the bed, closing his eyes tiredly.
"Why did the family head suddenly call for a meeting of this scale? Even the children were ordered to be present."
A big crowd had gathered, seated over the chairs arranged in a circular manner.
"I think it might be related to young master Art, I heard he is already awake. Don’t tell me he is going to announce Art as the next monarch!"
Similar conversations were taking place all over the place.
The strongest cousins of Gunter and Art were the ones who seemed the most unsettled and angry.
But Sid, the middle-aged man who had his arm broken by Vritra earlier, was in a good mood.
Beside him sat his three kids and his wife.
The area between the seats was still empty, neither Vritra nor Gunter could be seen yet.

"Tch, how irresponsible, how could a boy who had been away from home be our next monarch? We would become an even bigger joke if others find out about it. What could be worse than having a monarch like that?"
Sid, who just heard what his elder brother had said, frowned, then jumped into the conversation.
"You know what’s worse than that? Breathing the same air as you, sharing the same realm as you.
I pity the woman who let you put your tiny pea inside her, I pity the child who was created from something out of you. Just seeing your face is worse than anything and you mot... mmph... cker..."
The others were shocked when Sid, who acted like a puppy in front of his elder brothers, suddenly began to curse him for a random brat.
"F... Father, what are you doing?" Fray and her brothers turned pale. Had their father gone mad?
"..." Several of the men around hurriedly stopped Sid, who was about to fight.
"Settle down everyone." But the tension was broken as Gunter’s voice sounded.
"Greetings Monarch." Many bowed, but his cousins remained seated with frowns on their faces.
"Okay, so let’s start with this meeting." Looking around, Gunter continued: "I am sure you have all heard by now that my son, Art, is back and awake."
"Yes, we have. Is this meeting to inform us about Art becoming the future Monarch?" the oldest cousin, who was only younger than Gunter, spoke.
His name was Max, a name Vritra had not heard in quite some time.
"Well, not really. My son will take over the meeting from here on."
Gunter took a step back, as everyone quieted down, while the middle-aged men got ready to barrage the young guy with questions and allegations.
Then all gazes shifted to the person dressed in black, stepping into the centre of the hall.
At first several gasps, mostly from women, sounded as they saw his appearance. It truly enchanted them.
While the men instantly felt jealous, as even their wives or lovers were looking at him unlike anything they had experienced before.
"I am Art-" Vritra just said a few words when Max stood up from his seat, his cheeks burning with rage.

"Before you say anything, tell us, where had you disappeared off to? Where have you been all this time? How can we even know if you are the real Art?" As Max shouted, others followed, filling the hall with noises.
"Enough!" Gunter called, his aura making everyone among the crowd shiver as they finally quieted down.
"I am indeed Art and the monarch here has confirmed that himself. By questioning it, are you doubting your own Monarch?
Or do you wish to oppose his decision? Should it be considered a revolt?" Vritra mumbled, tapping over his chin with his finger.
"Tch, you... Fine, if Monarch said you are Art then we believe you are, but what is the meaning behind this meeting?" Max became even angrier, unexpectedly this young brat was quite eloquent.

"This meeting is just as you had expected, to announce me taking back my rightful place as the next Monarch of the Yate family. Now, if any of you have any problem with it then-" Vritra said nonchalantly.
"Is this a joke? You, Monarch? Hah. Even my newborn would rule a family better than you. How big of a joke would we be called if we let someone as useless and weak be our leader?
Gunter, you can’t let the family be ruined just because of your love for your son." Max shouted.
"Yes, the competition for the next monarch should be fair, and we all know who is best suited to fill that seat." The men all looked at their children.
"We all agree, Art cannot become the next monarch. If he does then he will have to prove his worth and loyalty!"
All of them kept shouting the same thing over and over. Vritra had expected this, their greed was so visible.
"Quiet!" Gunter punched a pillar beside him, glaring at them all, but with this even he couldn’t help Vritra out.
He too wasn’t sure if Vritra really was capable of ruling the family, though with what he had seen thus far, he certainly had the bearings and mind of a leader.
If only he possessed the power to back that up, then none of them would dare speak anything.
But he had been away for so long, so he can’t really blame his son even if he was yet to reach level 100.
"Yes, this needs to be very fair, so anyone among you from my generation who believes themselves to be more worthy of the monarch seat, step forward.
I am challenging you all in a duel. Anyone who could hit me once will be able to take the position from me." Vritra announced.

sentences.text: "Oh, I did plan to bring you to meet the Ford family for an important reason, which is related to your marriage." Gunter spoke, sighing heavily.
"Huh?
What marriage?" Vritra questioned in surprise.
"Yeah, I know you have been away for so long and had only just returned.
On top of that, you don’t even remember anything, so I planned to bring up this urgent matter later on."
The monarch of the Yate family said slowly.
"That is not important now, ask that Giant if he knows anything about Yennefer’s whereabouts."
That guy was also on Vritra’s list, after all it was him who had stopped him when he was trying to save that clone of his mother.
"Okay, we are going to the Ford family soon anyway.
But first we have to deal with the members of our branch family." Gunter said, releasing yet another sigh.
He had not paid them much attention and mostly let them do as they pleased, but he can’t allow such a thing anymore.
Otherwise, they might end up harming his son.
After a moment, Vritra said: "Call a family meeting, asking everyone to come there."
"What do you plan to do?" Gunter looked at him in confusion.
"We need not waste time on them, so I will just speak to them a little." Vritra said.
Gunter stared at his face for a few moments.
Since he would also be there, nothing could go wrong.
"Alright, but be careful, those cousins of mine and their children are rather cunning." Gunter said before leaving Vritra alone, arranging for the meeting.
’More than two years have passed...’ Vritra fell back on the bed, closing his eyes tiredly.
"Why did the family head suddenly call for a meeting of this scale?
Even the children were ordered to be present."
A big crowd had gathered, seated over the chairs arranged in a circular manner.
"I think it might be related to young master Art, I heard he is already awake.
Don’t tell me he is going to announce Art as the next monarch!"
Similar conversations were taking place all over the place.
The strongest cousins of Gunter and Art were the ones who seemed the most unsettled and angry.
But Sid, the middle-aged man who had his arm broken by Vritra earlier, was in a good mood.
Beside him sat his three kids and his wife.
The area between the seats was still empty, neither Vritra nor Gunter could be seen yet.
"Tch, how irresponsible, how could a boy who had been away from home be our next monarch?
We would become an even bigger joke if others find out about it.
What could be worse than having a monarch like that?"
Sid, who just heard what his elder brother had said, frowned, then jumped into the conversation.
"You know what’s worse than that?
Breathing the same air as you, sharing the same realm as you.
I pity the woman who let you put your tiny pea inside her, I pity the child who was created from something out of you.
Just seeing your face is worse than anything and you mot... mmph... cker..."
The others were shocked when Sid, who acted like a puppy in front of his elder brothers, suddenly began to curse him for a random brat.
Father, what are you doing?" Fray and her brothers turned pale.
Had their father gone mad?
"..." Several of the men around hurriedly stopped Sid, who was about to fight.
"Settle down everyone." But the tension was broken as Gunter’s voice sounded.
"Greetings Monarch." Many bowed, but his cousins remained seated with frowns on their faces.
"Okay, so let’s start with this meeting." Looking around, Gunter continued: "I am sure you have all heard by now that my son, Art, is back and awake."
"Yes, we have.

His name was Max, a name Vritra had not heard in quite some time.
"Well, not really.
My son will take over the meeting from here on."
Gunter took a step back, as everyone quieted down, while the middle-aged men got ready to barrage the young guy with questions and allegations.

At first several gasps, mostly from women, sounded as they saw his appearance.
It truly enchanted them.
While the men instantly felt jealous, as even their wives or lovers were looking at him unlike anything they had experienced before.

Where have you been all this time?
How can we even know if you are the real Art?" As Max shouted, others followed, filling the hall with noises.

chapters.title: Chapter 495: Beating
paragraphs: The hall fell silent for a few moments, then they all burst out in angry roars.
How could they allow someone who had just returned to the family to look down upon them and talk in such an insulting manner.
"You might be the son of the monarch but nothing gives you the right to insult me or my brothers." One from among the crowd stood up, his body trembling.
Then he looked at others and shouted: "Brothers and sisters, please let me teach him a lesson in your place."
It might seem like family love but they all knew since Art himself had said it so the first to hit him would be declared the next monarch.
Not even Gunter could refuse it later since he didn’t object.
While the current monarch had a deep frown over his face, was this truly alright? His son didn’t really seem like an idiot so what was he planning?
Could it be he didn’t want the seat at all.
’I hope you have something planned for this.’ Gunter remained silent, even though Vritra losing would be utterly shameful for him but for some reason he trusted him.
"No, I will be the one going!" Ray stood up but in the next instant his father gripped his hair and jerked his head back, pulling him to sit back on his seat.
"Stay silent, if I so much as hear your voice, you three will have your ass whooped." Sid said.
"Brothers, let me fight. It is just impossible for him to be the monarch."
"You stupid bastard, why isn’t it possible? Why not?" Sid shouted, soon he was dragged out of there along with his kids.
In hurry, several young men and women jumped from their seats, throwing away any pretence of decorum or respect.
"I will be the next monarch."
Within moments, over fifty people had gathered before Vritra, all looking at him as if he was their mortal enemy.
"Well then, attack." Vritra took a wooden sword from a guard nearby and stood with one of his arms behind his back.
At this disrespect, they became even more riled up and angry.
Many even took out their weapons to attack but feeling the deadly glare from Gunter they silently put them away.
"Brothers, let me punish him for you all." The first guy was at the forefront as he smiled hideously and launched a full-power punch towards Vritra which would certainly injure him badly.
"..." Vritra contemplated something for a moment as he gazed at the small army of mad young masters, who would do anything to become the monarch.
Then faint traces of his mana climbed onto the sword, glowing with different lights but none could see that.
His strength was more than enough to hurt them really badly but this mana would cling to their bodies and no matter what potion they drank, they wouldn’t be healed for a year or two.
"Forgive me young master, but you need some manners. And as your elder brother, this is my duty." The first guy’s punch arrived before Vritra.
He was only at the sixth legion and was certainly bad at fighting.
Shaking his head, Vritra tapped over his shoulders, elbow, wrists, knees and neck so fast that no one was able to see the movement of his hand.
The broken guy’s fist passed through the empty air, his body instinctively taking a couple steps forward before he just fell down.
But all others were in a rush, none noticed that one of them had been taken out already.
Or the fact how his arms, legs and neck had been twisted, though he was alive he wouldn’t be able to move at all for quite some time.
"Art, remember we used to play together when you were younger? I will go easy on you and share your burden, so take this!" The second guy kicked towards Vritra with the same ferocity.
Vritra continued to move forward slowly, his right hand moving at extreme speed and faint tapping noises along with the sound of bones snapping mixed with their collective shouts.
They rushed at him from all directions, but it was just too easy, only one among the younger generation had reached the general rank.
It was the eldest among Art’s cousins, the son of Max.
Kicks, punches, or wooden weapons all were launched towards Vritra, with only one thought in their minds.
"Fuck, just one hit, let me hit you once. I will even let you have my girl, I have to become the next monarch!!"
But in the moment, Vritra folded the guy with the stick as he continued to move efficiently among the crowd.
A woman tried to sneak attack from behind, but the stick landed over its mark perfectly, throwing her away as she lay all twisted over the ground.
If it was before then he really might have gone easy on them, but now, he didn’t really feel anything.
He didn’t outright kill these cousins and uncles since he still needed to find Yennefer.
"W- What? How... How is he beating all of us- ughhh cough" finally they began to notice how Vritra was easily beating them all up.
Then they looked at the dozen bodies fallen over the ground and shivered, all of them looked so twisted and broken.
They hadn’t just fainted, their limbs and even backbone were in a really bad condition.
"A- A monster!!" Few teenagers had lost their chances to jump in the fighting area or just didn’t want to compete.
They looked at the scene in complete shock, from the start Vritra was moving around casually, they couldn’t even see how his right arm was moving.
And one by one, all of the proud young masters from the Yate family fell.
"H- He was this strong all along?" Gunter was even more baffled, even he couldn’t see how Vritra’s arm was moving, but he couldn’t believe that Vritra had reached the lord rank yet.
So it just must be some special skill.
The parents of the injured men and women rose to their feet, shock and rage bubbling over.
Most held back from jumping there and attacking Vritra because of Gunter but one of the men whose sons got beaten at first couldn’t hold back.
"You bastard, I am going to kill you!!" Roaring madly, he jumped out of his seat and pulled out his sword, pouncing towards Vritra.
Vritra didn’t even turn to look as Gunter appeared before the charging man, his hands moved at high speed, and then...
CLANG
THUD
The sword and arm of one of his cousins fell to the ground before the man could register.
Then he too fell down and began to roll around, screaming as pain flooded out.
"No one is allowed to disturb this fight, they joined with their choices and now have to face the consequences." Gunter warned, looking at all his cousins.
Then asked one of the guards to drag the one-handed man.
By now, no one among the younger generation dared to attack Vritra, the ones who had foolishly jumped inside were now running for their lives.
Yet, Vritra showed absolutely no mercy, not allowing anyone to escape and within a few moments, over fifty of them were lying twisted, broken and unconscious.
Their parents seething with rage.

chapters.title: Chapter 496: Glib Tongued
paragraphs: The entire hall was completely silent, more than fifty young men and women lay over the floor, their limbs twisted.
And even with the help of the best healing potions, they wouldn’t be able to heal anytime soon.
The one in the worst condition was Max’s son, the only one who was at the general rank.
Overconfident in his ability, he was directly aiming to kill Vritra with one of his strongest attacks.
Believing his father was the strongest among all of Gunter’s cousins, and only a little younger than him, he thought he would be able to handle the situation.
But before he knew it, most of the bones in his body were shattered. If he wasn’t rushed to treatment, then he really might die.
"This is insane!!" the parents of all of them exploded in rage, Max seeming the angriest, sensing his son’s weak state.
Yet he didn’t dare to jump into the fighting area simply because Gunter was standing there.
"And as you can see, none of them are more fit to be the next monarch than me. Alright, the first round is over, you can take them away."
Vritra said, casually waving his hand, throwing the wooden sword away.
"My son!! Ah, why is his neck m-moving around so freely?"
"Daughter, are you still alive? I told you to just stay at home and learn to cook, ughh look at her arms..."
All the parents finally rushed into the arena. They checked their children’s condition and felt aggrieved.
All of them took out their best potions, but it didn’t really do anything.
"Healers, take them all away and treat them to the best of your abilities." Gunter ordered as dozens of healers soon rushed inside.
No wonder Vritra had ordered the guards to call some healers.
Some parents went along with their children, just wanting to get away from there.
They didn’t want to offend the person who was going to be their future monarch.
While many were still angry as they glared at Vritra and Gunter.
"Monarch, what is the meaning of this?" Max was the voice of dozens of parents who weren’t really happy about the outcome and needed Vritra to apologize and leave his seat.
"This just means your children are trash who can’t even deal with someone as weak as me." Vritra interrupted, shrugging.
"Pffttt weak? Hubby, since when is a demi god considered weak? A thought alone is enough to bury them all along this realm for you." Yasmine said, chuckling at his modesty.
’Wifey, are there any other demi gods on this planet?’ Vritra became curious about demi gods and titans.
"I doubt it. Once before, someone from the dark organization called Twilight tried to obtain that level of power.
At one point, that was the number one dark organization, and through inhumane means and committing endless slaughter and plundering, the leader almost became a demi god.
Like I had told you before, he was about to blow off a big part of this planet, but luckily he was killed at a moment of weakness during his transformation into a demi god.
Then most of the members of Twilight were hunted and killed and it disappeared completely soon." Yasmine explained.

’Oh Twilight... isn’t that the organization Red and others had joined? I wonder if it’s the same Twilight or a different one.’ Vritra wondered. It seemed a demi god truly possessed that level of power.
’I wish I can obtain more information about the titan race too, do you know anywhere I can find that?’ he questioned.
While their conversation was taking place, everyone around them was moving very slowly.
Vritra clearly saw the expression of all the men in the group become uglier after his reply.
"Not really, but there is one family that boasts about possessing the highest level of information and knowledge.
Maybe you can find it there. It’s one of the top five families." Yasmine answered after thinking for a few moments.
Nodding, he put his attention back to the men in front of him as once again time started moving at a normal speed.
"You brat! How dare you? Gunter, are you really allowing this to happen? Can’t you teach your son better manners?" Max was brimming with endless rage.
One of the men stepped forward, shouting angrily: "Even if this was a fight for the seat of monarch, how could you hurt your own siblings to that extent?
Even if you are strong, this just shows what sort of leader you would be. You clearly are not fit to be a leader."
"Right, who knows where he has been all this time? What if he was taken away by the enemies and got brainwashed by them? How can we ever trust him?"
Gunter was ready to interject if Vritra was overwhelmed by those men, but so far he was holding on perfectly.
He couldn’t help but feel proud of him. Not even these people with poisoned tongues and daggers in hand, ready to betray, could beat him in talking.
"Are you now going to put the blame of their incompetence on me? What can I even do if they broke by just light taps? Should I have sung a lullaby until they fell asleep and I became a winner?
Clearly, the apple doesn’t fall far from the tree." Vritra spoke, looking at the raging men emotionlessly.
"This is just absurd, haa is this what our family has been reduced to? A brat is disrespecting us all and Gunter, you are just going to watch this?
Should I take it that you won’t interfere if we were to teach your son some manners?" Max said, his only leash was Gunter, otherwise he would have already killed Art for the second time.
"Try it." Gunter just smiled, standing with his hands behind his back.
"Tch. Forget that, but we can’t let him be our next monarch or we would all leave the family. You wouldn’t want that right?
I am sure the other families would be more than happy to let us all join." Max said and all others behind him nodded in agreement.
While Gunter was busy with all the other matters, it seemed his younger cousin had joined hands with them all, their link clearly being greed.
"Oh sure, leave right now if you so wish, but understand. The moment you set foot out of this realm, you, your women, your children, servants, everyone would be killed without any exceptions."
A big smile twisted over his face as Vritra spoke, taking a step ahead.
"You bastard!!"
Max was at the lord rank, the only one among the brothers who had very recently reached that level.
Though the family did have several lord ranked humans, the branch family preferred staying safe and enjoying rather than going out in danger.
However, before Max could attack, Vritra spoke: "If among you, anyone is not happy with this decision, they are free to fight me.
The condition is the same. Come together or alone, if you can hit me once, you can have the seat."
Gunter was just puzzled and shocked. By saying things like that Vritra was making things difficult for him.
How can he just save his son directly if it’s a fair competition?
’Whatever, my son, my family is far more important to me than my reputation or this position.’ He thought and got ready to intervene at any moment.
While the group of several dozen men grinned hideously, finally!!

It seemed a demi god truly possessed that level of power.
’I wish I can obtain more information about the titan race too, do you know anywhere I can find that?’ he questioned.
While their conversation was taking place, everyone around them was moving very slowly.
Vritra clearly saw the expression of all the men in the group become uglier after his reply.
"Not really, but there is one family that boasts about possessing the highest level of information and knowledge.
Maybe you can find it there.
It’s one of the top five families." Yasmine answered after thinking for a few moments.
Nodding, he put his attention back to the men in front of him as once again time started moving at a normal speed.
"You brat!
How dare you?
Gunter, are you really allowing this to happen?
Can’t you teach your son better manners?" Max was brimming with endless rage.
One of the men stepped forward, shouting angrily: "Even if this was a fight for the seat of monarch, how could you hurt your own siblings to that extent?
Even if you are strong, this just shows what sort of leader you would be.
You clearly are not fit to be a leader."
"Right, who knows where he has been all this time?
What if he was taken away by the enemies and got brainwashed by them?
How can we ever trust him?"
Gunter was ready to interject if Vritra was overwhelmed by those men, but so far he was holding on perfectly.
He couldn’t help but feel proud of him.
Not even these people with poisoned tongues and daggers in hand, ready to betray, could beat him in talking.
"Are you now going to put the blame of their incompetence on me?
What can I even do if they broke by just light taps?
Should I have sung a lullaby until they fell asleep and I became a winner?
Clearly, the apple doesn’t fall far from the tree." Vritra spoke, looking at the raging men emotionlessly.
"This is just absurd, haa is this what our family has been reduced to?
A brat is disrespecting us all and Gunter, you are just going to watch this?
Should I take it that you won’t interfere if we were to teach your son some manners?" Max said, his only leash was Gunter, otherwise he would have already killed Art for the second time.
"Try it." Gunter just smiled, standing with his hands behind his back.
"Tch.
Forget that, but we can’t let him be our next monarch or we would all leave the family.
You wouldn’t want that right?
I am sure the other families would be more than happy to let us all join." Max said and all others behind him nodded in agreement.
While Gunter was busy with all the other matters, it seemed his younger cousin had joined hands with them all, their link clearly being greed.
"Oh sure, leave right now if you so wish, but understand.
The moment you set foot out of this realm, you, your women, your children, servants, everyone would be killed without any exceptions."
A big smile twisted over his face as Vritra spoke, taking a step ahead.
"You bastard!!"
Max was at the lord rank, the only one among the brothers who had very recently reached that level.
Though the family did have several lord ranked humans, the branch family preferred staying safe and enjoying rather than going out in danger.
However, before Max could attack, Vritra spoke: "If among you, anyone is not happy with this decision, they are free to fight me.
The condition is the same.
Come together or alone, if you can hit me once, you can have the seat."
Gunter was just puzzled and shocked.
By saying things like that Vritra was making things difficult for him.
How can he just save his son directly if it’s a fair competition?
’Whatever, my son, my family is far more important to me than my reputation or this position.’ He thought and got ready to intervene at any moment.
While the group of several dozen men grinned hideously, finally!!

chapters.title: Chapter 497: Bully
paragraphs: Finally, it was their turn. Earlier they were trying to somehow stop Gunter from interfering, but his son just proved too cunning.
Though maybe he was still too young and stupid, giving them a reason to beat him as badly as they wanted.
"Brothers, we are not like him, we put the family and our bonds before the greed of seat and anything else.
Do not kill him or hurt him too badly, we just need to teach some manners to this kid." Max’s face looked ugly, with a mix of rage and a smile.
He was going to deliver a hundred times of what his son had suffered.
"Yes yes, don’t worry big brother, we will go re~ally easy on him, we won’t bully him. Just give him light pats, though we don’t know if he can handle that."
"Monarch, you can’t interfere with the battle now, he was the one to challenge us or what reputation will you have among the entire family."
"..." Gunter remained silent and just moved back, though he would save his son no matter the cost.
"Let’s start." Max was at the forefront, despite being a lord he shamelessly got ready to attack someone of the younger generation.
"Wait." Vritra called out.
"Oh, you want to back out now? Fine, give up your seat and apologize to everyone you have hurt just no-" one man smiled and said arrogantly.
But ignoring him, Vritra looked around and gestured at one of the guards to come closer.
Then he took the sword, a real one this time.
"I will hold back, but still, let me warn you. If you choose to attack me, be prepared to lose your life." Vritra said, again taking the same posture.
His left hand was behind his back while the sword pointed towards them.
"You young brat, how can you be so shameless and disrespectful at such a young age. Let’s attack him." Max roared.
For some reason the others were getting a bit afraid but Max gave them strength.
Ignoring the warning they all charged forward, with Max being in the lead.
Shaking his head, Vritra took a step forward as his body suddenly flashed to the back of the group.
WHOOSH
His right hand once again became a blur, and then a fountain of blood spurted out.
The sword drew a perfect circle in the air, he attacked the man present at the back of the group.
Then the upper body of the man fell forward, being sliced apart near the thighs, while his hands were thrown forward.
The man’s face smashed into the floor and for a few moments he couldn’t understand anything, but then pain shot through his entire body.
Yet by the moment he let out a heart-wrenching scream, Vritra had already plunged the sword into the belly of another man.
He twisted the sword and pulled back as inner organs mangled with the blade came out, the man falling to the ground, unconscious.
With their levels, they would certainly survive such injuries yet it would leave them weakened for a very long time if not forever.
’Just... how strong is my son?’ Gunter felt he was watching some dream, he even pinched himself.
Yet the constant fountains of blood rising in the air, the murky scent of blood and ear-piercing screams definitely were real.
The well-being of these family members was the least of his concern.
They didn’t really contribute, if their limbs are chopped off then at least they would sit peacefully in their homes and not cause trouble.
’Just don’t kill anyone or that would be troublesome.’
Max turned as he heard the scream, while his claws slashed at the empty air.
Turning around, he saw two guys lying on the ground, torn and bloodied while Vritra already had his sword pierced into the chest of another.
"This!!"
Vritra was stronger than he expected, and possessed a good agility move it seemed, but there was no way he could be at the lord rank.
Max gritted his teeth and increased his speed, rushing in Vritra’s direction with an even stronger attack.
’I am going to tear him apart!!’
Roaring, Max once again ran towards Vritra, yet once again, Vritra just moved to the other side.
He kept attacking one man after another, just careful enough not to accidentally kill them but also letting them feel enough pain.
The rage that had been building inside him since the war seemed to be erupting, but Vritra held back greatly.
"You brat, how can the son of Gunter be such a coward? Stop there and face me, stop running away." Max shouted.
Vritra smiled, he plunged the sword into another man’s chest and slowly pulled it down, drawing a vertical line.

"Stop? Should I present my neck on a plate or something? Don’t tell me you can’t even catch me? Aww how pitiful, no wonder you have nine child with only three being yours." Vritra said, pulling out the sword.
Despite all the bloodshed, there wasn’t a drop of blood on Vritra’s skin or clothes.
"You despicable brat, I am going to kill you!!" Max almost went mad.
Vritra seemed to have hit a sore spot, it was actually true and almost all the people were aware of this fact.
Yet because of fear of Max, none dared to say it out loud, though Vritra got to know of it through the oldest healer.
Max had even caught his wife cheating but he could still do nothing since she was from another top family and if he dared to hurt her, his future would be bleak.
Like a wild beast, Max ran towards Vritra again in a futile attempt to hit him.
’H- He really is at the lord rank?’ Gunter was now sure of it, he was really curious about the things he might be hiding.
Vritra just ignored Max for now, he moved across the crowd, striking one man down after another.
By now, just like their kids, they had started to run for their lives, yet none was spared.
Within a minute, Vritra and Max stood in a large pool of blood, broken, torn and groaning bodies littered the area.
"..." Max calmed his mind, anger was only going to make him weaker.
His claws grew, energy fluctuating wildly around him as he decided to launch one of his strongest attacks on Vritra.
Gunter became nervous and ran forward to stop him.
Vritra rolled his eyes, he casually walked forward yet was several times faster than both Gunter and Max.
With a thought, he influenced the flow of energy in Max’s body, as all the energy dissipated and even his claws disappeared.
Then raising his arm, Vritra gripped his throat, raising his body higher.
"H- Huh? Ughhh cough H- How...?" it all happened way too fast, even Gunter paused, baffled by the sight.
Giving a light squeeze, almost snuffing out the life from him, he muttered: "So, do you admit defeat?"
Max still tried to hit Vritra but neither could he gather any mana nor could he move his body.
Finally, a sense of dread crept into his body, this young guy certainly wasn’t someone they could handle.
He couldn’t understand how such a young guy could be so strong in such small time, not even Gunter can defeat him that easily.
"D- Gefeak ughhh I agmik cough I admit d-defeat... f-forgive me..." max spoke with difficulty.
"Too late."

chapters.title: Chapter 498: Subdued
paragraphs: "Too late."
CRACK
A clear sound of neck snapping rang out, all the people who were rolling across the ground in pain suddenly paused.
Max’s motionless body fell to the ground as everyone stared at Vritra in horror.
Did he just kill a lord without any effort at all?
On top of that, he had just killed a family member, one of the oldest cousins, this was the biggest crime!!
’Sigh...’ Gunter sighed, it seemed his days as monarch were numbered.
"H- How can you kill him?!! Guards arrest him, M- Monarch, this is just outrageous." All of them, forgetting their pain, started screaming madly.
"He isn’t dead, just unconscious, don’t worry he will wake up."
Vritra’s calm voice interrupted them, and then they noticed the wheezing noise Max was creating with each breath.
He would certainly wake up but would be powerless in the future and would never be able to move.
"Healers, take them all away! They need treatment, make sure to treat them nicely." Gunter, finally relaxed, stepped forward and spoke.
And so, the baffled healers dragged all the patients, but with the teenagers already in care, the parents would have to wait.
"Art, are you okay?" Finally the crowd was gone, Gunter approached him and asked in worry, several questions filling his eyes.
"Yeah I am fine, and even if you do ask anything now I wouldn’t be able to answer them." Vritra said before the middle-aged man had a chance of asking anything.
Few hours later, again in the same large hall.
One side of the seats was filled with the teenagers who were wrapped by bandages, their limbs set completely straight.
While the other side was filled with their parents, few were still missing a limb or two, they were all in even worse conditions.
"Now, does any of you still have a problem with my son being the next monarch?" Gunter questioned, Vritra standing beside him.
They all started mumbling together at the same time, buzzing like bees, complaining about the unfairness of the world.
"Be clear, I can’t hear you. I might take this as a yes and start another round of battle." Vritra said, as all of them hurriedly and loudly spoke.
"O- Of course we don’t have any problem with you ruling us ughhh in the future, these injuries are proof enough that you would be a great ruler."
Max remained completely silent, he was in the worst condition of all. He couldn’t even close his mouth, his lips in a big O shape.

’Who the hell is this demon?! There is no way he could be the real A- Art, after all... after all, it was I who killed him with my own hands in the labyrinth.’ Max thought, looking fearfully at Vritra.
But there was no way he could say something like that out loud.
If he wanted to expose Vritra, first he would have to expose himself.
And what if this was Gunter’s plan all along? Max shivered at just the thought.
"Alright, I knew everyone would be overjoyed by my son ruling the family next, look how happy they all look." The monarch said, laughing out loud.
Vritra had taken care of everything in just a day. Strength truly could do the impossible, not to mention he didn’t show any mercy.
Gunter could never have done that.
"Good, all of you can return and rest, but if I so much as hear any of you planning anything behind my back, just think of uncle Max. You could be in worse condition."
Vritra warned and finally the meeting was over.
Vritra didn’t want any additional trouble from them, so he had even used the natural hypnosis on them.
At least, none of them would try anything funny.
Gunter and Vritra first went to meet Ava, the woman was getting better quite fast.
Soon, the two were walking across the long corridor.
"Can we go meet the Fords now?" Vritra asked, in a hurry to find any clue about Yennefer.
"Just wait a little more, they are already busy with the marriage trials preparations. Even if we go, we won’t be able to meet Sir Giant." Gunter replied.
"How long?" With a frown, he pressed on.
"Probably a few days. Actually, my visit this time to the Ford family was related to your marriage, it was something my father promised to that... uh your bride’s father when you were quite young.
I too would have preferred not to bring it up yet, but it can’t be delayed any longer, because of the oath." Gunter said.
It wasn’t any ordinary oath; it was taken with the Gods being their judge. So, if the two failed to go through it, both would receive the God’s wrath.
Vritra’s frown deepened, he wondered why they were so desperate for this marriage, even forming such an oath.
"And whose idea was the oath?" he questioned.
"Oh, it was her father." Came the reply.
Was the girl defective or something that they had to forcefully shove her to him; this was clearly a forced marriage.
Then he questioned in his mind: ’Wifey, won’t this oath already be broken since the real Art is already dead?’
And he almost knew who could have killed Art or knew the real culprit.
It was only Max who looked at him as if he was sure that Vritra wasn’t the real Art.
"Well since Divine used the real Art’s body’s and core’s property then he must have made some arrangement in advance, maybe merging with your soul a part of Art’s soul.
Hmm is that how you were able to stay alive even as a consciousness?" Yasmine spoke, pondering.
If the two families had already made an oath to get him married to that girl, then what was the point of the whole marriage trials and competitions?
But Vritra didn’t really care all that much about the marriage or the two families, he was just focused on his goals.
They continued to walk silently for a while.
Finally, Gunter broke the silence.
"Sigh Son, I know this is a big burden for you, you are literally being forced into this marriage. And she is so much older than you too so if you don’t want to do it, I can unders-"
Vritra ignored both his words and concerns since he didn’t plan to go through with the marriage, as he interrupted: "Its alright I understand, but for some time I need to go out."
"Go out... will it be safe?" Gunter didn’t really know what secret he was hiding, but with that strength, his enemies might be just as dangerous.
"Yeah, when it is time to go, you can contact me through this glyph." Vritra pulled out a small white glyph from his inventory, passing it on.
"Okay... just be careful and return as soon as possible, your mother can’t go a day without seeing you now."
And within moments, Vritra was gone, disappeared into thin air.
Gunter knew perfectly well that Vritra was stronger than him, so he wasn’t really surprised.
After a moment, he walked away, there were a lot of preparations needed for the marriage after all.

chapters.title: Chapter 499: Meeting the Queen
paragraphs: In the new Quartz continent, the city of charms was made at the heart of the continent.
The demons hadn’t been much of a bother for some time now, after all they too had made a big loss.
Things had been quite peaceful, though Twilight had started to become a big issue ever since several broken dark organizations joined it.
The cities were bustling with crowd, it was a cloudy day, thousands of storytellers were spread across the cities.
People would stop and listen to the stories, although the Golden Moon and others had tried to stop that but they just couldn’t.
The influence of Golden Moon had greatly decreased in the continent, even the Phoenix continent had now merged with Quartz continent.
Vritra was pleasantly surprised as he landed inside one of the cities, it appeared almost as if there hadn’t been such a deadly war just a few years ago.
He walked slowly, taking in the sight around him and soon saw a small crowd gathered before a storyteller.
"And that’s how he protected the Dunshire kingdom from demons, Nine Pacts and Bone Blood Cult.
The Blue kingdom from the Grieves and freed the White kingdom from slavery, saved their king and defeated demons, Nine Pacts and Bone Blood Cult in the war, protecting it.
And even in the Quartz continent, he captured a lot of criminals, protected thousands of people who were almost exploded to pieces by demons."
Holding an ancient-looking book, the storyteller was speaking in a dramatic way.
’That sounds... strangely familiar.’ Vritra thought, shaking his head.
This must be the work of his wives, to completely change the way the world looked at him and expose the righteous organization.
"Do you even have any proof? We all know that demon destroyed the whole continent, killed over a million soldiers, how can we believe some random man?
Not to mention that announcement about him being the divine." someone from the crowd shouted.
Since Golden Moon failed to forcefully suppress these storytellers, they decided to do it the easy way.
It was someone from the Golden Moon who was tasked to not let people’s opinion shift.
"Of course, I am not fool enough to be standing here and muttering gibberish without anything backing it up." The storyteller said confidently, as the dozens of people watching him became curious.
"Oh, and what is it?" the same man from the crowd questioned.
"Here, the empress of this continent, the goddess herself, someone who would never lie is saying the truth, what else you need."
The storyteller threw a glyph into the sky, as Diana’s image burst out of it.
Vritra stared at the goddess’s face, she looked even more beautiful, and now she was actually the empress.
She really had matured a lot, it was a little hard to imagine the same haughty and careless goddess he met back then to be the same graceful and tactical lady.
All the people instantly kneeled, bowing in the goddess’s presence.
"My loyal subjects, rise... The Golden Moon has never been what we believed it to be, they could turn an innocent man into a heinous criminal overnight.
If suddenly, few people enter your house, try to kill you, your family, what would you do?"
Diana’s image paused, and the response of all the people matched.
Of course, they would try to stop them and if needed even kill them.

"Exactly, did they explain why Vritra Arclis was a criminal, what crime he committed? They just said he is a demon, so according to their wish, they could mobilize all the army and attack a person who was actually killing the criminals and demons?
Why hadn’t the Golden Moon taken responsibility for the death of so many soldiers? How can we believe them when their leader is a coward, a schemer, and doesn’t care about any of us."
Diana was speaking, slowly but loudly, her voice full of suppressed rage.
’She has gotten quite good at speaking.’ Vritra smiled.
It seemed they were aware that he was not dead and will return very soon.
Maybe Yennefer left some message behind.
’T- This! We all knew who was behind these storytellers but they hadn’t acted directly before, but now they are not even afraid of anything, even the empress is openly supporting that demon.’
The man from the Golden Moon thought, looking around he saw the almost hypnotized expressions of the crowd.
’Looks like we will soon have to deal with them all, the goddess, the succubus queen, the phoenix empress and the world information centre.’ He thought, then sighing he left.
Diana was too good at influencing people, after becoming the empress she won people’s trust in such a small time.
Vritra too continued to walk, excited to be reunited with his family finally.
In a big hall, a stunningly gorgeous and seductive woman was seated over a throne at the high platform.
In front of her, dozens of women were seated on the seats present on the left and right, while three men knelt; chains wrapped around them.
"Queen, these three men tried to kidnap a group of children and almost succeeded. They are smugglers, selling women and children." A woman named Layla said, glaring at the three.
The queen barely stopped herself from tearing them apart herself, after a moment she commanded:
"Cut off their limbs, hang them outside the city and let the birds feed over their flesh. And... cut off their lower parts too, feed it to them."
"Yes, queen." Layla said and gestured for the chained men to be dragged away, as the three looked on with looks of horror.
Their mouths were stuffed with clothes, unable to speak at all, yet they continued to beg.
"That’s all for now... recently the number of attacks by humans, demons and others in our city has increased. They are becoming bolder." She added, releasing a long sigh.
"Let them come, anyone who comes here with ill intentions will be killed and made an example out of." The queen said, before adding:
"Send a message to the human empress, if more humans dare to trespass then we, the succubus, will launch a war against them." Vanessa spoke, a green flame dancing around her body.
"Y- Yes, I understand." Layla nodded, had been spending time with Diana and Fiona ever since they started living in the city of charms.
Vanessa had such good relations with the other two before, she couldn’t understand how did things suddenly become so chaotic between them.
It almost felt as if a war might break between the humans, succubus and the phoenix race.
"If we are done for today then let’s head to th-" just as Vanessa was about to get up, one of the women guarding at the door spoke in urgency.

"Queen, a m- man has entered our city, even our palace, and is asking to let him enter this hall, h- he wishes to meet you. Should we detain him or...?" the guard asked nervously, since none of them could really do anything to him, they couldn’t stop him at all.
Just then, the man actually dared to enter the hall.
"Forgive me, my queen, but there is something important I must tell you about." He said, with a faint smile.
